cryxianMonstrosity.name: Cryxian Monstrosity
cryxianMonstrosity.description:
This model is a monstrosity that can be included in a Cryxian warcaster's battlegroup. A Cryxian warcaster can allocate focus points to this model as if it was a warjack. If this model's warcaster is destroyed or removed from the table, it becomes autonomous. A Cryxian warcaster can take control of an autonomous friendly Cryxian monstrosity. To do this, a Cryxian warcaster must spend 1 focus point during its activation while B2B with the autonomous Cryxian monstrosity. The monstrosity must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it becomes controlled. The monstrosity becomes a part of the battlegroup of the warcaster that took control of it.

At any time during its activation, a Cryxian warcaster can spend focus points to heal damage a monstrosity in its battlegroup in its control range has suffered. For each focus point spent this way, remove 1 damage point.

lesserWarlock.name: Lesser Warlock
lesserWarlock.description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage. This model must have at least one warbeast in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

limitedBattlegroupWarBoarMMD47.name: Limited Battlegroup [War Boar MMD47]
limitedBattlegroupWarBoarMMD47.description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is War Boar MMD47.

hyperAggressive.name: Hyper-Aggressive
hyperAggressive.description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

fullBoar.name: Full Boar
fullBoar.description: This model can use Full Boar at the start of its activation. This model gains +2 SPD that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Full Boar can be used only once per activation.

bulldoze.name: Bulldoze
bulldoze.description: When this model is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when this model makes a trample power attack.

exhaustFumes.name: Exhaust Fumes
exhaustFumes.description: When this model advances during its Normal Movement, for one round other friendly models gain concealment while within 3" of this model.

fieldMarshalHyperAggressive.name: Field Marshal [Hyper-Aggressive]
fieldMarshalHyperAggressive.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Hyper-Aggressive. (When a model with Hyper-Aggressive suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.)

veteranLeaderFarrowWarrior.name: Veteran Leader [Farrow warrior]
veteranLeaderFarrowWarrior.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Farrow warrior models gain +1 to attack rolls.

greatPower.name: Great Power
greatPower.description: During your Control Phase, this model can upkeep one spell without spending a focus or fury point.

arcaneAssist.name: Arcane Assist
arcaneAssist.description: If its Leader is within 5" of this model during your Control Phase, the Leader can upkeep one spell without spending a focus or fury point.

repairD6Action__c26272a1.name: Repair [d6] (★Action)
repairD6Action__c26272a1.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

ancillaryAttackAction__69fabdc4.name: Ancillary Attack (★ Action)
ancillaryAttackAction__69fabdc4.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by an Ancillary Attack special action only once per turn.

sucker.name: Sucker!
sucker.description: If this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

anatomicalPrecision.name: Anatomical Precision
anatomicalPrecision.description: When this model’s melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

limitedBattlegroupAberration.name: Limited Battlegroup [Aberration]
limitedBattlegroupAberration.description: The only cohort that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Aberration.

vitalizerAction__df1da9e6.name: Vitalizer (★ Action)
vitalizerAction__df1da9e6.description: RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.

journeymanCephalyxWarcaster.name: Journeyman Cephalyx Warcaster
journeymanCephalyxWarcaster.description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Healing, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model may allocate focus point to monstrosities in it's battlegroup as if they were a warjack. This model must have at least one cohort in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

combatDrugsAction.name: Combat Drugs (★ Action)
combatDrugsAction.description: RNG 5. Target Cohort in this model’s battlegroup gains Aggressive for one turn. (A model with Aggressive can run or charge without spending a focus point or being forced.)

hormoneManipulation.name: Hormone Manipulation
hormoneManipulation.description: When this model begins its activation in Nostilla's control range, choose one of the following effects. Hormone Manipulation effects last for one round.

adrenalSurge.name: •Adrenal Surge
adrenalSurge.description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, models with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

endorphinDump.name: •Endorphin Dump
endorphinDump.description: This model gains +2 to its attack rolls.

dopamineBoost.name: •Dopamine Boost
dopamineBoost.description: This model gains Overtake, and Swift Hunter. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".) (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

imperviousFlesh.name: Impervious Flesh
imperviousFlesh.description: When this model suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.

sacrosanctLight.name: Sacrosanct Light
sacrosanctLight.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy attack, you can have a friendly Gallant within 3" of it be directly hit instead. Gallant is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

limitedBattlegroupGallant.name: Limited Battlegroup [Gallant]
limitedBattlegroupGallant.description: The only warjack that can be in this model's battlegroup is Gallant.

requiemForTheFallen.name: Requiem for the Fallen
requiemForTheFallen.description: When a friendly model within 5" this model or a friendly Gallant is destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack, this model gains one requiem token. This model can have up to three requiem tokens at any time. During its activation, this model can spend requiem tokens for the following:

invocation.name: •Invocation
invocation.description: This model spends one requiem token to cast a spell without spending focus.

divineIllumination.name: •Divine Illumination
divineIllumination.description: This model spends one requiem token to gain Divine Inspiration until the end of its activation. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.)

knightOfTheProphet.name: Knight of the Prophet
knightOfTheProphet.description: When this model makes a melee damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly model that has one of this model’s upkeep spells, this model adds +2 to the roll.

absolution.name: •Absolution
absolution.description: This model spends one requiem token to remove one damage from a friendly model within its control range.

divineBulwark.name: Divine Bulwark
divineBulwark.description: During your Control Phase, this model gains 1 focus point for each enemy model within 5".

inviolableBastion.name: Inviolable Bastion
inviolableBastion.description: This model cannot be moved by a push, slam or throw. Opponents cannot take control of this model.

reposition3.name: Reposition [3"]
reposition3.description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.

deployCountermeasuresAction.name: Deploy Countermeasures (★Action)
deployCountermeasuresAction.description: Enemy models suffer –2 to charge attack rolls against this model and its battlegroup controller for one round.

blessingOfMorrow.name: Blessing of Morrow
blessingOfMorrow.description: While in this model's control range, friendly non-Leader Morrowan warrior models can spend focus points on this model during their activations to boost one melee attack or melee damage roll for each focus point spent.

flankMorrowan.name: Flank [Morrowan]
flankMorrowan.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Morrowan model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

soulTakerReclaim.name: Soul Taker: Reclaim
soulTakerReclaim.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living model is destroyed while in this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its focus points or leeches fury during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 focus or fury point.

accumulatorMorrowan.name: Accumulator [Morrowan]
accumulatorMorrowan.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Morrowan warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

bondBlaize.name: Bond [Blaize]
bondBlaize.description: If Gallant begins the game in Blaize’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Gallant is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Gallant is bonded to Blaize and B2B with her, she cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

sacredWard.name: Sacred Ward
sacredWard.description: This model cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

repairD31Action__f08d8031.name: •Repair [d3 +1] (★Action)
repairD31Action__f08d8031.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

resourceful.name: Resourceful
resourceful.description: This model can upkeep spells on models in its battlegroup without spending focus or fury points.

fieldMarshalUnyielding.name: Field Marshal [Unyielding]
fieldMarshalUnyielding.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

unyielding.name: Unyielding
unyielding.description: This model gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.

dodge.name: Dodge
dodge.description: This model can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.

warcasterBenefits.name: Warcaster Benefits
warcasterBenefits.description: While within 1" of its warcaster, this model can use one of the following special rules:

luckyCharmAction.name: •Lucky Charm (★ Action)
luckyCharmAction.description: During its activation this turn, this model’s warcaster can reroll one attack or damage roll, then Lucky Charm expires.

reloaderAction.name: •Reloader (★ Action)
reloaderAction.description: During its Combat Action this turn, this model’s warcaster can make one additional ranged attack.

spyglassAction.name: •Spyglass (★ Action)
spyglassAction.description: Target an enemy model in this model’s LOS. That model loses Stealth for one round.

destroyableDefenses.name: Destroyable Defenses
destroyableDefenses.description: A Defense is removed from the table if it is contacted by a model with an extra-large or huge base.

deployingDefenses.name: Deploying Defenses
deployingDefenses.description:
At the start of the game after turn order has been determined and standard terrain and objectives have been placed for the scenario, but before deploying models, place your Defenses. If both players are using Defenses, take turns placing Defenses starting with the Defender. 

A player can only place Defenses within 24" of the rear edge of their Deployment Zone. Additionally, Defenses cannot be deployed or placed within 3" of an objective, obstruction, obstacle, or other Defense terrain feature.

obstacle.name: Obstacle
obstacle.description: This terrain feature is an obstacle.

barrier.name: Barrier
barrier.description: When a large- or smaller-based model without Flight or Pathfinder attempts to cross this terrain feature, reduce the distance the model moves by 2".

barrier__f81e6c5b.name: Barrier
barrier__f81e6c5b.description: A Barrier is 4" in length, 1/2" wide, and 3/4" tall.

fireHazard.name: Fire Hazard
fireHazard.description: This terrain feature is a hazard. A model without Flight entering the area of this terrain feature suffers the Fire continuous effect. If a trooper model without Flight advances through the area of this terrain as part of its unit’s Normal Movement, all models in the unit suffer the fire continuous effect.

illumination.name: Illumination
illumination.description: Models lose Stealth while within 5" of this terrain feature.

spikeHazard.name: Spike Hazard
spikeHazard.description: This terrain feature is a hazard. An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 1" of this terrain feature suffers a POW 10 damage roll. If an enemy warjack without Flight enters this terrain feature, in addition to the POW 10 damage roll, the warjack also suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement System box. Your models do not suffer damage from these terrain features if you placed them.

roughTerrain.name: Rough Terrain
roughTerrain.description: This terrain feature is rough terrain.

spikeTrap.name: Spike Trap
spikeTrap.description: A Spike Trap's dimensions are 50mm square area terrain.

exploding.name: Exploding!
exploding.description: This terrain feature explodes and is removed from play if an extra-large or huge-based model contacts it. This terrain feature also explodes if a model contacts it as a result of slam or throw movement. This terrain feature explodes immediately after a Throw targeting it has been resolved. This terrain feature explodes if an attack targeting it results in a critical hit. When this terrain feature explodes, all models within 2" of it suffer a POW 15 blast damage roll, and this terrain feature is removed from the table.

targetable__e88cb9ef.name: Targetable
targetable__e88cb9ef.description: This terrain feature can be targeted by basic ranged and melee attacks as a small-based model. This terrain feature can be targeted by attacks made by either player’s models.  This terrain feature does not suffer damage or any other effects from attacks targeting it.

throwable.name: Throwable
throwable.description: Medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality can target this terrain feature with Throw Power Attacks. This terrain feature is automatically hit by the attack. For the purposes of resolving a throw, this terrain feature is considered to be a medium-based model. This terrain feature is moved 2 additional inches when thrown. A model hit by this terrain feature when it is thrown suffers collateral damage normally.

demolition.name: Demolition
demolition.description: A medium-based and larger models with the Throw Power Attack weapon quality within 1" of this terrain feature can make a Demolition (★ Action) special action during its activation.  When it does so remove this terrain feature and either another Defense or Trapdoor marker within 10" of it from the table.

alchemicalMask.name: Alchemical Mask
alchemicalMask.description: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS or resolving attacks, this model ignores cloud effects and concealment granted from cloud effects.

shieldWall.name: Shield Wall
shieldWall.description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.

smokeBombsAction.name: Smoke Bombs (★Action)
smokeBombsAction.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.

empowerAction.name: Empower (★ Action)
empowerAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point

repairD33Action.name: Repair [d3+3] (★ Action)
repairD33Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 + 3 damage points from it.

repairable.name: Repairable
repairable.description: This model can be targeted with Repair special actions as if it were a construct model.

repairD3Action.name: Repair [d3] (★ Action)
repairD3Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

bondSorscha.name: Bond [Sorscha]
bondSorscha.description: If Beast 09 begins the game in Sorscha’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Beast 09 is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Beast 09 is bonded to Sorscha and in her control range, it gains Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack during your opponent’s turn while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard directly hit instead. It is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

murderous.name: Murderous
murderous.description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.

berserk__98095277.name: Berserk
berserk__98095277.description: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.

freezer.name: Freezer
freezer.description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 2" of this model, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round.

fieldMarshalRelentlessCharge.name: Field Marshal [Relentless Charge]
fieldMarshalRelentlessCharge.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Relentless Charge.

relentlessCharge.name: Relentless Charge
relentlessCharge.description: While advancing as part of a charge, this model gains Pathfinder.

guardDog.name: Guard Dog
guardDog.description: While this model is within 3" of its Leader and is not knocked down or stationary, its Leader gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.

returnLeader.name: Return [Leader]
returnLeader.description: Immediately after resolving a charge attack, this model can make a full advance toward its Leader model.

noisyAction.name: Noisy (★Action)
noisyAction.description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models lose Stealth. Noisy lasts for one round.

noSleepingOnTheJobWinterGuard.name: No Sleeping on the Job [Winter Guard]
noSleepingOnTheJobWinterGuard.description: This model and friendly Winter Guard models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

fleet.name: Fleet
fleet.description: Once per activation, this model can spend 1 focus point to gain +2 SPD that activation.

smasher.name: Smasher
smasher.description: This model can make trample power attacks without spending focus and gains an additional die on trample attack rolls.

shieldGuard__fca004fb.name: Shield Guard
shieldGuard__fca004fb.description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

bondStrakhov.name: Bond [Strakhov]
bondStrakhov.description: If Torch begins the game in Strakhov’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Torch is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Torch is bonded to Strakhov and in his control range, it gains Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

heavyBoiler.name: Heavy Boiler
heavyBoiler.description: This model gains +2 SPD when running.

ventSteam.name: Vent Steam
ventSteam.description: This model can use Vent Steam once per activation at any time. Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Living and undead models in the template when it is placed suffer an unboostable POW 12 damage roll.

bondButcher.name: Bond [Butcher]
bondButcher.description: If Ruin begins the game in Butcher’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ruin is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Ruin is bonded to Butcher and in his control range, it gains Boundless Charge. (During its activation, a model with Boundless Charge can charge without spending focus or being forced and gains +2 SPD and Pathfinder when it charges.)

soulTakerSpiritHarvester.name: Soul Taker: Spirit Harvester
soulTakerSpiritHarvester.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model’s activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

spectralVortex__c0e8b444.name: Spectral Vortex
spectralVortex__c0e8b444.description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

fieldMarshalFlankManOWar.name: Field Marshal [Flank Man-O-War]
fieldMarshalFlankManOWar.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Flank [Man-O-War]. (When a model with Flank [Man-O-War] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Man-O-War model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

stormsEmbrace.name: Storm’s Embrace
stormsEmbrace.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models gain concealment.

battleWizard.name: Battle Wizard
battleWizard.description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

empowerAction__e131c030.name: •Empower (★Action)
empowerAction__e131c030.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point.

hoarfrostAttack.name: •Hoarfrost (★ Attack)
hoarfrostAttack.description: Hoarfrost is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 14/8 arcane attack that causes cold damage. On a critical hit, models hit become stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold.

magicAbility.name: Magic Ability
magicAbility.description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

guidanceAction.name: •Guidance (★ Action)
guidanceAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.

bondHarkevich.name: Bond [Harkevich]
bondHarkevich.description: If Black Ivan begins the game in Harkevich’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Black Ivan is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Black Ivan is bonded to Harkevich and in his control range, it gains Swift Hunter. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

evasive.name: Evasive
evasive.description: When this model is hit by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can advance up to 2".

steady__ee8b6350.name: Steady
steady__ee8b6350.description: This model cannot become knocked down.

girded.name: Girded
girded.description: This model and friendly models B2B with it gain Resistance: Blast.

rainOfDeathAttack.name: Rain of Death (★ Attack)
rainOfDeathAttack.description: This attack does not need a target. Models B2B with this model suffer a POW 18 blast damage roll. Other models within 3" of this model suffer a POW 9 blast damage roll. When this model charges, instead of making a charge attack it can make a Rain of Death attack. Rain of Death damage is simultaneous. After a Rain of Death attack, this model can make additional melee attacks. This model is not affected by Rain of Death.

iceBoltAttack.name: •Ice Bolt (★Attack)
iceBoltAttack.description: Ice Bolt is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit suffers a POW 12 cold damage roll. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

iceCageAttack.name: •Ice Cage (★Attack)
iceCageAttack.description: Ice Cage is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a direct hit a model hit suffers a cumulative –2 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold. When a model without Resistance: Cold is affected by two or more directly hitting Ice Cage attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.

battlePlan__c0764839.name: Battle Plan
battlePlan__c0764839.description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation.

fightingDirty.name: •Fighting Dirty
fightingDirty.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. Dirty Fighting lasts for one turn. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

sneak.name: •Sneak
sneak.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Prowl for one round. Sneak lasts for one round. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

moneyShot.name: •Money Shot
moneyShot.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 RAT and +2 to its ranged damage rolls for one turn.

prowl.name: Prowl
prowl.description: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

takeDown.name: Take Down
takeDown.description: Models disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by this model are removed from play.

veteranLeaderAssaultKommando.name: Veteran Leader [Assault Kommando]
veteranLeaderAssaultKommando.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Assault Kommando models gain +1 to attack rolls.

battlePlan.name: Battle Plan
battlePlan.description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

fightToTheLast.name: •Fight to the Last
fightToTheLast.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough for one round.

precisionStrike.name: •Precision Strike
precisionStrike.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them. Precision Strike lasts for one turn.

sacrificialPawnWinterGuardTrooper.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Winter Guard trooper]
sacrificialPawnWinterGuardTrooper.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Winter Guard trooper model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

desperatePaceWinterGuard.name: •Desperate Pace [Winter Guard]
desperatePaceWinterGuard.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Winter Guard trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

leadershipWidowmakerScouts.name: Leadership [Widowmaker Scouts]
leadershipWidowmakerScouts.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Widowmaker Scout models gain Swift Hunter.

marksman.name: Marksman
marksman.description: When damaging a warjack or warbeast with a ranged attack, choose which column or branch suffers damage.

swiftHunter__4a67cf58.name: Swift Hunter
swiftHunter__4a67cf58.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

sniper.name: Sniper
sniper.description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

artilleristAction.name: Artillerist (★Action)
artilleristAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, it gains +2 RAT when making a ranged attack with an AOE weapon. Artillerist lasts for one round.

leadershipWeaponCrew.name: Leadership [Weapon Crew]
leadershipWeaponCrew.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly weapon crew models gain Reposition [3"].

takeUp.name: Take Up
takeUp.description: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.

extendedFire.name: Extended Fire
extendedFire.description: This model can use Extended Fire once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, the ranged weapons of models in this unit gain Snipe. (An attack with a weapon with Snipe gains +3 RNG.)

grantedRise.name: Granted: Rise
grantedRise.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit that are knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase stand up.

combinedArms.name: Combined Arms
combinedArms.description: When this model misses an attack roll for a combined ranged attack, it can reroll that attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Combined Arms.

eliteCadreKossiteWoodsmenAndManhunters.name: Elite Cadre [Kossite Woodsmen and Manhunters]
eliteCadreKossiteWoodsmenAndManhunters.description: Friendly Kossite Woodsmen and Manhunters models gain Treewalker.

sprint.name: Sprint
sprint.description: At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, this model can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.

treewalker.name: Treewalker
treewalker.description: This model ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, this model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.

followUp.name: Follow Up
followUp.description: When this model slams an enemy model, immediately after the slam is resolved this model can advance directly toward the slammed model, up to the distance the slammed model was moved.

markTarget.name: Mark Target
markTarget.description: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to ranged attack rolls against enemy models within 5" of this model and in its LOS.

arcantrikTurbine.name: Arcantrik Turbine
arcantrikTurbine.description: At the start of this model’s activation, it can spend 1 focus point to gain +2 SPD and Pathfinder for one turn.

manInTheMachine.name: Man in the Machine
manInTheMachine.description: This model is a living model but is neither a warjack nor a warrior model. It has a damage grid and suffers damage like a warjack. This model can make power attacks without spending focus. Effects modifying the amount of damage to or the manner in which damage is applied to a warjack also apply to this model. This model cannot spend focus points to remove damage.

march.name: •March
march.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

unstoppableFuryManOWar.name: •Unstoppable Fury [Man-O-War]
unstoppableFuryManOWar.description: - RNG 5. Target friendly Man-O-War model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Retaliatory Strike for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

tactician.name: Tactician
tactician.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models ignore other friendly models when determining LOS. Friendly models can advance through other friendly models within 10" of this model if they have enough movement to move completely past them.

rallyingPoint.name: Rallying Point
rallyingPoint.description: While this model is in play, increase the RNG of Arconovich’s Battle Plans by +3

reveille.name: •Reveille
reveille.description: Knocked down friendly Faction models within 10" of this model immediately stand up. Models that became knocked down this turn are not affected by Reveille.

specialOrders.name: •Special Orders
specialOrders.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

fieldMarshalReposition3.name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
fieldMarshalReposition3.description: Cohort in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

smokeLaunchers.name: Smoke Launchers
smokeLaunchers.description: This model can use Smoke Launchers once per activation at any time. Place one cloud effect template completely within within 5" of this model. The template remains in play for one round.

grantedPathfinder.name: Granted: Pathfinder
grantedPathfinder.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Pathfinder

grantedQuickWork.name: Granted: Quick Work
grantedQuickWork.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Quick Work. (When a model with Quick Work destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved the model with Quick Work can make one basic ranged attack.)

supportFire.name: Support Fire
supportFire.description: This model can use Support Fire once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in its unit gain Dual Shot. (If a model with Dual Shot uses its Normal Movement to aim, it can make one additional ranged attack this activation.)

bondOfBrotherhood.name: Bond of Brotherhood
bondOfBrotherhood.description: This model can use Bond of Brotherhood once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. For one round, when a model in this unit is damaged by an enemy attack, you can choose one or more models in its unit to suffer any amount of that damage instead, divided as you choose. A model cannot suffer more damage as a result of Bond of Brotherhood than it has unmarked damage boxes.

grantedVengeance.name: Granted: Vengeance
grantedVengeance.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. Each model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3". After all models in the unit have moved, each model can then make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

grantedShieldWall.name: Granted: Shield Wall
grantedShieldWall.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Shield Wall. (While a model with Shield Wall is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.)

desperatePaceManOWar.name: •Desperate Pace [Man-O-War]
desperatePaceManOWar.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Man-O-War trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

grantedDualAttack.name: Granted: Dual Attack
grantedDualAttack.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dual Attack.

grantedSturdy.name: Granted: Sturdy
grantedSturdy.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit cannot be pushed.

steady.name: Steady
steady.description: This model cannot become knocked down.

ghostShield.name: Ghost Shield
ghostShield.description: This model gains +1 ARM for each soul token currently on it.

harmoniousExaltationAction.name: •Harmonious Exaltation (★Action)
harmoniousExaltationAction.description: RNG 5. Target this model’s Leader. If it is in range, once this turn when the Leader casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

spellSlaveActionOrAttack.name: •Spell Slave (★Action or ★Attack)
spellSlaveActionOrAttack.description: This model must be in its Leader’s control range to make the Spell Slave special action. When it does, it casts one of the spells on its Leader’s card with a COST of 3 or less. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL. When casting an offensive spell, Spell Slave is an arcane attack.

soulTakerRequiem.name: Soul Taker: Requiem
soulTakerRequiem.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

strengthOfDeath.name: •Strength of Death
strengthOfDeath.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

soulTap.name: Soul Tap
soulTap.description: If this model is in its Leader’s control range during your Control Phase, the Leader can spend soul tokens on this model to upkeep one spell for each token spent.

extendedControlRange.name: Extended Control Range
extendedControlRange.description: When checking to see if this model is in its controller's control range, double the range.

leadershipTitans.name: Leadership [Titans]
leadershipTitans.description: When a friendly non-Bronzeback Titan ends its activation within 5" of this model, you can remove 1 fury point from that Titan.

cleave.name: Cleave
cleave.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one additional melee attack. This model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.

grantedBulldoze.name: Granted: Bulldoze
grantedBulldoze.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Bulldoze. (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

grantedSacredWard.name: Granted: Sacred Ward
grantedSacredWard.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

setDefense.name: Set Defense
setDefense.description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

shieldGuard__819aa308.name: Shield Guard
shieldGuard__819aa308.description: When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.

arcanePrecision.name: Arcane Precision
arcanePrecision.description: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, it ignores cloud effects when determining LOS and ignores Stealth that activation.

futureSight.name: Future Sight
futureSight.description: This model can boost attack and damage rolls after rolling.

multipleHeads5.name: Multiple Heads [5]
multipleHeads5.description: This model can make 5 initial attacks each Combat Action, using any combination of Acid Spray and Bite attacks. This model loses one initial attack for each of its aspects that are currently crippled. This model cannot be forced to make additional Acid Spray attacks.

regenerationD33.name: Regeneration [d3 +3]
regenerationD33.description: This model can be forced to remove d3 +3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.

snacking.name: Snacking
snacking.description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

defensiveLine.name: Defensive Line
defensiveLine.description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 DEF and cannot become knocked down.

sideStep.name: Side Step
sideStep.description: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.

bladeShield.name: Blade Shield
bladeShield.description: This model gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls.

focusedStrike.name: Focused Strike
focusedStrike.description: When this model damages a warjack or warbeast with a melee attack, choose which column or branch suffers the damage.

sacrificialPawnWarbeastInThisModelsBattl.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Warbeast in This Model’s Battlegroup]
sacrificialPawnWarbeastInThisModelsBattl.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal warbeast in this model’s battlegroup within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

painMaddened.name: Pain Maddened
painMaddened.description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, it gains +2 SPD for one round.

bondMakeda.name: Bond [Makeda]
bondMakeda.description: If Molik Karn begins the game in Makeda’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Molik Karn is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While bonded to Makeda and in her control range, Molik Karn gains Side Step. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.)

intuition.name: Intuition
intuition.description: When an enemy model targets this model with an attack and the attack roll results in a hit, you can immediately force this model to cause the enemy model to reroll the attack roll.

beastMaster.name: Beast Master
beastMaster.description: This model can force friendly Faction warbeasts within 6" of it as if it were their battlegroup controller.

fleshHardeningAction.name: •Flesh-Hardening (★ Action)
fleshHardeningAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction living warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, continuous effects on it immediately expire and it gains Tough for one round.

influenceAttack.name: •Influence (★Attack)
influenceAttack.description: Influence is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Take control of target enemy non-Leader warrior model hit. The model immediately makes one basic attack, then Influence expires. A model can be affected by Influence only once per turn.

marionetteAttack.name: •Marionette (★Attack)
marionetteAttack.description: Marionette is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Target enemy model/unit. You can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Marionette expires. Marionette lasts for one round.

conditionAction.name: Condition (★Action)
conditionAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

enrageAction.name: Enrage (★Action)
enrageAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. Enrage lasts for one turn.

medicateD3Action.name: Medicate [d3] (★Action)
medicateD3Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

unpredictableMovement.name: Unpredictable Movement
unpredictableMovement.description: When placing unit models during their unit’s Normal Movement, after determining the advancing model’s movement place the remaining troopers in the squad within 4" of that model, not 2".

grantedUnyielding.name: Granted: Unyielding
grantedUnyielding.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

shieldWall__4297683a.name: Shield Wall
shieldWall__4297683a.description: While this model is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.

grantedRelentlessCharge.name: Granted: Relentless Charge
grantedRelentlessCharge.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Relentless Charge. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

grantedSideStep.name: Granted: Side Step
grantedSideStep.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Side Step. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.)

penetratingStrike.name: Penetrating Strike
penetratingStrike.description: When this model hits a warjack, warbeast, or horror with a melee attack, you can choose to have the model hit suffer 1 damage point instead of a damage roll.

hunter.name: Hunter
hunter.description: This model ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

prey.name: Prey
prey.description: After deployment but before the first player’s turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this model/unit’s prey. This model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.

digInAction.name: Dig In (★Action)
digInAction.description: This model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged. It can begin the game dug in.

dragBelow.name: Drag Below
dragBelow.description: During this model's activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it boxed an enemy warrior model, this model can use Drag Below. The boxed model is removed from play and this model can immediately make a full advance and then perform a Dig In special action, then its activation ends.

boundlessRage.name: Boundless Rage
boundlessRage.description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack or when this model destroys an enemy model with a basic attack this model gains a rage token. This model can have up to three rage tokens at any time. This model gains +1 to its melee attack and melee damage rolls for each rage token on it. This model can spend rage tokens for the following:

painmonger.name: •Painmonger
painmonger.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend rage tokens to remove d3+1 damage points for each token spent.

eliteCadreSmallBasedPraetorian.name: Elite Cadre [small-based Praetorian]
eliteCadreSmallBasedPraetorian.description: Friendly small-based Praetorian models gain Vengeance. (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack.)

stayDeath.name: Stay Death
stayDeath.description: When a friendly living non-Leader Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled, this model can spend 1 fury point to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model.

bondXerxis.name: Bond [Xerxis]
bondXerxis.description: If Tiberion begins the game in Xerxis’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Tiberion is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Tiberion is bonded to Xerxis and in his control range, it gains Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved it can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model with Retaliatory Strike can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

immovableObject.name: Immovable Object
immovableObject.description: This model cannot become knocked down, cannot be placed, and cannot be moved by a push, slam, or throw.

bullheaded.name: Bullheaded
bullheaded.description: When this model frenzies, if it would charge a model, it targets that model with a slam power attack instead. If it cannot, it frenzies normally.

slammer.name: Slammer
slammer.description: This model can make slam power attacks without being forced. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

jump.name: Jump
jump.description: After it makes a full advance during its Normal Movement but before it performs its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

leadershipPraetorianFerox.name: Leadership [Praetorian Ferox]
leadershipPraetorianFerox.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Praetorian Ferox models gain Dodge.

combatCoordinationVenator.name: •Combat Coordination [Venator]
combatCoordinationVenator.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Venator model. If the target model is in range, during its activation this turn, it can reroll one attack or damage roll, then Combat Coordination expires.

desperatePaceFactionWeaponCrew.name: •Desperate Pace [Faction weapon crew]
desperatePaceFactionWeaponCrew.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction weapon crew trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

grantedCombinedArms.name: Granted: Combined Arms
grantedCombinedArms.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Combined Arms. (When a model with Combined Arms misses an attack roll for a combined ranged attack, it can reroll that attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Combined Arms.)

fieldMarshal2SPD.name: Field Marshal [+2 SPD]
fieldMarshal2SPD.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD.

acidCloud.name: Acid Cloud
acidCloud.description: This model can use Acid Cloud once per activation at any time. Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Models in the template when it is placed or that enter or end their activation in the template suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

bondAiakos.name: Bond [Aiakos]
bondAiakos.description: If Kharybdis begins the game in Aiakos’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Kharybdis is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Kharybdis is bonded to Aiakos and in his control range, it gains Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

bodySnatcherHeartEater.name: Body Snatcher: Heart Eater
bodySnatcherHeartEater.description: When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

crucibleOfDeath.name: •Crucible of Death
crucibleOfDeath.description: This model can spend up to three corpse tokens at the start of its activation to gain 1 focus point for each corpse token spent.

finisher.name: Finisher
finisher.description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls against damaged models.

bodySnatcherGraveRobber5.name: Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [5"]
bodySnatcherGraveRobber5.description: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

deathIndustry.name: •Death Industry
deathIndustry.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction undead Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within 12" of this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

bladeRush.name: Blade Rush
bladeRush.description: While making a trample power attack, this model does not stop when it contacts a model with a medium or larger base, an obstacle, or an obstruction. This model makes trample attacks against models regardless of their base size. This model cannot hit models occupying buildings with its trample power attacks.

serpentsGrace.name: •Serpent’s Grace
serpentsGrace.description: RNG 5. Target friendly living Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Dodge for one round.

ashenVeil.name: Ashen Veil
ashenVeil.description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

noSleepingOnTheJobBlightedTrollkin.name: No Sleeping on the Job [Blighted Trollkin]
noSleepingOnTheJobBlightedTrollkin.description: This model and friendly Blighted Trollkin models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

overtake.name: Overtake
overtake.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".

bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst
bloodthirst.description: When it charges a living or undead model, this model gains +2" SPD.

fieldMarshalReposition3__31cc9896.name: Field Marshal [Reposition 3"]
fieldMarshalReposition3__31cc9896.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

temptationsOfFate.name: Temptations of Fate
temptationsOfFate.description: While this model is within 3" of its warcaster, the warcaster gains Sucker!. (If a model with Sucker! is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.)

acrobatics.name: Acrobatics
acrobatics.description: This model can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. This model ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.

fieldMarshalGangFighter.name: Field Marshal [Gang Fighter]
fieldMarshalGangFighter.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Gang Fighter. (When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.)

gangFighter.name: Gang Fighter
gangFighter.description: When making a melee attack damage roll against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warrior model, this model adds +2 to the roll.

eliteCadreBloodgorgers.name: Elite Cadre [Bloodgorgers]
eliteCadreBloodgorgers.description: Friendly Bloodgorgers models in this army gain Berserk

bodySnatcherGibbet.name: Body Snatcher: Gibbet
bodySnatcherGibbet.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead model is destroyed within 8" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token if it does not already have one. This model cannot have more than one corpse token at any time. This model begins the game with one corpse token.

distantDeployment9.name: Distant Deployment [9"]
distantDeployment9.description: This model can be placed at the same time as your models with Advance Deployment, up to 9" beyond your deployment zone.

gallowsFruit.name: Gallows Fruit
gallowsFruit.description: During a friendly Faction warcaster’s activation, it can remove 1 corpse token from this model if this model is in its control range. When a friendly Faction warcaster removes a corpse token from this model, the warcaster gains 1 focus point. Each warcaster can do this only once per turn.

immobile.name: Immobile
immobile.description: This model has no Normal Movement or Combat Action, cannot become knocked down or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks.

revulsion.name: Revulsion
revulsion.description: While this model has a corpse token, it gains Stealth.

sacrificialStrikeAction__22edd9b8.name: Sacrificial Strike (★Action)
sacrificialStrikeAction__22edd9b8.description: RNG 12. Target a model in this model’s LOS. If that model is in range, remove one friendly Faction trooper model within 1" of this model from play. The target model suffers an unboostable magical damage roll with POW equal to the base ARM of the removed model.

darkShroud.name: Dark Shroud
darkShroud.description: While within 2" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

gang.name: Gang
gang.description: When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, this model gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.

grantedBlessed.name: Granted: Blessed
grantedBlessed.description: While this model is in play, the weapons of models in its unit gain Blessed.

noSleepingOnTheJobSatyxis.name: No Sleeping on the Job [Satyxis]
noSleepingOnTheJobSatyxis.description: This model and friendly Satyxis models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

witchcraft.name: Witchcraft
witchcraft.description: This model can use one of the following special rules at any time during each of its unit’s activations. Each model in this unit gains the benefits listed.

redTide.name: •Red Tide
redTide.description: Affected models gain Overtake this activation. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

trueWind.name: •True Wind
trueWind.description: Affected models gain Pathfinder this activation.

whippingWinds.name: •Whipping Winds
whippingWinds.description: Affected models gain Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

hexBoltAttack.name: •Hex Bolt (★Attack)
hexBoltAttack.description: Hex Bolt is a RNG 6, POW 13 arcane attack. Models hit cannot make special actions, special attacks, or power attacks for one round.

dismantle.name: Dismantle
dismantle.description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against constructs.

repairD31Action__88ce80ed.name: Repair [d3 +1] (★ Action)
repairD31Action__88ce80ed.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

smokeCloud.name: Smoke Cloud
smokeCloud.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model when it makes a ranged attack. The template remains in play for one round.

grantedFeignDeath.name: Granted: Feign Death
grantedFeignDeath.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Feign Death. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

noQuarter.name: No Quarter
noQuarter.description: This model can use No Quarter once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Pathfinder. A model in this unit that charges as part of its Normal Movement gains +2 SPD. No Quarter lasts for one round.

quickWork.name: Quick Work
quickWork.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack.

pistoleer.name: Pistoleer
pistoleer.description: Range attack damage rolls made by this model against a model in melee with this model are boosted.

reciprocate.name: Reciprocate
reciprocate.description: When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic ranged attack targeting the attacking model.

runGun.name: Run & Gun
runGun.description: At the end of its activation, if this model destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, it can make a full advance.

reinforcementsLivingFaction.name: Reinforcements [living Faction]
reinforcementsLivingFaction.description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed living Faction Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

bloodQuenched.name: Blood-Quenched
bloodQuenched.description: This model gains a cumulative +1 ARM and +1 to its melee damage rolls for each enemy model it destroys with a melee attack during its activation. This bonus lasts for one round.

manEater.name: Man-Eater
manEater.description: This model can charge living warrior models without being forced.

rise.name: Rise
rise.description: If this model is knocked down at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it stands up.

channeler.name: Channeler
channeler.description: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it.

deathFeast.name: •Death Feast
deathFeast.description: During its activation, this model can spend corpse tokens to remove d3 damage points for each token spent.

deathPowered.name: Death-Powered
deathPowered.description: This model gains +1 ARM and +1 to its melee attack damage rolls for each corpse token currently on it.

torpid.name: Torpid
torpid.description: If this model destroys a living enemy model with a basic melee attack, it can immediately end its activation after the attack is resolved. If this model’s activation ends as a result of Torpid, you can remove 1 fury point from this model.

carapace.name: Carapace
carapace.description: This model gains +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.

bondWrongEye.name: Bond [Wrong Eye]
bondWrongEye.description: Snapjaw begins the game bonded to Wrong Eye. Snapjaw is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. When Snapjaw boxes a living model with a melee attack while bonded to Wrong Eye and in his control range, the boxed model is removed from play and Snapjaw and Wrong Eye can each remove d3 damage points.

companionWrongEye.name: Companion [Wrong Eye]
companionWrongEye.description: This model is included in any army that includes Wrong Eye. If Wrong Eye is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Wrong Eye’s battlegroup.

territorial.name: Territorial
territorial.description: This model can charge large or larger-based models without being forced.

bodySnatcherBonePile.name: Body Snatcher: Bone Pile
bodySnatcherBonePile.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When this model or a friendly Bone Shaker models destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token and the destroyed model is removed from play. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time.

sacrificialPawnBoneShaker.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Bone Shaker]
sacrificialPawnBoneShaker.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Bone Shaker within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

tideOfSkulls.name: Tide of Skulls
tideOfSkulls.description: During your Control Phase, Barnabas can spend one or more corpse tokens to put a Bone Shaker model into play. For each corpse token spent, add one Bone Shaker model. You cannot have more than three Bone Shaker models in play at any time. Place the Bone Shaker models completely within 3" of Barnabas. Bone Shaker models must forfeit their Combat Action the turn they are put into play.

deathRattleAttack.name: •Death Rattle (★Attack)
deathRattleAttack.description: Death Rattle is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When Death Rattle boxes a living or undead non-Leader enemy warrior model, you can immediately take control of the model. The boxed model immediately makes one basic attack, then it is removed from play.

mentalForce.name: Mental Force
mentalForce.description: This model can use Mental Force at the beginning of each attack. If it does, all attack and damage rolls resulting from the attack are boosted. After the attack is resolved, this model suffers d3 damage points.

shepherdsCallAction.name: •Shepherd’s Call (★Action)
shepherdsCallAction.description: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 3" of this model.

spiritNexus.name: Spirit Nexus
spiritNexus.description: This model begins the game with 1 fury point. During your Control Phase, this model receives 1 fury point if it does not have any. This model cannot have more than 1 fury point at any time. During a friendly Faction warlock’s activation, it can remove 1 fury point from this model in its control range and gain that fury point. Each warlock can do this only once per turn. When a warlock removes a fury point from this model, roll a d6. On a roll of 1 or 2, the spirits become angry and curse the warlock. A cursed warlock suffers –1 DEF and ARM for one round.

darkPower.name: Dark Power
darkPower.description: This model gains an additional die on arcane attack and arcane attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

warWeaver.name: War Weaver
warWeaver.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with an arcane attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

noSleepingOnTheJobGatorman.name: No Sleeping on the Job [Gatorman]
noSleepingOnTheJobGatorman.description: This model and friendly Gatorman models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

reposition5.name: Reposition [5"]
reposition5.description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.

bodySnatcherGraveRobber10.name: Body Snatcher: Grave Robber [10"]
bodySnatcherGraveRobber10.description: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

meatForTheBeast.name: •Meat for the Beast
meatForTheBeast.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

puppetMasterAction.name: •Puppet Master (★Action)
puppetMasterAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the target model/unit is in range, you can have one affected model reroll one attack or damage roll, then Puppet Master expires. Puppet Master lasts for one round.

seasoningTheSauceAction.name: •Seasoning the Sauce (★Action)
seasoningTheSauceAction.description: This model gains d3 corpse tokens.

spectralLashAttack.name: •Spectral Lash (★Attack)
spectralLashAttack.description: Spectral Lash is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When an enemy model is hit by this attack, it can be pushed d6" directly toward Spectral Lash’s point of origin.

specialDelivery.name: Special Delivery
specialDelivery.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove any number of corpse tokens and place them on a friendly model that can gain corpse tokens within 5" of it.

deathMagic.name: Death Magic
deathMagic.description: During its activation, this model can remove friendly Grunt models in its unit from play to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional melee attack or boost one roll for each model removed. When this model would suffer damage, you can choose one or more models in its unit to suffer any number of those damage points instead, divided as you choose. If you do, this model does not suffer that damage. A model cannot suffer more damage as a result of Death Magic than it has unmarked damage boxes.

handOfGloryAttack.name: •Hand of Glory (★ Attack)
handOfGloryAttack.description: Hand of Glory is a RNG 7 arcane attack. Target enemy model hit becomes stationary for one round.

grimReturnsAction.name: •Grim Returns (★ Action)
grimReturnsAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly trooper model. If the model is in range, return one destroyed Grunt to its unit. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target trooper model. The returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

eruptionOfFlies.name: Eruption of Flies
eruptionOfFlies.description: When this model suffers damage as a result of an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can target the attacking model with a SP 8, POW 14 ranged attack that causes corrosion damage. This attack ignores the firing into melee penalty. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

carnivorousSwarm.name: Carnivorous Swarm
carnivorousSwarm.description: When this model is disabled, center a cloud effect template on it, then remove this model from play. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Enemy models without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending their activation in the template suffer 1 point of corrosion damage

deathRideAction.name: •Death Ride (★Action)
deathRideAction.description: Friendly Faction undead models activating within 5" of this model gain +1" movement when advancing as part of their Normal Movement. Death Ride lasts for one turn.

ghostWalkAction.name: •Ghost Walk (★Action)
ghostWalkAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

sacrificialStrikeAction.name: •Sacrificial Strike (★Action)
sacrificialStrikeAction.description: RNG 12. Target a model in this model’s LOS. If that model is in range, remove one friendly Faction trooper model within 1" of this model from play. The target model suffers an unboostable magical damage roll with POW equal to the base ARM of the removed model.

fieldMarshalDeathRage.name: Field Marshal [Death Rage]
fieldMarshalDeathRage.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Death Rage. (When a model with Death Rage is disabled by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack, then the model is then destroyed. When making this attack, ignore the effects of crippled aspects on the affected warbeast.)

enlivenAction.name: •Enliven (★Action)
enlivenAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, the next time it suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the target can make a full advance, then Enliven expires. Enliven lasts for one round.

healD3Action.name: •Heal [d3] (★Action)
healD3Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

mudFootAttack.name: •Mud Foot (★Attack)
mudFootAttack.description: Mud Foot is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model/unit hit loses Pathfinder and treats open terrain as rough terrain. Mud Foot lasts for one round.

venomAttack.name: •Venom (★Attack)
venomAttack.description: Venom is a RNG SP 10, POW 10 arcane attack that causes corrosion damage. Models hit suffer the Corrosion continuous effect.

shareTheLoad.name: Share the Load
shareTheLoad.description: Once per turn, when this model makes a Magic Ability special attack or special action, immediately after the attack or action is resolved it can make one additional Magic Ability special attack or special action.

headShot.name: Head Shot
headShot.description: Models disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. Models destroyed by a ranged attack made by this model are removed from play.

fieldMarshalUndead.name: Field Marshal [Undead]
fieldMarshalUndead.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Undead.

soulTakerSpiritEater.name: Soul Taker: Spirit Eater
soulTakerSpiritEater.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After leeching during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 fury point.

soulstorm.name: Soulstorm
soulstorm.description: While this model has one or more soul tokens, enemy models entering or ending their activations within 2" of it immediately suffer 1 point of magical damage.

soulTakerCryptOfSouls.name: Soul Taker: Crypt of Souls
soulTakerCryptOfSouls.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. At the start of each of your Control Phases, this model receives d3 soul tokens if it does not have any. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

spectralVortex.name: •Spectral Vortex
spectralVortex.description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 soul token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

strengthOfDeath__05e22232.name: •Strength of Death
strengthOfDeath__05e22232.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

telemetry.name: Telemetry
telemetry.description: Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.

stewsOn.name: Stew’s On
stewsOn.description: While within 3" of this model, friendly warrior models gain Comfort Food. (If a model with Comfort Food is within 1" of a friendly Faction warbeast at the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching you can remove the model with Comfort Food from play to remove any number of fury points from the warbeast.)

arcaneConsumption.name: Arcane Consumption
arcaneConsumption.description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while within 10" of this model, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points and this model can remove d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

spellWard__692ef090.name: Spell Ward
spellWard__692ef090.description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

attunedSpirit.name: Attuned Spirit
attunedSpirit.description: Once per activation, this model can cast the animus of a warbeast in its battlegroup without spending fury.

mageStatic.name: Mage Static
mageStatic.description: Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of this model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.

wastingPower.name: Wasting Power
wastingPower.description: This model can use Wasting Power at any time during its activation. When it does, animi and upkeep spells on models within 8" of this model immediately expire, then this model is removed from play.

autoRepair.name: Auto-Repair
autoRepair.description: During your Control Phase, remove d3 damage points from this model.

flyingHigh.name: Flying High
flyingHigh.description: Ranged attacks targeting this model suffer –3 RNG. Friendly models can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past its base. This model loses Flying High if it loses Flight.

propelled.name: Propelled
propelled.description: This model cannot aim, charge, or become knocked down.

shootingGallery.name: Shooting Gallery
shootingGallery.description: This model gains +2 to ranged attack rolls against models within 5" of it.

swiftHunter.name: Swift Hunter
swiftHunter.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".

inhumanResolve.name: Inhuman Resolve
inhumanResolve.description: When a friendly warrior model within 10" of this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can remove 1 damage point. When this model is disabled, it becomes knocked down instead of becoming boxed and its activation immediately ends. While this model is disabled, it cannot activate. If this model is disabled at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it is destroyed.

forceBarrier.name: Force Barrier
forceBarrier.description: This model gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.

shoutItOutAction.name: Shout it Out (★ Action)
shoutItOutAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

pathOfFlames__d7880d6d.name: Path of Flames
pathOfFlames__d7880d6d.description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement to use Path of Flames. If it does, place this model anywhere completely within 8" of its current location. Other models within 2" of this model after it is placed immediately suffer a POW 13 fire damage roll.

hyperRegeneration.name: Hyper-Regeneration
hyperRegeneration.description: Remove d3 damage points from this model at the start of each of its activations.

itBurns.name: It Burns!
itBurns.description: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers the Fire continuous unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

destructivePower.name: Destructive Power
