destructivePower.description: During its activation, this model can suffer 1 damage point to boost an attack or damage roll. This damage is suffered immediately after the attack is resolved.

regenerationD3.name: Regeneration [d3]
regenerationD3.description: This model can be forced to remove d3 damage points once per activation. This model cannot use Regeneration during an activation it runs.

exigent.name: Exigent
exigent.description: Enemy models engaged by a model with Exigent suffer –2 to attack rolls when attacking models without Exigent.

plasmaNimbus.name: Plasma Nimbus
plasmaNimbus.description: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to have the attacking model suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

spyglassAction__9ac35610.name: Spyglass (★ Action)
spyglassAction__9ac35610.description: Target an enemy model in this model’s LOS. That model loses Stealth for one round.

annoyance.name: Annoyance
annoyance.description: Living enemy models within 1" of this model suffer –1 to attack rolls.

standYourGround.name: •Stand Your Ground
standYourGround.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Set Defense for one round. (Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against a model with Set Defense.)

stirTheBlood.name: •Stir the Blood
stirTheBlood.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, each affected model gains +2 to its next melee attack damage roll this turn.

fieldMarshalShieldGuard.name: Field Marshal [Shield Guard]
fieldMarshalShieldGuard.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

fortuneHunter.name: Fortune Hunter
fortuneHunter.description: This model gains an additional die on its attack and damage rolls against character models.

fieldMarshalRunicAmmunition.name: Field Marshal [Runic Ammunition]
fieldMarshalRunicAmmunition.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Runic Ammunition. (Once per activation, immediately after resolving a ranged attack in which it destroyed an enemy model, this model can use its animus without being forced.)

birdsEye.name: Birds Eye
birdsEye.description: While in this model’s control range, models in its battlegroup can ignore cloud effects, forest terrain, and intervening models when determining LOS.

darkRituals__c58cd6b0.name: Dark Rituals
darkRituals__c58cd6b0.description: This model can channel spells through friendly Faction warrior models in its control range. Immediately after a spell is channeled through a model as a result of Dark Rituals, the model it was channeled through suffers d3 points of magical damage.

eliteCadreBrinebloodMarauderWarrior.name: Elite Cadre [Brineblood Marauder Warrior]
eliteCadreBrinebloodMarauderWarrior.description: Friendly non-Leader Faction warrior models gain Undead.

reposition2.name: Reposition [2"]
reposition2.description: At the end of this model/unit’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, this model can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.

stumblingDrunk.name: Stumbling Drunk
stumblingDrunk.description: This model cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved a model with Stumbling Drunk is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.

foulStench.name: Foul Stench
foulStench.description: While within 5" of this model, living enemy warbeasts suffer –1 FURY and THR.

monkeyBite.name: Monkey Bite
monkeyBite.description: While in melee with this model, living enemy models suffer –2 to melee attack rolls.

openBar.name: Open Bar
openBar.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly living Faction models with a large or smaller base gain Stumbling Drunk.

fightOrFlightInstinct.name: Fight-or-Flight Instinct
fightOrFlightInstinct.description: This model can run or charge without being forced.

cursed.name: Cursed
cursed.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models suffer –1 ARM.

leadershipFriendlyFaction.name: Leadership [Friendly Faction]
leadershipFriendlyFaction.description: When another model within 8" of this model casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +2 RNG.

distantDeployment12.name: Distant Deployment [12"]
distantDeployment12.description: This model can be placed at the same time as your models with Advance Deployment, up to 12" beyond your deployment zone.

inconsequential.name: Inconsequential
inconsequential.description: This model can not score or contest Objectives, Scenario terrain, or Caches.

riposte.name: Riposte
riposte.description: When it is missed by an enemy melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic melee attack against the attacking model.

veteranLeaderMarauderCrew.name: Veteran Leader [Marauder Crew]
veteranLeaderMarauderCrew.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Marauder Crew models gain +1 to attack rolls.

toadLicker.name: Toad Licker
toadLicker.description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following toad effects. Toad effects last for one round.

deathCrazed.name: •Death Crazed
deathCrazed.description: This model gains Berserk and Last Word. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.)

bloodSweats.name: •Blood Sweats
bloodSweats.description: This model gains +2 ARM. If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

psychonaut.name: •Psychonaut
psychonaut.description: This model gains Eyeless Sight and Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved a model with Stumbling Drunk is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

sanguineBond.name: Sanguine Bond
sanguineBond.description: When this model would suffer damage from an enemy attack, you can choose one or more models in its unit to suffer any amount of that damage instead, divided as you choose. If you do, this model does not suffer that damage. A model cannot suffer more damage as a result of Sanguine Bond than it has unmarked damage boxes.

setDefense__3b2bf550.name: Set Defense
setDefense__3b2bf550.description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

unbreakableWall.name: Unbreakable Wall
unbreakableWall.description: This model gains a cumulative +3 ARM for each other model in this unit it is currently B2B with. Additionally, while B2B with another model in its unit, this model cannot become knocked down, cannot be placed outside Normal Movement, and cannot be moved by a push, slam, or throw.

powderStores.name: Powder Stores
powderStores.description: This model can use Powder Stores once per game at anytime during its unit’s activation. That activation, other models in this unit gain +2 to their ranged attack damage rolls.

grantedStumblingDrunk.name: Granted: Stumbling Drunk
grantedStumblingDrunk.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved a model with Stumbling Drunk is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

lastCall.name: Last Call
lastCall.description: This model can use Last Call once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

magicAbility__0cffaca0.name: Magic Ability
magicAbility__0cffaca0.description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

soulWard.name: Soul Ward
soulWard.description: Enemy models cannot gain soul tokens from friendly models destroyed within 6" of this model.

ancillaryAttackAction.name: •Ancillary Attack (★ Action)
ancillaryAttackAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction warjack/warbeast. If the target is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by an Ancillary Attack special action only once per turn.

cleansingFireAttack.name: •Cleansing Fire (★Attack)
cleansingFireAttack.description: Cleansing Fire is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 14/8 arcane attack that causes fire damage. On a critical hit, models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

monsterHunter.name: Monster Hunter
monsterHunter.description: When this model hits a warbeast with an attack, the warbeast suffers d3 + 3 points of damage to the branch of your choice.

ironSentinel.name: Iron Sentinel
ironSentinel.description: While B2B with a friendly Faction Cohort model, this model gains +2 DEF and ARM and cannot become knocked down.

clear.name: Clear!
clear.description: This model’s ranged attacks against friendly models automatically miss.

roadblock.name: Roadblock
roadblock.description: This model provides cover to friendly models as if it were an obstacle. This model loses Roadblock while it is incorporeal or knocked down

holdOnLads.name: Hold On Lads!
holdOnLads.description: Once per turn, when this model begins an advance, you can choose a non-Leader friendly Faction warrior model with 1" of it. When this model ends that advance, the chosen model can be pushed up to 3" directly towards it.

skyLadder.name: Sky Ladder
skyLadder.description: When this model ends its Normal Movement, choose one small or medium-based friendly solo model within 2" of it. You can place the chosen model completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed as a result of Sky Ladder only once per turn.

airborneReconnaissance.name: Airborne Reconnaissance
airborneReconnaissance.description: While within 8" of this model, friendly Faction models ignore cloud effects when targeting enemy models.

grantedProwl.name: Granted: Prowl
grantedProwl.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

lash.name: Lash
lash.description: This model and friendly warrior models B2B with it cannot become knocked down.

duelist.name: Duelist
duelist.description: This model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.

blackWatersAction.name: •Black Waters (★Action)
blackWatersAction.description: While within 3" of this model, models treat open terrain as shallow water and gain Resistance Fire. Black Waters lasts for one round.

mageStatic__31cc019c.name: Mage Static
mageStatic__31cc019c.description: Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of this model suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.

sigilOfPowerAction.name: •Sigil of Power (★ Action)
sigilOfPowerAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

albatross.name: Albatross
albatross.description: If this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, for the rest of this turn enemy models suffer –1 to their attack and damage rolls.

fieryBlast.name: Fiery Blast
fieryBlast.description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 14 blast fire damage roll.

grimReturnsAction__e97a8dff.name: Grim Returns (★ Action)
grimReturnsAction__e97a8dff.description: RNG 5. Target friendly trooper model. If the model is in range, return one destroyed Grunt to its unit. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target trooper model. Returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

healD31Action.name: Heal [d3+1] (★ Action)
healD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

walkItOff.name: •Walk It Off
walkItOff.description: RNG 10. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, continuous effects, knockdown, and stationary on the affected models immediately expire.

paralyzingGaze.name: Paralyzing Gaze
paralyzingGaze.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models with LOS to this model suffer –2 DEF.

vault.name: Vault
vault.description: Once per activation, after making a full advance as its Normal Movement but before performing its Combat Action, this model can be forced to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

fuelForTheFlames5.name: Fuel for the Flames [5"]
fuelForTheFlames5.description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Fire suffers a fire damage roll while within 5" of this model, add an additional die to the damage roll

fieldMarshalFuelForTheFlames.name: Field Marshal [Fuel for the Flames]
fieldMarshalFuelForTheFlames.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Fuel for the Flames [5"].

deathHowler.name: •Death Howler
deathHowler.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one corpse token to gain Mortal Fear. Death Howler lasts for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Mortal Fear, living enemy models suffer –2 to damage rolls.)

shadowGate.name: •Shadow Gate
shadowGate.description: Once per turn during its activation immediately after resolving an attack in which it hit an enemy model with a melee attack, this model can spend 1 corpse or soul token to be placed completely within 2" of its current location.

divineManifestation.name: Divine Manifestation
divineManifestation.description: This model is not a living model, cannot become knocked down, and never suffers Blind. Opponents cannot take control of this model.

blindingRadiance.name: Blinding Radiance
blindingRadiance.description: While within 3" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls.

divineInspiration.name: Divine Inspiration
divineInspiration.description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.

veteranLeaderMorrowan.name: Veteran Leader [Morrowan]
veteranLeaderMorrowan.description: While within 10" of this model, other Morrowan models gain +1 to attack rolls.

righteousFury.name: Righteous Fury
righteousFury.description: When one or more friendly Faction warrior models are destroyed by an enemy attack while within 10" of this model, this model gains +2 ARM and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round.

righteousVengeance.name: Righteous Vengeance
righteousVengeance.description: If one or more friendly Faction warrior models were destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of this model during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase this model  can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

belovedOfThamar.name: Beloved of Thamar
belovedOfThamar.description: When a friendly Thamarite model within 10" of this model misses an attack roll, it can reroll that attack roll. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Beloved of Thamar.

trueSight.name: True Sight
trueSight.description: This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth.

entropicForce__d5706932.name: Entropic Force
entropicForce__d5706932.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.

soulTakerSpectralScavenger.name: Soul Taker: Spectral Scavenger
soulTakerSpectralScavenger.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed in this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

soulPhase__eb1eecb3.name: •Soul Phase
soulPhase__eb1eecb3.description: This model can spend a soul token at any time during its activation to gain Incorporeal for one turn.

voidWalk.name: Void Walk
voidWalk.description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed a living or undead enemy model with an attack during its Combat Action, you can place this model anywhere completely within 8" of its current location.

mothersEmbrace.name: Mother’s Embrace
mothersEmbrace.description: When a friendly model is destroyed by an enemy attack while within 10" of this model, after the attack is resolved you can remove d3 damage points from a friendly model.

shepherdsCallAction__7fedad84.name: Shepherd’s Call (★Action)
shepherdsCallAction__7fedad84.description:
Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 3" of this
model.

threadsOfLife.name: Threads of Life
threadsOfLife.description: Once per turn, when another friendly living non-Leader Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is hit by an attack, this model can suffer d3 damage points to use Threads of Life. If it does so, the friendly model does not suffer a damage roll from the attack.

elementalMastery.name: Elemental Mastery
elementalMastery.description: Construct warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup beginning their activations in this model’s control range can charge and make power attacks without being forced. This model can heal friendly construct warbeasts in its battlegroup.

forestWalk.name: Forest Walk
forestWalk.description: While completely within a forest, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement to use Forest Walk. If it does, choose a location completely within this model’s control range that is completely within a forest. Remove this model from the forest and place it in the chosen location. This model cannot use Forest Walk while knocked down.

devourersDebt.name: Devourer’s Debt
devourersDebt.description: During your Control Phase, place one Wurm token on this model. This model gains +1 to melee attack damages for each Wurm token on it. At the end of each of this model’s activations, it suffers 1 damage point for each Wurm token on it. This damage cannot be transferred.

ritualOfRenewalAction.name: Ritual of Renewal (★Action)
ritualOfRenewalAction.description: Remove all Wurm tokens from this model.

earthsPowerAction.name: •Earth’s Power (★Action)
earthsPowerAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction construct warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee damage rolls this turn.

repairD6Action__1786ea7d.name: •Repair [d6] (★Action)
repairD6Action__1786ea7d.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

stoneSprayAttack.name: •Stone Spray (★Attack)
stoneSprayAttack.description: Stone Spray is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

phaseJumpAction.name: •Phase Jump (★ Action)
phaseJumpAction.description: If it is within 2" of a friendly Shifting Stone model, place this model anywhere completely within 12" of its current location. Otherwise, place it completely within 2" of a friendly Shifting Stone model anywhere on the table. After using Phase Jump, this model’s activation ends.

huntersMarkAttack.name: •Hunter’s Mark (★Attack)
huntersMarkAttack.description:
Hunter’s Mark is a RNG 10 arcane attack that causes no damage.
Friendly models can charge or make a slam power attack against target enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark without being forced or spending focus. A friendly model charging or power attack slamming an enemy model hit by Hunter’s Mark gains +2 SPD while resolving the charge or slam. Hunter’s Mark lasts for one turn.

killingSpree.name: Killing Spree
killingSpree.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, after that attack is resolved this model can advance up to 1" and make one additional melee attack.

leadershipBloodweavers.name: Leadership [Bloodweavers]
leadershipBloodweavers.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Bloodweavers models gain Killing Spree.

earthMagic.name: Earth Magic
earthMagic.description: When a construct warbeast in this model’s battlegroup is forced to use its animus while in this model’s control range, reduce the COST of the animus by 1.

stonebinder.name: Stonebinder
stonebinder.description: Only construct warbeasts can be part of this model’s battlegroup. This model cannot take control of wild living warbeasts.

controlledWarping.name: Controlled Warping
controlledWarping.description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following warp effects. Warp effects last for one round. If this model frenzies it must choose Warp Strength at the start of its activation.

ghostly__f3414119.name: •Ghostly
ghostly__f3414119.description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

spellWard.name: •Spell Ward
spellWard.description: This model cannot be targeted by spells.

warpStrength.name: •Warp Strength
warpStrength.description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls.

bondMorvahna.name: Bond [Morvahna]
bondMorvahna.description: If Brennos begins the game in Morvahna’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Brennos is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Brennos is bonded to Morvahna and in her control range, she can channel spells through him.

purifyingPrayerAction.name: •Purifying Prayer (★Action)
purifyingPrayerAction.description: Animi and continuous effects on models/units within 6" of this model immediately expire.

earthSpikesAttack.name: •Earth Spikes (★Attack)
earthSpikesAttack.description: Earth Spikes is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 13/7 arcane attack. When making this attack, ignore cover and concealment. On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

ritesOfSpringAction__e2cb9a87.name: Rites of Spring (★Action)
ritesOfSpringAction__e2cb9a87.description: Remove d3 damage points from each friendly living Faction model currently within 6" of this model.

grantedPrey.name: Granted: Prey
grantedPrey.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Prey. (After deployment but before the first player’s turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this unit’s prey. A model with Prey gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.)

bloodRage.name: •Blood Rage
bloodRage.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend corpse tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

grantedTreewalker.name: Granted: Treewalker
grantedTreewalker.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Treewalker. (A model with Treewalker ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, a model with Treewalker gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.)

rapidHealing.name: Rapid Healing
rapidHealing.description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.

channelerWurmwoodTreeOfFate.name: Channeler [Wurmwood, Tree of Fate]
channelerWurmwoodTreeOfFate.description: While this model is in Wurmwood, Tree of Fate’s control range, Wurmwood can channel spells through it.

furyBound.name: Fury-Bound
furyBound.description: While in Wurmwood’s control range, this model can spend fury points on Wurmwood to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each fury point spent.

companionWurmwoodTreeOfFate.name: Companion [Wurmwood, Tree of Fate]
companionWurmwoodTreeOfFate.description: This model is included in any army that includes Wurmwood, Tree of Fate. If Wurmwood is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Wurmwood’s battlegroup. This model is also attached to Wurmwood. Each Leader can have only one model/unit attached to it.

furyBank.name: Fury Bank
furyBank.description: While this model is in a friendly Faction warlock’s control range during the warlock’s activation, the warlock can move fury points from itself to this model at any time. This model can have up to 3 fury points at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend fury points to boost one attack or damage roll for each fury point spent.

powerOfTheStones.name: Power of the Stones
powerOfTheStones.description: During your Control Phase, this model can leech fury from friendly Faction construct warbeasts within 10" of it.

craftTalismanAction__b5cd4849.name: •Craft Talisman (★ Action)
craftTalismanAction__b5cd4849.description: RNG 5. Target a friendly Leader model. If the Leader is in range, when it casts a spell and is the point of origin, the spell gains +2 RNG. Spells with RNG SELF or CTRL are not affected. Craft Talisman lasts for one turn.

cannibalMagic.name: Cannibal Magic
cannibalMagic.description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it can spend a corpse token to suffer 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

chainLightningAttack.name: •Chain Lightning (★ Attack)
chainLightningAttack.description: Chain Lightning is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit by Chain Lightning suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll, and lightning arcs from that model to d3 consecutive additional models. The lightning arcs to the nearest model it has not already arced to within 3" of the last model it arced to, ignoring this model. Each model the lightning arcs to suffers a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Chain Lightning damage rolls are simultaneous.

obscuringMistAction.name: •Obscuring Mist (★ Action)
obscuringMistAction.description: Models in this unit gain concealment for one round.

divineRetribution.name: Divine Retribution
divineRetribution.description: This model can use Divine Retribution once per game at any time during its unit's activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Divine Inspiration. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

grantedElementalPower.name: Granted: Elemental Power
grantedElementalPower.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Resistance: Cold, Resistance: Corrosion, Resistance: Electricity, and Resistance: Fire.

digInAction__bd3f74e8.name: •Dig In (★Action)
digInAction__bd3f74e8.description: This model gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged. It can begin the game dug in.

gripOfShadowsAction.name: •Grip of Shadows (★Action)
gripOfShadowsAction.description: This model gains Telemetry for one round. (Other friendly models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of this model.)

windStrikeAttack.name: •Wind Strike (★Attack)
windStrikeAttack.description: Wind Strike is a RNG 10, POW 10 arcane attack. An enemy model hit by this attack can be pushed d3" directly away from this model.

grantedBattleWizard.name: Granted: Battle Wizard
grantedBattleWizard.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Battle Wizard. (Once per turn, when a model with Battle Wizard destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.)

medicateD31Action.name: Medicate [d3+1] (★Action)
medicateD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove d3 +1 damage points from it.

strangeGrowth.name: Strange Growth
strangeGrowth.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

serenity.name: Serenity
serenity.description: At the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching, you can remove 1 fury point from a friendly Faction warbeast within 1" of this model.

bondKromac.name: Bond [Kromac]
bondKromac.description: If Ghetorix begins the game in Kromac’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ghetorix is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Kromac and in his control range, Ghetorix gains Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

murderous__ce6e6c0c.name: •Murderous
murderous__ce6e6c0c.description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack rolls against warrior models.

snacking__d55018f2.name: •Snacking
snacking__d55018f2.description: When this model boxes a living model with a melee attack, it can choose to remove the boxed model from play. When it does, this model can remove d3 damage points.

painResponse.name: Pain Response
painResponse.description: While damaged, this model can charge and make power attacks without being forced.

leadershipWolfSworn.name: Leadership [Wolf Sworn]
leadershipWolfSworn.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Wolf Sworn models gain Prowl and Side Step.

leadershipTharn.name: Leadership [Tharn]
leadershipTharn.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Tharn models gain Dodge.

bloodRitualAction.name: •Blood Ritual (★Action)
bloodRitualAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove it from play. If target model was removed from play, then choose one friendly Faction warrior model within 5" of this model. That model either gains Divine Inspiration for one turn or d3 corpse tokens. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

flankFriendlyFactionCohortModel.name: Flank [friendly Faction Cohort model]
flankFriendlyFactionCohortModel.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction Cohort model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

unyielding__f1431fc4.name: Unyielding
unyielding__f1431fc4.description: This model gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.

bondKayaTheMoonhunter.name: Bond [Kaya the Moonhunter]
bondKayaTheMoonhunter.description: Laris begins the game bonded to Kaya the Moonhunter. Laris is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Laris is bonded to Kaya and in her control range, she can channel spells through him.

ferocity.name: Ferocity
ferocity.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD when making a charge.

alteredStates.name: Altered States
alteredStates.description: At the start of your Maintenance Phase, choose a form for this model to take: Tharn Form or Beast Form. If it changes form, replace the model in play with its alternate form. Effects on the replaced model are applied to the alternate form. When one form replaces another, the new form is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering. You choose which form this model starts the game in.

beastMind.name: Beast Mind
beastMind.description: This model cannot upkeep spells or cast non-animus spells.

thunderingHeavens.name: •Thundering Heavens
thunderingHeavens.description: This model gains Ionization [10"] for one turn. (When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 10" of this model, add +2 to the roll.)

bleedPower.name: Bleed Power
bleedPower.description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, it gains 1 fury point for each friendly Faction construct Cohort model it is control range. This model cannot exceed its ARC in fury points as a result of Bleed Power.

geomancy.name: Geomancy
geomancy.description: Once per activation while in its controller’s control range, this model can be forced to cast one of the spells on its controller’s card with a COST of 3 or less. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL.

mend.name: Mend
mend.description: During your Control Phase, remove 1 damage point from this model.

firesFury.name: Fire’s Fury
firesFury.description: This model gains +5 ARM against fire damage. While suffering the Fire continuous effect, this model cannot become knocked down and gains boosted attack and damage rolls.

witchHunter.name: Witch Hunter
witchHunter.description: When an enemy model declares it is casting a spell while within 10" of this model, this model can immediately make a basic attack targeting the enemy spellcaster. If the spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

stormMatrix.name: Storm Matrix
stormMatrix.description: While in this model’s control range, friendly models’ arcane and ranged attacks that cause electrical damage gain +2 RNG.

bondTanith.name: Bond [Tanith]
bondTanith.description: If Loki begins the game in Tanith’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Loki is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Loki is bonded to Tanith and in her control range, he gains Unstoppable.

hunter__b8f5eb87.name: •Hunter
hunter__b8f5eb87.description: This model ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

bondBaldur.name: Bond [Baldur]
bondBaldur.description: If Megalith begins the game in Baldur’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Megalith is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. If Megalith is bonded to Baldur and in his control range at the start of Baldur’s activation, Baldur can remove d3 damage points.

maltreatment.name: Maltreatment
maltreatment.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove 1 fury point from a warbeast in its battlegroup that is in its control range and add 1 fury point to its own current total. The warbeast suffers d3 damage points.

sacrificialPawnFactionWarrior.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Faction warrior]
sacrificialPawnFactionWarrior.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Faction warrior model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

vitalMagic.name: Vital Magic
vitalMagic.description: When a spell or special rule would cause one or more of this model’s upkeep spells to expire, this model can keep one or more of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points for each spell kept in play.

imperishableConviction.name: Imperishable Conviction
imperishableConviction.description: When a friendly Faction model in its control range is destroyed by an enemy attack, this model can remove 1 damage point.

scalesOfFate.name: Scales of Fate
scalesOfFate.description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack or damage roll during its activation while in this model’s control range, this model can suffer d3 damage points to cause that model to reroll that roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Scales of Fate. This damage cannot be transferred.

huntersReckoning.name: Hunter’s Reckoning
huntersReckoning.description: This model can use Hunter’s Reckoning once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. When it does, choose a new enemy model/unit to be this model/unit’s prey. The previously chosen model/unit is no longer this unit’s prey.

realityAnchor.name: Reality Anchor
realityAnchor.description: Enemy models cannot be summoned within 10" of this model.

roilingEarth.name: Roiling Earth
roilingEarth.description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 3" of this model, the enemy model suffers Shadow Bind for one round. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

leadershipReevesOfOrboros.name: Leadership [Reeves of Orboros]
leadershipReevesOfOrboros.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Reeves of Orboros models gain Hunter.

sniper__674f30ed.name: Sniper
sniper__674f30ed.description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

goToGround.name: Go to Ground
goToGround.description: This model can use Go to Ground once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. For one round, models in this unit gain cover and Resistance: Blast and do not block LOS.

tracker.name: Tracker
tracker.description: This model ignores forests when determining LOS when declaring a charge.

forestGrowth.name: Forest Growth
forestGrowth.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend 1 fury point to use Forest Growth. When it does, center a 3" template on this model. The template is a forest terrain that remains in play for one round.

naturalSummons.name: Natural Summons
naturalSummons.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend 1 fury point to use Natural Summons if there are fewer than three friendly Mannikin solos in play for each friendly Sentry Stone model in play. When it does, place a Mannikin solo in play within 3" of this model. A Mannikin solo must forfiet its Combat Action the turn it is put in play.

wellspring.name: Wellspring
wellspring.description: If there are fewer than 3 fury points on the Sentry Stone during your Maintenance Phase, place d3 fury points on it. This model can have up to three fury points at any time.

furyLinked.name: Fury-Linked
furyLinked.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend fury points on a friendly Sentry Stone within 10" of it to boost an attack or damage roll.

shiftingPowers.name: Shifting Powers
shiftingPowers.description: Choose one of the following effects at the start of this unit’s activation:

healingField.name: •Healing Field
healingField.description: Remove d3 damage points from the models in this unit and from other friendly Faction models within 2" of one or more models in this unit. Roll separately for each model.

shifting.name: •Shifting
shifting.description: Place one model in this unit anywhere completely within 8" of its current location. Then place the other models in this unit 2" of it.

teleportation.name: •Teleportation
teleportation.description: If all three Shifting Stone models in this unit are in play, place one friendly Faction model whose base is within the triangular area between them anywhere completely within 8" of its current location. The placed model must forfeit its Normal Movement after being placed this turn. A model can be placed only once per turn as a result of Teleportation.

primalRage.name: Primal Rage
primalRage.description: Once per turn, when this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance toward the attacking model and can make one basic melee attack.

freakOut.name: Freak Out
freakOut.description: While damaged this model gains +3 MAT and +3 to its melee attack damage rolls.

naturesSecretsAction.name: •Nature’s Secrets (★Action)
naturesSecretsAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction construct model/unit. If the target model/unit is in range, it gains Prowl for one round.

blackclad.name: Blackclad
blackclad.description: This model is a Blackclad model.

concentratedFireAction.name: •Concentrated Fire (★ Action)
concentratedFireAction.description: This activation, models in this unit gain a +1 cumulative bonus to ranged damage rolls for each other model in this unit that has hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this activation.

zephyrAction.name: •Zephyr (★ Action)
zephyrAction.description: Each model in this unit can immediately advance up to 3".

selfSacrifice.name: Self-Sacrifice
selfSacrifice.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in this unit within 3" of this model to be destroyed and this model removes 1 damage point.

lightningRod.name: Lightning Rod
lightningRod.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Electricity.

fieldMarshalProwl.name: Field Marshal [Prowl]
fieldMarshalProwl.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Prowl.

grantedDivineInspiration.name: Granted: Divine Inspiration
grantedDivineInspiration.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Divine Inspiration. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

massCarnage.name: Mass Carnage
massCarnage.description: This model can use Mass Carnage once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

huntersGraceAction.name: •Hunter’s Grace (★ Action)
huntersGraceAction.description: Friendly Tharn models cannot become knocked down while within 5" of this model. Hunter’s Grace lasts for one round.

skyShakerAction.name: •Sky Shaker (★Action)
skyShakerAction.description: This model gains Warping Winds for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Warping Winds, the attack suffers –3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)

leadershipWolfRiders.name: Leadership [Wolf Riders]
leadershipWolfRiders.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Wolf Riders models gain Prowl.

unpredictableMovement__c6fa3aa2.name: Unpredictable Movement
unpredictableMovement__c6fa3aa2.description: When placing unit models during their unit’s Normal Movement, after determining the advancing model’s movement place the remaining troopers in the squad within 4" of that model, not 2".

birdsOfPrey.name: Birds of Prey
birdsOfPrey.description: While in Una’s control range, Griffon warbeasts in her battlegroup gain Flank [another Griffon in Una’s battlegroup]. (When a model with Flank [another Griffon in Una’s battlegroup] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another Griffon in Una’s battlegroup, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

fieldMarshalSprint.name: Field Marshal [Sprint]
fieldMarshalSprint.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

sicEm.name: Sic ’Em
sicEm.description: Once per turn if this model is not engaged, when a friendly model hits an enemy model with a melee or ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can charge the model hit. This model’s charge attack roll is boosted.

grantedCleave.name: Granted: Cleave
grantedCleave.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Cleave. (When a model with Cleave destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved the model can make one additional melee attack. A model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave per activation.)

grantedGang.name: Granted: Gang
grantedGang.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Gang. (When making a melee attack targeting an enemy model in the melee range of another model in this unit, a model with Gang gains +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls.)

berserk.name: •Berserk
berserk.description: When this model destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.

prowl__dd1b3a62.name: •Prowl
prowl__dd1b3a62.description: While this model has concealment, it gains Stealth.

forwardDeployment.name: Forward Deployment
forwardDeployment.description: This model can be deployed up to 8" beyond your deployment zone.

wakenTheStones.name: Waken the Stones
wakenTheStones.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction construct warbeasts gain Hyper-Aggressive. (When a model with Hyper-Aggressive suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.)

reinforcementsSmallBased.name: Reinforcements [Small-based]
reinforcementsSmallBased.description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed small-based Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

flankWolfSworn.name: Flank [Wolf Sworn ]
flankWolfSworn.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Wolf Sworn model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

prey__a78adfb2.name: Prey
prey__a78adfb2.description: After deployment but before the first player’s turn, choose an enemy model/unit to be this model/unit’s prey. This model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit to be the prey.

soulTakerAltarOfSacrifice.name: Soul Taker: Altar of Sacrifice
soulTakerAltarOfSacrifice.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed in this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. After this model leeches during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 fury point.

flankLug.name: Flank [Lug]
flankLug.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of Lug, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

limitedBattlegroupLug.name: Limited Battlegroup [Lug]
limitedBattlegroupLug.description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Lug.

companionBrunCragback.name: Companion [Brun Cragback]
companionBrunCragback.description: This model is included in any army that includes Brun Cragback. If Cragback is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Cragback’s battlegroup.

returnCragback.name: Return [Cragback]
returnCragback.description: Immediately after resolving a charge attack, this model can make a full advance toward Cragback.

grantedHunter.name: Granted: Hunter
grantedHunter.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit ignore concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.

charmer.name: Charmer
charmer.description: When a friendly warbeast would frenzy in this model’s control range, instead of frenzying the warbeast can forfeit its activation.

limitedBattlegroupSkarath.name: Limited Battlegroup [Skarath]
limitedBattlegroupSkarath.description: The only warbeast that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Skarath.

bondDahliaHallyr.name: Bond [Dahlia Hallyr]
bondDahliaHallyr.description: Skarath begins the game in Dahlia Hallyr’s battlegroup and is bonded to her. Skarath is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. If Skarath is bonded to Dahlia and in her control range, Skarath gains an additional die on attack rolls against models in Hallyr’s control range.

boosterShotAction.name: Booster Shot (★ Action)
boosterShotAction.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction warbeast model. If the warbeast is in range, it suffers 1 damage point and all attack and damage rolls resulting from its next basic attack this turn are boosted.

fieldMarshalChanneler.name: Field Marshal [Channeler]
fieldMarshalChanneler.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Channeler. (While a model with Channeler is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it.)

arcaneVoid.name: Arcane Void
arcaneVoid.description: When a model is targeted by an enemy spell within 5" of this model, the enemy spellcaster immediately suffers d3 damage points. If the enemy spellcaster is destroyed as a result of this damage, the spell does not take effect.

gateWalker.name: Gate Walker
gateWalker.description: Once per activation, immediately after this model casts a spell, you can place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

bleedAttack.name: •Bleed (★Attack)
bleedAttack.description: Bleed is a RNG 8, POW 10 arcane attack. When Bleed damages a living enemy model, this model can remove d3 damage points.

unbindingAction.name: •Unbinding (★Action)
unbindingAction.description: Enemy upkeep spells on models/units within 5" of this model expire. For each upkeep spell that expires as a result of Unbinding, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

markedSoul.name: Marked Soul
markedSoul.description: This model is a Marked Soul.

arcanePulse.name: Arcane Pulse
arcanePulse.description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy upkeep spells on models within 8" of it expire.

hexBlastAttack.name: •Hex Blast (★ Attack)
hexBlastAttack.description: Hex Blast is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 13/8 arcane attack. Enemy upkeep spells and animi on the model/unit directly hit by Hex Blast immediately expire.

hellMarked.name: Hell Marked
hellMarked.description: Models destroyed by attacks made by this model never generate soul tokens.

dismember.name: Dismember
dismember.description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against warbeasts.

magicAbility__3e82c264.name: Magic Ability
magicAbility__3e82c264.description: Performing a Magic Ability special action or special attack counts as casting a spell.

conditionAction__f10c61cd.name: •Condition (★Action)
conditionAction__f10c61cd.description: RNG 6. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, you can place 1 fury point on it or remove 1 fury point from it.

hitTheDeck.name: Hit the Deck!
hitTheDeck.description: Ignore this model when determining which models would be hit by an AOE. If it would be hit by an AOE, it instead becomes knocked down. While this model is knocked down, ranged attacks targeting it automatically miss.

vengeance.name: Vengeance
vengeance.description: During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. Each model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3". After all models in the unit have moved, each model can then make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

spiritBind.name: Spirit Bind
spiritBind.description: When a living warbeast within 5" of this model is destroyed but not removed from play by an attack, you can remove this model from play to use Spirit Bind. If you do, the warbeast is not destroyed and remains on the table under your control. If the warbeast was part of a battlegroup, the controller of that battlegroup can reave fury points on the warbeast as if it had been destroyed, and fury points that are not reaved are removed from the warbeast. The warbeast becomes a friendly Mercenary model, gains Undead, and no longer belongs to a battlegroup. Remove 1 damage point from each of the warbeast’s aspects. The warbeast cannot activate the turn Spirit Bind is used, cannot be forced, and loses its animus.

mechanikallyAdept.name: Mechanikally Adept
mechanikallyAdept.description: This model can target non-Faction models with Repair special actions.

repairD6Action.name: Repair [d6] (★ Action)
repairD6Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

bingeDrinking.name: Binge Drinking
bingeDrinking.description: This model can use Binge Drinking once per game at any time during its activation. This model becomes knocked down.

hangover.name: Hangover
hangover.description: The first time this model is disabled by an enemy attack, it removes all damage and becomes knocked down.

fieldMarshalPathfinderAndReposition3.name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder and Reposition 3"]
fieldMarshalPathfinderAndReposition3.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder and Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

veteranLeaderFarrowValkyries.name: Veteran Leader [Farrow Valkyries]
veteranLeaderFarrowValkyries.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Farrow Valkyries gain +1 to attack rolls.

ancientShroud.name: Ancient Shroud
ancientShroud.description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it suffers 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

darkProphecy.name: Dark Prophecy
darkProphecy.description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy models within 8" lose their essence points and cannot cast spells, channel spells, or be forced for one round.

whispersAtTheGateAction.name: •Whispers at the Gate (★Action)
whispersAtTheGateAction.description: Remove 1 essence point from each enemy infernal model currently within 5" of this model. Add 1 essence point to each friendly infernal model currently within 5" of this model.

wordOfRuinAction.name: •Word of Ruin (★Action)
wordOfRuinAction.description: This model gains Master of Ruin for one round. (Other models suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of a model with Master of Ruin.)

winterStormAction.name: •Winter Storm (★Action)
winterStormAction.description: Enemy models that begin their activations within 10" of this model lose Eyeless Sight, Flight, and Pathfinder that activation. Winter Storm lasts for one round.

vendettaLegionOrBlighted.name: Vendetta [Legion or Blighted]
vendettaLegionOrBlighted.description: This model gains boosted attack and damage rolls against Legion or Blighted models.

appliedKnowledgeAction.name: Applied Knowledge (★Action)
appliedKnowledgeAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly warrior model. If the model is in range, when it damages a warjack or warbeast with an attack, you choose which column or branch suffers the damage. Applied Knowledge lasts for one round.

firstAidD3Action.name: First Aid [d3] (★ Action)
firstAidD3Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

windBarrierAction.name: •Wind Barrier (★ Action)
windBarrierAction.description: Non-magical ranged attacks targeting this model or another model in its unit within 2" of it automatically miss. Wind Barrier lasts for one round.

windBurstAttack.name: •Wind Burst (★ Attack)
windBurstAttack.description: Wind Burst is a RNG 10, AOE 3, POW 12/7 arcane attack. After resolving this attack, cloud effects in the spellcaster’s control range expire.

vampiric.name: Vampiric
vampiric.description: When this model destroys a living or undead model with a melee or ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can remove d3 damage points.

turnUpTheHeat.name: Turn Up The Heat
turnUpTheHeat.description: This model can use Turn Up the Heat at the start of its activation. This activation, this model gains +2 SPD. At the end of the activation, this model suffers d3 damage points.

curseBoneGrinder.name: Curse [Bone Grinder]
curseBoneGrinder.description: This model can use Curse once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model/unit within 10" of this model. Friendly Bone Grinder gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Curse lasts for one turn.

bloodTrade.name: Blood Trade
bloodTrade.description: This model can upkeep spells by suffering 1 damage point per spell instead of spending focus or fury points.

bogTrogWarlock.name: Bog Trog Warlock
bogTrogWarlock.description: This model can have only Minion Gatorman warbeasts in its battlegroup.

callToSacrificeBogTrog.name: Call to Sacrifice [Bog Trog]
callToSacrificeBogTrog.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Bog Trog model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

diversionaryTacticAction.name: Diversionary Tactic (★ Action)
diversionaryTacticAction.description: Models other than Brine within 3" of Rorsh suffer a POW 7 blast damage roll. After these damage rolls are resolved, Rorsh can make a full advance. If Brine was within 3" of Rorsh when he used Diversionary Tactic, Brine can also make a full advance.

farrowWarlock.name: Farrow Warlock
farrowWarlock.description: This model can have only Minion Farrow warbeasts in its battlegroup.

souieAction.name: Souie (★ Action)
souieAction.description: If Brine is currently in this model’s control range, Brine can immediately make a full advance toward Rorsh.

bacon.name: Bacon
bacon.description: When this model is destroyed, each living warbeast within 1" of it can remove d3 damage points.

companionRorsh.name: Companion [Rorsh]
companionRorsh.description: This model is included in any army that includes Rorsh. If Rorsh is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Rorsh’s battlegroup.

adrenalize.name: Adrenalize
adrenalize.description: This model can use Adrenalize at any time during its activation. This model gains Berserk and Overtake that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

flankRazorBoar.name: Flank [Razor Boar]
flankRazorBoar.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Razor Boar, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

aggressionDial.name: Aggression Dial
aggressionDial.description: This model can use Aggression Dial at any time during its activation. This model gains +2 to its melee damage rolls that activation. At the end of that activation, this model suffers d3 damage points. Aggression Dial can be used only once per activation.

reconnaissanceAction.name: Reconnaissance (★Action)
reconnaissanceAction.description: RNG 8. Target friendly warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Pathfinder. Reconnaissance lasts for one turn.

mentalDominationShieldGuard.name: Mental Domination [Shield Guard]
mentalDominationShieldGuard.description: While in this model’s control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

struggleOfWills.name: Struggle of Wills
struggleOfWills.description: Before the start of the game and at the start of each of your Maintenance Phases after your first turn, choose which mind is dominant: Sturm or Drang. Use that mind’s stats and rules for one round.

mentalDominationOvertake.name: Mental Domination [Overtake]
mentalDominationOvertake.description: While in this model’s control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

deflect.name: Deflect
deflect.description: When an enemy model misses this model with a non-spray ranged attack, the attacking model becomes the target of the attack and is directly hit by the attack. This model becomes the point of origin for the attack.

takeABullet.name: Take A Bullet
takeABullet.description: When a friendly model is targeted by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of this model, you can choose to have this model become the target of the attack instead. If you do, this model is considered to be within the attacker’s LOS and within the RNG of the attack. This model can use Take A Bullet only once per round and cannot use Take A Bullet if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary.

beastLore.name: •Beast Lore
beastLore.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains boosted attack rolls against warbeasts for one turn.

companionIronMotherDirectrix.name: Companion [Iron Mother Directrix]
companionIronMotherDirectrix.description: Two of these models are included in any army that includes Iron Mother Directrix. If Directrix is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Directrix’s battlegroup.

ascensionCommand.name: •Ascension Command
ascensionCommand.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models with Flight gain Resistance: Blast and Flying High. Ascension Command lasts for one round. (Ranged attacks targeting a model with Flying High suffer –3 RNG. Friendly models can advance through a model with Flying High if they have enough movement to move completely past its base. A model loses Flying High if it loses Flight.)

phantomProtocol.name: •Phantom Protocol
phantomProtocol.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly models with Flight gain Dodge and Reposition [3"]. Phantom Protocol lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.) (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

accumulatorWarcaster.name: Accumulator [Warcaster]
accumulatorWarcaster.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly warcaster warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

arcaneRepeater.name: Arcane Repeater
arcaneRepeater.description: While this model’s Leader is within 5" of it, that Leader’s control range is extended 2".

focusBattery.name: Focus Battery
focusBattery.description: During your Maintenance Phase, do not remove unspent focus points from this model.

powerTransferAction.name: Power Transfer (★ Action)
powerTransferAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the warjack is in range, this model can give that warjack any number of its focus points.

inductionRepeater.name: Induction Repeater
inductionRepeater.description: When another warjack in this model's battlegroup uses force induction, increase the range to 12".

soulVessel.name: Soul Vessel
soulVessel.description: This model generates soul tokens as if it were a living model.

realignment.name: Realignment
realignment.description: This model can use Realignment once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit can reroll failed attack rolls this turn. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Realignment.

handOfVengeance.name: Hand of Vengeance
handOfVengeance.description: When one or more friendly Faction warrior models are destroyed or removed from play by enemy attacks while within 5" of this model, this model gains +2 on melee attack and melee damage rolls for one round.

configuration.name: Configuration
configuration.description: At the start of each of this model’s activations, it gains +2 MAT or RAT until the start of its next activation.

repairD31Action.name: Repair [d3+1] (★Action)
repairD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

reinforcementsSmallOrMediumBasedConstruc.name: Reinforcements [small or medium-based constructs]
reinforcementsSmallOrMediumBasedConstruc.description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small or medium-based friendly destroyed construct Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

variable.name: Variable
variable.description: At the start of this unit’s activation, choose one of the following effects. The chosen effect lasts for one round.

accuracy.name: •Accuracy
accuracy.description: This model gains +2 on its attack rolls.

shieldsUp__44e89ed1.name: •Shields Up
shieldsUp__44e89ed1.description: This model's weapons gain the Buckler advantage

fieldMarshalReconstruct.name: Field Marshal [Reconstruct]
fieldMarshalReconstruct.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Reconstruct. (When a model with Reconstruct is disabled by an enemy attack, place it anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Then, remove 1 damage point from each system. A model can only use Reconstruct once per turn. Reconstruct only effects models with a large base or smaller.)

arcanePatternArray.name: Arcane Pattern Array
arcanePatternArray.description: When another model within 10" of this model casts a spell, this model gains one power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

created.name: Created
created.description: This model does not begin the game in play.

ionization5.name: Ionization [5"]
ionization5.description: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 5" of this model, add +2 to the roll.

activateExponentServitor.name: Activate Exponent Servitor
activateExponentServitor.description: At the end of your Control Phase, you can put one Exponent Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model if there are fewer than two Exponent Servitors in play in Directrix’s battlegroup.

fieldMarshalArcNode.name: Field Marshal [Arc Node]
fieldMarshalArcNode.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Arc Node.

flankAngel__9c5cac62.name: Flank [Angel]
flankAngel__9c5cac62.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction Angel model, this model gains +2 to the attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

allTerrainAction.name: All-Terrain (★Action)
allTerrainAction.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

arcaneReinforcementAction.name: Arcane Reinforcement (★Action)
arcaneReinforcementAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Arcane Reinforcement lasts for one turn.

extendedRange.name: •Extended Range
extendedRange.description: This model’s ranged weapons gain +3 RNG.

empoweredAttack.name: •Empowered Attack
empoweredAttack.description: This weapon gains +2 on its damage rolls.

apparition.name: Apparition
apparition.description: During your Control Phase, place this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location.

leadershipAngels.name: Leadership [Angels]
leadershipAngels.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Angel models gain Apparition.

launchServitor.name: Launch Servitor
launchServitor.description: Once per turn at any time during this model’s activation, you can place one Attunement Servitor solo into play completely witn in 2" of this model.

powerGrid.name: Power Grid
powerGrid.description: Once per turn at any time during this model’s activation, you can place one Ionization Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model. There can be up to 3 Ionization servitors in play per Prime Conflux included in this army.

setDefense__fe6de8d2.name: •Set Defense
setDefense__fe6de8d2.description: Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against this model.

defensiveStrike.name: Defensive Strike
defensiveStrike.description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

sacrificialPawnPermutationServitor.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Permutation Servitor]
sacrificialPawnPermutationServitor.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Permutation Servitor model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

servitorSatellites.name: Servitor Satellites
servitorSatellites.description: At the start of this model’s activation, remove any Permutation Servitors this model put into play from the table. Once per activation, after its Normal Movement, this model can place up to three Permutation Servitors anywhere within 1" of itself. During its Combat Action, this model can make one additional Aperture Pulse ranged attack for each Permutation Servitor it did not place that activation.

repair1Action__d359963b.name: Repair [1] (★ Action)
repair1Action__d359963b.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove 1 damage point from it.

stripAction.name: Strip (★ Action)
stripAction.description: This model can make this special action only when B2B with an enemy warjack. The warjack suffers 1 damage point to the column of your choice.

soulMatrixAsphyxious.name: Soul Matrix [Asphyxious]
soulMatrixAsphyxious.description: When this model destroys an enemy living model with an attack, Asphyxious gains the destroyed model’s soul token.

superTuneAction.name: Super Tune (★ Action)
superTuneAction.description: RNG 1. Target Nemo. If Nemo is in range, they gain an additional die on electrical attack and electrical damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. Super Tune lasts for one turn.

portal.name: Portal
portal.description: Choose one of the following effects at the start of this model’s activation:

foldSpace.name: •Fold Space
foldSpace.description: Return d3 small-based friendly destroyed Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

spatialVortex.name: •Spatial Vortex
spatialVortex.description: Enemy models currently within 2" of this model suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll. After the damage is resolved, place this model completely within 3" of its current location.

repairD33Action__73e6a299.name: Repair [d3+3] (★Action)
repairD33Action__73e6a299.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 + 3 damage points from it.

fieldMarshalDarkShroud.name: Field Marshal [Dark Shroud]
fieldMarshalDarkShroud.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

soulTakerCullSoul.name: Soul Taker: Cull Soul
soulTakerCullSoul.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its focus during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 focus point.

flankAngel.name: Flank [Angel]
flankAngel.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Angel model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

fieldMarshalApparition.name: Field Marshal [Apparition]
fieldMarshalApparition.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Apparition.

fieldMarshalTrueStrike.name: Field Marshal [True Strike]
fieldMarshalTrueStrike.description: When a warjack in this model’s battlegroup damages a warjack or warbeast with a melee attack, choose which column or branch suffers the damage.

chemicalWarfare.name: Chemical Warfare
chemicalWarfare.description: When an enemy model takes damage from a continuous effect while in this model’s control area, double the damage.

superconduction8.name: Superconduction [8"]
superconduction8.description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack with a ranged weapon with Damage Type: Electricity targeting an enemy model within 8" of this model, the attacking model gains +2 to its attack roll.

springBlades.name: Spring Blades
springBlades.description: If a model hits this model with a melee attack, the attacking model suffers d3 damage points immediately after the attack is resolved unless this model was destroyed or removed from play by the attack.

jackHunter.name: ’Jack Hunter
jackHunter.description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against warjacks.

repairD32Action.name: Repair [d3+2] (★ Action)
repairD32Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3+2 damage points from it.

bondLukas.name: Bond [Lukas]
bondLukas.description: If Apollo begins the game in Lukas’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Apollo is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. If Apollo is bonded to Lukas and is in his control range at the start of Lukas’ activation, Lukas can remove d3 damage points.

arcaneRealignment.name: Arcane Realignment
arcaneRealignment.description: While within this model's Leader's control Range, that Leader can reroll one failed arcane attack roll each turn.

psychokineticForceAction.name: •Psychokinetic Force (★Action)
psychokineticForceAction.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 MAT and RAT. Psychokinetic Force lasts for one round.

forceAuraAction.name: •Force Aura (★Action)
forceAuraAction.description: While within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and ARM against ranged attacks. Force Aura lasts for one round.

psychicAssaultAttack.name: •Psychic Assault (★Attack)
psychicAssaultAttack.description: Psychic Assault is a RNG SP 8, POW 12 arcane attack. This attack ignores LOS.

fieldAlchemy.name: Field Alchemy
fieldAlchemy.description: This model can use one of the following special rules at any time during each of its activations.

impenetrableHaze.name: •Impenetrable Haze
impenetrableHaze.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This AOE remains in play for one round. This model gains Stealth while completely within the template.

superFuel.name: •Super Fuel
superFuel.description: Friendly Faction construct models currently within 5" of this model gain +2 SPD this turn.

ephemeralVitae.name: •Ephemeral Vitae
ephemeralVitae.description: This model can cast one spell this activation without spending focus points.

transmogrificationElixir.name: Transmogrification Elixir
transmogrificationElixir.description: This model can use Transmogrification Elixir once per game during your Control Phase. Immediately mark all of this model’s damage boxes and replace it with Big Alyce.

traumaticTransformation.name: Traumatic Transformation
traumaticTransformation.description: This model begins the game as Little Alyce. When all of this model’s damage boxes are marked, instead of becoming disabled this model is replaced with Big Alyce. Damage points in excess of this model’s remaining unmarked damage boxes are not applied to Big Alyce’s damage boxes. If this model is replaced with Big Alyce during its activation, its activation ends. After this model is replaced with Big Alyce, apply effects that were on it to Big Alyce. When this model is replaced by Big Alyce, Big Alyce is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area.

detoxAction__45cda727.name: Detox (★Action)
detoxAction__45cda727.description: Remove any number of elixer tokens from this model.

healthCare__31c3d2e3.name: Health Care
healthCare__31c3d2e3.description: This model does not suffer damage from elixer tokens while it has two or fewer elixer tokens and is within  5" of Little Alyce.

juicer__2bf27a2f.name: Juicer
juicer__2bf27a2f.description: During your Maintenance Phase, you can place one elixer token on di Morray. For each elixer token on di Morray, he gains +1 ARC and AAT. At the end of each of his activations, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the number of elixer tokens on di Morray, he suffers 1 damage point for each elixer token on him. Di Morray cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.

acidTreatmentAction.name: Acid Treatment (★Action)
acidTreatmentAction.description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Corrosion for one round.

heatTreatmentAction.name: Heat Treatment (★Action)
heatTreatmentAction.description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Continuous Effect Fire for one round.

magicalTreatmentAction.name: Magical Treatment (★Action)
magicalTreatmentAction.description: RNG 5. Target model's ranged and melee weapons gain Damage Type Magical for one round.

grantedDualShot.name: Granted: Dual Shot
grantedDualShot.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dual Shot. (If a model with Dual Shot uses its Normal Movement to aim, it can make one additional ranged attack this activation.)

grantedDodge.name: Granted: Dodge
grantedDodge.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

missionObjective.name: Mission Objective
missionObjective.description: Once per game at any time during its unit’s activation, this model can use Mission Objective. When it does, choose an enemy model/unit in this model’s LOS. This activation, models in this unit gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against the chosen model/unit.

grantedReposition2.name: Granted: Reposition [2"]
