grantedReposition2.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [2"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [2"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 2", then its activation ends.)

coagulumOfEntropy.name: •Coagulum of Entropy
coagulumOfEntropy.description: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Resistance: Corrosion. When an affected model is hit by a melee attack, the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous effect. Coagulum of Entropy lasts for one round.

fortemorphicElixir.name: •Fortemorphic Elixir
fortemorphicElixir.description: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and gains Overtake. Fortemorphic Elixir lasts for one round. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

theGoodStuff.name: •The Good Stuff
theGoodStuff.description: RNG 5. Target friendly faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough and cannot become knocked down but suffers –1 to attack rolls. The Good Stuff lasts for one round.

healD32Action.name: Heal [d3 +2] (★Action)
healD32Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 +2 damage points from it.

revivifier.name: Revivifier
revivifier.description: This model can use Revivifier once per game at any time during its activation. While within 5" of this model, friendly Faction warrior models gain Tough. Additionally, when a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while within 5" of this model, that model can remove 1 damage point. Revivifier lasts for one round.

armsCaddy.name: Arms Caddy
armsCaddy.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation and while within 5" of Mr. Clogg, Gearhart can use Arms Caddy. Replace his ranged weapon with one of the weapons on Mr. Clogg’s card. Gearhart keeps that weapon until he uses Arms Caddy again.

bloodyWellDone.name: •Bloody Well Done!
bloodyWellDone.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains an additional die on each model’s first non-spray ranged attack roll this turn.

giveEmWhatFor.name: •Give ’Em What For!
giveEmWhatFor.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Reciprocate for one round. (When it is missed by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved a model with Reciprocate can make one basic ranged attack against the attacking model.)

companionMarshalGeneralBaldwinGearhart.name: Companion [Marshal General Baldwin Gearhart]
companionMarshalGeneralBaldwinGearhart.description: This model is included in any army that includes Marshal General Baldwin Gearhart. If Gearhart is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Gearhart’s battlegroup.

johnnyOnTheSpotAction.name: Johnny on the Spot (★Action)
johnnyOnTheSpotAction.description: RNG 5. Target Gearhart. If Gearhart is in range, he immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack.

anchor.name: Anchor
anchor.description: Friendly warrior models cannot be knocked down while B2B with this model.

alchemicalVents.name: Alchemical Vents
alchemicalVents.description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following Alchemical Vents effects. While within 5" of this model, models are affected by the chosen effect. While its S system is crippled, this model loses the benefits of Alchemical Vents. Alchemical Vent effects last for one round.

ironBane.name: •Iron Bane
ironBane.description: Models hit without Resistance: Corrosion suffer Rust. (A construct model suffering Rust suffers –2 ARM. Rust lasts for one round)

miasmaOfDeath.name: •Miasma of Death
miasmaOfDeath.description: Affected living enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them unless they can ignore gas effects.

unnaturalAffliction.name: •Unnatural Affliction
unnaturalAffliction.description: On a direct hit, models hit lose Resistance: Cold, Resistance: Corrosion, Resistance: Electricity, and Resistance: Fire for one round.

dogfighter.name: Dogfighter
dogfighter.description: This model gains boosted attack and damage rolls against models with Flight.

unstableConcoction.name: •Unstable Concoction
unstableConcoction.description: Unstable Concoction is a RNG 8, AOE 2, POW 12/8 arcane attack. Add 1 to the AOE value of this attack if the target is suffering from the Fire or Corrosion continuous effect. Add 2 to the AOE if the target is suffering from both.

combatChemistry.name: Combat Chemistry
combatChemistry.description: At the start of each of this model's activations, it gains one elixir token. This model can have up to three elixir tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend elixir tokens to gain additional melee attacks, boost an attack roll, or boost a damage roll. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent.

spontaneousCombustion.name: Spontaneous Combustion
spontaneousCombustion.description: On a direct hit, add an additional die to this weapon’s damage roll if the model hit is suffering a continuous effect. Add two dice instead if the model hit is suffering from two different continuous effects. Then, all continuous effects on that model expire.

iceCage.name: •Ice Cage
iceCage.description: On a direct hit a model hit suffers a cumulative –2 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold. When a model without Resistance: Cold is affected by two or more directly hitting Ice Cage attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.

combatAlchemy.name: Combat Alchemy
combatAlchemy.description: Once during this model's combat action, this model can spend an elixir token to cast a spell.

poltergeist.name: Poltergeist
poltergeist.description: When an enemy model misses this model with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from this model.

espionageAction.name: Espionage (★Action)
espionageAction.description: RNG 8. Target enemy Leader model. If the enemy Leader is in range, one friendly faction model within 8" of this model can immediately advance 3".

fieldMarshal1DEFAndRiposte.name: Field Marshal [+1 DEF and Riposte]
fieldMarshal1DEFAndRiposte.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain +1 DEF and Riposte.

protectionOfTheGreatFathersAction.name: •Protection of the Great Fathers (★ Action)
protectionOfTheGreatFathersAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Rhul Guard model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Force Barrier for one round.

tectonicShiftAction.name: •Tectonic Shift (★ Action)
tectonicShiftAction.description: Choose a table edge. Enemy models currently within 3" of this model are pushed 3" directly toward the chosen edge in the order you choose.

sacrificialPawnPrivateerWarrior.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Privateer warrior]
sacrificialPawnPrivateerWarrior.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Privateer warrior model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

flankPrivateer.name: Flank [Privateer]
flankPrivateer.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Privateer model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

tenacity.name: •Tenacity
tenacity.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Feign Death for one round. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

cacophony.name: •Cacophony
cacophony.description: While within 10" of this model, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells. Cacophony lasts for one round.

warCry.name: •War Cry
warCry.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 MAT. War Cry lasts for one turn.

driveDismantle.name: Drive: Dismantle
driveDismantle.description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Dismantle.

juryRigged.name: Jury-Rigged
juryRigged.description: This model can use Jury-Rigged at the start of its activation. This activation, this model gains +2 SPD. At the end of the activation, this model suffers 1 damage point to its first available Movement system box. This model cannot use Jury-Rigged if its Movement system is crippled. Jury-Rigged can be used only once per activation.

triedTrue.name: Tried & True
triedTrue.description: When this model is affected by a Repair special action, remove 1 additional damage point from it.

bondDamiano.name: Bond [Damiano]
bondDamiano.description: If this model begins the game in Damiano’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to Damiano and in his control range, it gains Guard Dog. (While a model with Guard Dog is within 3" of its Leader and is not knocked down or stationary, its Leader gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.)

bondShae.name: Bond [Shae]
bondShae.description: If Scallywag begins the game in Shae’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Scallywag is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Scallywag is bonded to Shae and in his battlegroup, it gains Extended Control Range. (When checking to see if Scallywag is in Shae’s control range, double the range.)

boundingLeap.name: Bounding Leap
boundingLeap.description: Once per activation, after making a full advance as its Normal Movement but before performing its Combat Action, this model can spend 1 focus point to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

noSleepingOnTheJobLivingPrivateer.name: No Sleeping on the Job [living Privateer]
noSleepingOnTheJobLivingPrivateer.description: This model and friendly living Privateer models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

fieldMarshalOvertake__5004f018.name: Field Marshal [Overtake]
fieldMarshalOvertake__5004f018.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Overtake.

driveReposition3.name: Drive: Reposition [3"]
driveReposition3.description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Reposition [3"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

veteranLeaderDevilDog.name: Veteran Leader [Devil Dog]
veteranLeaderDevilDog.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Devil Dog models gain +1 to attack rolls.

trollkin.name: Trollkin
trollkin.description: This model is a Trollkin model.

healD6Action.name: •Heal [d6] (★Action)
healD6Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d6 damage points from it.

noImFine.name: No, I’m Fine
noImFine.description: When a friendly Privateer model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while within 10" of this model, that model removes 1 damage point and becomes knocked down.

fieldMarshalContinuousFire.name: Field Marshal [Continuous Fire]
fieldMarshalContinuousFire.description: The ranged weapons of Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

leadershipRhulGuardWarriors.name: Leadership [Rhul Guard warriors]
leadershipRhulGuardWarriors.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Rhul Guard warrior models gain Hit the Deck! (Ignore a model with Hit the Deck! when determining which models would be hit by an AOE. If a model with Hit the Deck! would be hit by an AOE, it instead becomes knocked down. While this model is knocked down, ranged attacks targeting a model with Hit the Deck! automatically miss.)

objectOfDesire.name: Object of Desire
objectOfDesire.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Privateer Warrior models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls.

leadershipOrderOfIlluminationVigilants.name: Leadership [Order of Illumination Vigilants]
leadershipOrderOfIlluminationVigilants.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Order of Illumination Vigilants models gain True Sight.

blessedWards.name: Blessed Wards
blessedWards.description: This model gains +3 ARM against damage rolls made by Infernal or undead models.

callOfDefiance.name: •Call of Defiance
callOfDefiance.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models do not lose Tough while knocked down. Call of Defiance lasts for one round.

gunsBlazing.name: Guns Blazing
gunsBlazing.description: This model can use Guns Blazing once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit can make one additional ranged attack during this unit’s Combat Action.

reinforcementsRhulGuard.name: Reinforcements [Rhul Guard]
reinforcementsRhulGuard.description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed Rhulic Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

periscope.name: Periscope
periscope.description: This model can use Periscope once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model in this model’s LOS. That model loses Stealth for one turn.

batteryFireAction.name: Battery Fire (★Action)
batteryFireAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction weapon crew model. If the model is in range, it can make one additional ranged attack during its activation this turn.

guidanceAction__dcceef63.name: Guidance (★ Action)
guidanceAction__dcceef63.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model. If the model is in range, it gains Eyeless Sight and its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical for one turn.

bloodBound.name: Blood-Bound
bloodBound.description: When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in its unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of this model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed enemy model is removed from play and does not provide a soul or corpse token.

darkBlessing__22b6b6cd.name: Dark Blessing
darkBlessing__22b6b6cd.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to gain +3 DEF. Dark Blessing lasts for one round.

fieldMarshalArcaneAmmunition.name: Field Marshal [Arcane Ammunition]
fieldMarshalArcaneAmmunition.description: The ranged weapons of Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Damage Type: Magical.

payday.name: •Payday
payday.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain boosted melee attack rolls and Overtake for one turn. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

parlayAction__d1c6ee40.name: Parlay (★Action)
parlayAction__d1c6ee40.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy warrior models cannot target this model or its Leader with attacks. Parlay lasts for one round.

seductionAction.name: Seduction (★Action)
seductionAction.description: Take control of a living enemy non-Leader warrior model within 1" of this model. You can immediately make a full advance with the enemy model followed by a basic melee attack, then Seduction expires. A model can be affected by Seduction only once per turn.

hotMeal.name: Hot Meal
hotMeal.description: This model can use Hot Meal once per game at any time during its activation. Remove all damage from friendly living warrior Faction models within 5" of this model.

doublePowderRation.name: Double Powder Ration
doublePowderRation.description: This model can use Double Powder Ration once per game at any time during its activation. This turn, ranged attacks made by friendly Privateer models while within 10" of this model gain +2 RNG. Double Powder Ration lasts for one turn.

spellBreaker.name: Spell Breaker
spellBreaker.description: When this model hits another model with an attack, enemy upkeep spells on the model hit expire. A spellcaster can keep its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points.

holyBonds.name: Holy Bonds
holyBonds.description: Enemy models cannot gain this model’s soul token.

veteranLeaderOrdic.name: Veteran Leader [Ordic]
veteranLeaderOrdic.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Ordic models gain +1 to attack rolls.

deathFieldAction.name: •Death Field (★Action)
deathFieldAction.description: While within 3" of this model, friendly models gain Dark Shroud. Death Field lasts for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

sacrificialPawnLivingModel.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Living model]
sacrificialPawnLivingModel.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal living model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

dirgeOfMists.name: •Dirge of Mists
dirgeOfMists.description: While within 5" of this model, friendly models gain concealment. Dirge of Mists lasts for one round.

driveShieldGuard.name: Drive: Shield Guard
driveShieldGuard.description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains  Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

partnerTarynDiLaRovissi.name: Partner [Taryn di la Rovissi]
partnerTarynDiLaRovissi.description: While within 10" of Taryn di la Rovissi, this model gains Dodge. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

grantedAdvanceDeployment.name: Granted: Advance Deployment
grantedAdvanceDeployment.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Advance Deployment.

flankSteelheadHalberdier__805126a8.name: Flank [Steelhead Halberdier]
flankSteelheadHalberdier__805126a8.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Steelhead Halberdier, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

leadershipSteelheadHalberdiers.name: Leadership [Steelhead Halberdiers]
leadershipSteelheadHalberdiers.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Steelhead Halberdier models gain Shield Wall. (While a model with Shield Wall is B2B with one or more models in its unit, it gains +2 ARM and cannot be knocked down.)

reinforcementsSteelhead.name: Reinforcements [Steelhead]
reinforcementsSteelhead.description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed Steelhead Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

battleBrothersSteelhead.name: Battle Brothers [Steelhead]
battleBrothersSteelhead.description: While B2B with one or more Steelhead models, this model gains +2 ARM.

defensiveStrike__78f41ebc.name: Defensive Strike
defensiveStrike__78f41ebc.description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in this model’s melee range, this model can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.

desperatePaceWeaponCrewAction.name: Desperate Pace [Weapon Crew] (★ Action)
desperatePaceWeaponCrewAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Weapon Crew trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

siegeTacticsAction.name: Siege Tactics (★ Action)
siegeTacticsAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction weapon crew. If the weapon crew is in range, the next ranged attack made by the unit gains Siege Weapon. Siege Tactics lasts for one turn. (A weapon with Siege Weapon gains an additional die to its damage rolls against huge-based models and buildings.)

flankSteelheadHalberdier.name: Flank [Steelhead Halberdier]
flankSteelheadHalberdier.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Steelhead Halberdier, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

crane.name: Crane
crane.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can choose one other friendly large-based or smaller model within 2" of it. You can place that model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location, and if it is knocked down, it immediately stands up. A model can only be placed once per turn as a result of Crane.

combatCoordination.name: •Combat Coordination
combatCoordination.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, during its activation this turn, it can reroll one attack or damage roll, then Combat Coordination expires.

desperatePaceRhulGuardUnit.name: •Desperate Pace [Rhul Guard unit]
desperatePaceRhulGuardUnit.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Rhul Guard trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

deathlyStrike.name: •Deathly Strike
deathlyStrike.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds for one turn. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

callToSacrificeSeaDog.name: Call to Sacrifice [Sea Dog]
callToSacrificeSeaDog.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Sea Dog trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

arcaneSecretsAction.name: Arcane Secrets (★Action)
arcaneSecretsAction.description: RNG 6. Target this model’s Leader. If the Leader is in range, it gains an additional die on arcane  attack rolls and magical damage rolls for the next spell it casts. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Arcane Secrets lasts for one turn.

spiritualConduit.name: Spiritual Conduit
spiritualConduit.description: While its Leader is within 10" of this model, when the Leader casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +2 RNG.

smokeBombsAction__84b997ea.name: •Smoke Bombs (★Action)
smokeBombsAction__84b997ea.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. This template remains in play for one round.

partnerRutgerShaw.name: Partner [Rutger Shaw]
partnerRutgerShaw.description: While within 10" of Rutger Shaw, this model gains Tough.

blessedOfThamar.name: Blessed of Thamar
blessedOfThamar.description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, each Infernal model within 5" of this model loses 1 essence point.

fellCurseAction.name: •Fell Curse (★Action)
fellCurseAction.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them. Fell Curse lasts for one round.

barringTheGatesAction.name: •Barring the Gates (★Action)
barringTheGatesAction.description: When a model within 10" of this model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, when an Infernal model within 10" of this model summons a horror, the Infernal must spend 1 additional essence point to summon the horror. Barring the Gates lasts for one round.

tuneUpAction__4b864b5a.name: Tune Up (★ Action)
tuneUpAction__4b864b5a.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the model expire, and it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

grandSlam.name: Grand Slam
grandSlam.description: This model can make slam power attacks without spending a focus point. Models slammed by this model are moved an additional 2".

escapees.name: Escapees
escapees.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, replace it with a Gremlin Swarm solo and remove this model from play.

practicedShot.name: Practiced Shot
practicedShot.description: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, it ignores Stealth and this weapon gains +3 RNG that activation.

deathReaper.name: Death Reaper
deathReaper.description: When a living enemy model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, Asphyxious gains the destroyed model’s soul token.

serpentSCoil.name: Serpent's Coil
serpentSCoil.description: Once per game at any time during its unit’s activation, this model can use Serpent’s Coil. For one round, models in this unit gain Defensive Strike. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.)

ghostly.name: Ghostly
ghostly.description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

grantedSetDefense.name: Granted: Set Defense
grantedSetDefense.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Set Defense. (Models suffer –2 on charge and slam power attack rolls against a model with Set Defense.)

darkShroud__348feb07.name: Dark Shroud
darkShroud__348feb07.description: While within 2" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

rapidStrike.name: Rapid Strike
rapidStrike.description: This model can make one additional melee attack each Combat Action.

curseBane.name: Curse [Bane]
curseBane.description: This model can use Curse once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model/unit within 10" of this model. Friendly Bane models gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Curse lasts for one turn.

ghostly__910100df.name: Ghostly
ghostly__910100df.description: This model can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.

grantedTough.name: Granted: Tough
grantedTough.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Tough.

voidBringer.name: Void Bringer
voidBringer.description: This model can use Void Bringer once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. When this model uses Void Bringer, return d3 + 1 destroyed troopers to this unit. Place the returned troopers completely within 3" of this model. Returned troopers must forfeit their Combat Actions this activation.

darkShroud__12de294d.name: Dark Shroud
darkShroud__12de294d.description: While within 2"  of this model, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.

fieldMarshalBloodShadow.name: Field Marshal [Blood Shadow]
fieldMarshalBloodShadow.description: The melee weapons of warjacks in this models's battlegroup gain Blood Shadow.

darkFireAttack.name: •Dark Fire (★Attack)
darkFireAttack.description: Dark Fire is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Dark Fire, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

soulTakerSoulCage.name: Soul Taker: Soul Cage
soulTakerSoulCage.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

blackArts.name: Black Arts
blackArts.description: A friendly Faction Leader model that has this model in its control range can upkeep one spell without spending focus or fury.

sigilOfPowerAction__eff18fc2.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

darkFireAttack__edc8cffc.name: •Dark Fire (★Attack)
darkFireAttack__edc8cffc.description: Dark Fire is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Dark Fire, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model's soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

bondTerminus.name: Bond [Terminus]
bondTerminus.description: If Barathrum begins the game in Terminus’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Barathrum is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Barathrum is bonded to Terminus and in his control range, it gains Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

purge.name: Purge
purge.description: If this model is hit by a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the attacking model suffers the Corrosion continuous effect.

disbindingAction.name: •Disbinding (★Action)
disbindingAction.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi on this model and its unit immediately expire.

leadershipBloatThralls.name: Leadership [Bloat Thralls]
leadershipBloatThralls.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Bloat Thrall models gain Reposition [3"].

thrallBomb.name: Thrall Bomb
thrallBomb.description: When this model is disabled, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 8 blast damage roll, then this model is removed from play.

veteranLeaderBloatThralls.name: Veteran Leader [Bloat Thralls]
veteranLeaderBloatThralls.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Bloat Thrall models gain +1 to attack rolls.

bondAsphyxious.name: Bond [Asphyxious]
bondAsphyxious.description: If Cankerworm begins the game in Asphyxious’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Cankerworm is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Asphyxious and in his control range, Cankerworm gains Reposition [5"]. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [5"] can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.)

salvageHarvester.name: Salvage Harvester
salvageHarvester.description: When this model destroys an enemy Cohort model with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved remove d3+3 damage points from this model.

callToSacrificeRevenant.name: Call to Sacrifice [Revenant]
callToSacrificeRevenant.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Revenant trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

veteranLeaderRevenant.name: Veteran Leader [Revenant]
veteranLeaderRevenant.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Revenant models gain +1 to attack rolls.

battleWizard__41cb4e8f.name: Battle Wizard
battleWizard__41cb4e8f.description: Once per turn, when this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved it can make one Magic Ability special attack or special action.

hellfireAttack__adf62268.name: •Hellfire (★Attack)
hellfireAttack__adf62268.description: Hellfire is a RNG 10, POW 14 arcane attack. Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

invocationOfDarkestNightAction.name: •Invocation of Darkest Night (★Action)
invocationOfDarkestNightAction.description: This model gains Mortal Fear. Invocation of Darkest Night lasts for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Mortal Fear, living enemy models suffer -2 to damage rolls.)

hellfireAttack.name: •Hellfire (★Attack)
hellfireAttack.description: Hellfire is a RNG 10, POW 14 magic attack. Models disabled by Hellfire cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by Hellfire are removed from play.

necromancy.name: •Necromancy
necromancy.description: While this model is in its controller’s control range, it can spend focus points to cast its controller’s spells. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL.

hateFueled.name: Hate Fueled
hateFueled.description: This model can have up to 5 focus points at any time instead of the normal limit of 3. During your Control Phase, after focus allocation this model gains 1 focus point for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

darkRestoration.name: Dark Restoration
darkRestoration.description: If Goreshade is disabled while within 5" of this model, this model is destroyed and 1 damage point is removed from Goreshade.

companionGoreshadeTheBastard.name: Companion [Goreshade The Bastard]
companionGoreshadeTheBastard.description: This model is included in any army that includes Goreshade The Bastard. If Goreshade is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Goreshade’s battlegroup.

breathTaker.name: Breath Taker
breathTaker.description: Living enemy models suffer –2 DEF and –2 to their melee attack damage rolls while within 5" of this model.

soulMastery.name: Soul Mastery
soulMastery.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend soul tokens to use one of the following effects for each token spent:

darkWhispers.name: •Dark Whispers
darkWhispers.description: This model can cast a spell with COST 3 or less without spending focus.

vengefulSpirits.name: •Vengeful Spirits
vengefulSpirits.description: Choose a cohort model in this model’s battlegroup within 10" of it. That cohort model gains up to 3 focus points.

soulWeaver.name: Soul Weaver
soulWeaver.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can remove soul tokens from one friendly Faction model within 10" of it and place them on itself.

tuneUpAction__f7429a40.name: •Tune Up (★ Action)
tuneUpAction__f7429a40.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the model expire, and it gains Pathfinder for one turn.

accumulatorBane.name: Accumulator [Bane]
accumulatorBane.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Bane warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

blackMantle.name: Black Mantle
blackMantle.description: While B2B with this model, friendly Faction models gain Stealth.

sympatheticLink.name: Sympathetic Link
sympatheticLink.description: When this model would suffer damage, it can spend 1 focus point to reduce the damage by 5. Assign the remaining damage to one or more Witch Coven of Garlghast models, divided as you choose. Coven models cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage. A Witch cannot be assigned more damage points than she has unmarked damage boxes. This model does not suffer that damage.

bondScaverous.name: Bond [Scaverous]
bondScaverous.description: If this model begins the game in Scaverous’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to Scaverous and in his control range, he can channel spells through it.

spellVortex.name: Spell Vortex
spellVortex.description: If an enemy model cast a spell in this model’s control range last turn, this model can cast one spell without spending focus during its activation this turn.

soulTakerBodyCount__4e0c6a55.name: Soul Taker: Body Count
soulTakerBodyCount__4e0c6a55.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

driveDarkShroud.name: Drive: Dark Shroud
driveDarkShroud.description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains  Dark Shroud. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

cloakOfDarknessAction.name: •Cloak of Darkness (★Action)
cloakOfDarknessAction.description: This model gains Stealth. While a warjack this model controls is B2B with it, the warjack also gains Stealth. Cloak of Darkness lasts for one round.

soulPowered.name: •Soul-Powered
soulPowered.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

bondDeneghra.name: Bond [Deneghra]
bondDeneghra.description: If Nightmare begins the game in Deneghra’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Nightmare is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Nightmare is bonded to Deneghra and in her control range, it gains Stealth.

necromanticPower.name: Necromantic Power
necromanticPower.description: During your Control Phase, after focus allocation this model gains 1 focus point for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

soulReaperAction.name: Soul Reaper (★ Action)
soulReaperAction.description: When a living enemy model is destroyed in this model's’ control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. Soul Reaper lasts for one round.

sacrificialPawnUndeadModel.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Undead model]
sacrificialPawnUndeadModel.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Undead model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

shadowOfDeath.name: Shadow of Death
shadowOfDeath.description: While in this model’s control range, friendly undead Faction models gain Tough.

fieldMarshalUnstoppable.name: Field Marshal [Unstoppable]
fieldMarshalUnstoppable.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Unstoppable.

knowledgeOfTheDamned__f89bbdb5.name: Knowledge of the Damned
knowledgeOfTheDamned__f89bbdb5.description: When a model in this model’s control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

soulTakerExhumator.name: Soul Taker: Exhumator
soulTakerExhumator.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within this model’s control range, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model’s activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

leadershipFactionLightWarjack.name: Leadership [Faction Light Warjack]
leadershipFactionLightWarjack.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction light warjack models gain Dodge.

interface.name: Interface
interface.description: While B2B with this model, a warjack in its battlegroup can spend focus points on this model.

salvage.name: Salvage
salvage.description: When this model destroys an enemy Cohort model with a melee attack, remove d3 +3 damage points from a model in this model's battlegroup currently in its control range.

bodySnatcherCorpseHarvester.name: Body Snatcher: Corpse Harvester
bodySnatcherCorpseHarvester.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead model is destroyed within 8" of this model or a Grunt in its unit, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

resurrectionistAction.name: •Resurrectionist (★Action)
resurrectionistAction.description: Remove up to three corpse tokens from this model to return one small-based friendly Grunt to a Thrall unit for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within within 8" of this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

necrosurgeryD31Action.name: Necrosurgery [d3+1] (★Action)
necrosurgeryD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly undead Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

sacrificialPawnThrall.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Thrall]
sacrificialPawnThrall.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Thrall model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

spareParts.name: Spare Parts
spareParts.description: When a warjack is destroyed within 5" of this model, it gains one scrap token. This model can have up to three scrap tokens at any time. Before making a repair roll, this model can spend one scrap token to add +2 to its roll

createScrapThrallAction.name: Create Scrap Thrall (★Action)
createScrapThrallAction.description: Remove one or more scrap tokens from this model, then roll a d3 for each scrap token removed. Place up to that number of Scrap Thralls into play completely within 3" of this model. A placed Scrap Thrall must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it is put into play

soulTakerBodyCount.name: Soul Taker: Body Count
soulTakerBodyCount.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When this model destroys a living enemy model with an attack, this model gains the destroyed model's soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

darkBlessing.name: •Dark Blessing
darkBlessing.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to gain +1 DEF. Dark Blessing lasts for one round.

apparition__ce79494c.name: Apparition
apparition__ce79494c.description: During your Control Phase, place this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location.

fieldMarshalFutureSight.name: Field Marshal [Future Sight]
fieldMarshalFutureSight.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Future Sight.

soulTakerCollector.name: Soul Taker: Collector
soulTakerCollector.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

soulTransferAction__9f781185.name: •Soul Transfer (★Action)
soulTransferAction__9f781185.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with a Soul Taker special rule. If the model is in range, remove any number of soul tokens from this model and place them on the target friendly model.

chainAttackDarkShroud.name: Chain Attack: Dark Shroud
chainAttackDarkShroud.description: If this model hits the same target with both its initial melee attacks, after resolving the attacks this model gains Dark Shroud for one turn. (While in the melee range of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

reversal.name: Reversal
reversal.description: When a model misses this model with a charge or a power attack, the attacking model becomes knocked down.

snapStrike.name: Snap Strike
snapStrike.description: This model can make one additional attack with each melee weapon for each focus or fury point spent to make additional attacks.

coven.name: Coven
coven.description: The Witch Coven of Garlghast is made up of Helleana, Morgaen, and Selene. The Coven shares a single focus pool, and Coven models do not receive focus individually. The Coven’s base ARC is three times the number of models in the Coven that are in play. When the Coven replenishes its focus, the Egregore receives those focus points. The Coven’s control range is measured from the Egregore. Any Coven model in the Coven’s control range can spend focus points on the Egregore. Effects that reduce or remove focus never affect the Egregore. The Coven can use its feat only once. The Coven counts as a single warcaster when calculating Field Allowance. The Coven can have up to one attached model, which is attached to the Coven, not to an individual model in the Coven. The Coven can have only one of each of its upkeep spells in play at any time.

perfectConjunction.name: Perfect Conjunction
perfectConjunction.description: A Perfect Conjunction is established any time the Egregore is completely within the triangular area between all three Witches. During a Perfect Conjunction, arcane attack rolls made by one of the Witches are automatically boosted.

inscrutable.name: Inscrutable
inscrutable.description: Opponents cannot take control of this model.

soulBondage.name: Soul Bondage
soulBondage.description: Once per round when a living enemy warrior model is destroyed within 2" of this model, you can replace the destroyed model with a Machine Wraith solo. The destroyed model is removed from play and does not provide a soul token.

unhallowed.name: Unhallowed
unhallowed.description: While within 10", friendly Faction undead models gain +2 ARM against ranged and arcane attacks.

wraithWalker.name: Wraith Walker
wraithWalker.description: At the end of your Control Phase, this model can gain Incorporeal for one round unless it gained Incorporeal during the last round.

cultists.name: Cultists
cultists.description: Choose one friendly living non-Morrowan Faction unit at the beginning of the game to be Cultists. Cultists are Thamarite models. This model can upkeep one spell without spending focus if there is one or more Cultist models in its control range during the Control Phase. Additionally, Cultist models do not suffer damage when spells are channeled through them as a result of Dark Rituals.

whiplash.name: Whiplash
whiplash.description: When an enemy model misses this model with an arcane attack, the attacking model becomes the target and is automatically hit by the attack. This model is the point of origin for all these attacks.

inquisitorsTalisman.name: Inquisitor’s Talisman
inquisitorsTalisman.description: This model begins the game with three power tokens. During its activation, this model can spend power tokens to make additional melee attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent.

stealthAction.name: •Stealth (★Action)
stealthAction.description: This model gains Stealth for one round.

powerVortex.name: Power Vortex
powerVortex.description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 power token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

catastrophicExplosion.name: Catastrophic Explosion
catastrophicExplosion.description: When this model is disabled by an enemy attack, enemy models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Then remove this model from play.

grantedInspiration.name: Granted: Inspiration
grantedInspiration.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.

bondCaine.name: Bond [Caine]
bondCaine.description: If Ace begins the game in Caine's’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ace is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. Each time Ace makes a Rune Shot Cannon ranged attack while bonded to Caine and in his control range, choose one of the following special rules:

shadowFire.name: Shadow Fire
shadowFire.description: A model hit by this attack does not block LOS for one turn.

thunderbolt.name: Thunderbolt
thunderbolt.description: Enemy models hit are pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.

ricochet.name: Ricochet
ricochet.description: When this model directly hits an enemy model with an attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make another ranged attack with this weapon targeting another model within 4" of the model originally hit, ignoring LOS and this weapon’s RNG. Attacks gained from Ricochet cannot generate additional attacks from Ricochet.

grantedSwiftHunter.name: Granted: Swift Hunter
grantedSwiftHunter.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Swift Hunter. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

momentOfClarity.name: Moment of Clarity
momentOfClarity.description: This model can use Moment of Clarity once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, models in this unit gain True Sight. (A model with True Sight ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. A model with True Sight also ignores Stealth.)

fineTuning.name: Fine Tuning
fineTuning.description: While Finch is within 10" of Nemo, he can upkeep one spell without spending focus.

companionArtificerGeneralNemo.name: Companion [Artificer General Nemo]
companionArtificerGeneralNemo.description: This model is included in any army that includes Artificer General Nemo. If Nemo is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Nemo's battlegroup.

powerBooster.name: Power Booster
powerBooster.description: When Nemo allocates one or more focus points to a warjack within 10" of Finch, the warjack is allocated 1 additional focus point.

focusChargedPolarityField.name: Focus-Charged: Polarity Field
focusChargedPolarityField.description: This model can spend 1 focus point at any time during its activation to gain Polarity Field for one round. (A model with Polarity Field cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.)

turbulence.name: Turbulence
turbulence.description: Models activating within 12" of this model lose Flight for one round.

activateLightningPod.name: Activate Lightning Pod
activateLightningPod.description: Once per activation, after the Stormwall’s Normal Movement, you can place one Lightning Pod anywhere completely within 10" of this model. When a Lightning Pod is placed, enemy models whose bases are intersected by a line drawn from the center of the Lightning Pod’s base to the center of this model’s base suffer a POW 10 electrical damage roll. Warjacks damaged by a Lightning Pod damage roll suffer Disruption. This model cannot have more than three Lightning Pods in play at any time. The S boxes of this model’s damage grid represent its Lightning Pod system. While its Lightning Pod system is crippled, this model cannot use Activate Lightning Pod.

conductor.name: Conductor
conductor.description: When a friendly Stormsmith Stormcaller makes a Surge or Triangulation special attack, this model is considered to be another friendly Stormsmith Stormcaller.

bondNemo.name: Bond [Nemo]
bondNemo.description: If Dynamo begins the game in Nemo’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Dynamo is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Dynamo is bonded to Nemo and in his control range, it can reroll missed ranged attack rolls. Attack rolls can be rerolled only once as a result of this bond.

chainReaction.name: Chain Reaction
chainReaction.description: When this model hits one or more enemy models with a melee or ranged attack during its activation, after the attack is resolved this model gains a cumulative +1 to its damage rolls on subsequent attacks that activation.

accumulatorStormKnightWarrior.name: Accumulator [Storm Knight warrior]
accumulatorStormKnightWarrior.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Storm Knight warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

concentratedFire.name: Concentrated Fire
concentratedFire.description: This activation, models in this unit gain a +1 cumulative bonus to ranged damage rolls for each other model in this unit that has hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this activation.

bondMaddox.name: Bond [Maddox]
bondMaddox.description: If Brickhouse begins the game in Maddox’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Brickhouse is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Brickhouse is bonded to Maddox, it gains Follow Up. (When a model with Follow Up slams an enemy model, immediately after the slam is resolved this model can advance directly toward the slammed model, up to the distance the slammed model was moved.)

forceLock.name: Force Lock
forceLock.description: Enemy models beginning an advance in this model’s melee range cannot advance.

arcaneReinforcementAction__eabbc0d4.name: •Arcane Reinforcement (★Action)
arcaneReinforcementAction__eabbc0d4.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Arcane Reinforcement lasts for one turn.

defensiveMeasuresAction.name: •Defensive Measures (★Action)
defensiveMeasuresAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, it gains Shield Guard for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

bondStryker.name: Bond [Stryker]
bondStryker.description: If Ol’ Rowdy begins the game in Stryker’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Ol’ Rowdy is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Ol’ Rowdy is bonded to Stryker and in his control range, both models gain +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.

activateHalfjack.name: Activate Halfjack
activateHalfjack.description: At the end of your Control Phase, you can put one Halfjack solo into play within 1" of this model if there are fewer than three Halfjacks in play in Darius’ battlegroup.

companionCaptainEDominicDarius.name: Companion [Captain E. Dominic Darius]
companionCaptainEDominicDarius.description: This model is included in any army that includes Captain E. Dominic Darius. If Darius is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Darius’ battlegroup. Place all three Halfjacks in play at the start of the game.

primeMineAction.name: Prime Mine (★Action)
primeMineAction.description: Replace this model with a mine marker. You can have up to three mine markers in play at any time. After resolving continuous effects during your Maintenance Phase, you can detonate any number of friendly mine markers. Models within 3" of a mine marker suffer an unboostable POW 14 blast damage roll, then the mine marker is removed from the table.

repair1Action.name: Repair [1] (★Action)
repair1Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove 1 damage point from it.

reserveAccumulator.name: Reserve Accumulator
reserveAccumulator.description: Once per turn during your Control Phase after replenishing focus, if this model is within 5" of its controlling Leader, the Leader can gain 1 focus point. If the Leader gains a focus point, roll a d6. On the roll of 1 or 2, this model loses the Reserve Accumulator special rule for the rest of the game.

sigilOfPowerAction__be94e6d6.name: Sigil of Power (★ Action)
sigilOfPowerAction__be94e6d6.description: RNG 6. Target friendly model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, its weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Sigil of Power lasts for one turn.

ironHorse.name: Iron Horse
ironHorse.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup activating in this model's control range gain Pathfinder and Reposition [3"]. Additionally, warjacks in this model’s battlegroup activating in this model’s control range gain +2 SPD when resolving charges. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

fieldMarshalTrueSight.name: Field Marshal [True Sight]
fieldMarshalTrueSight.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain True Sight.

arcaneVortex.name: Arcane Vortex
arcaneVortex.description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 focus or fury point. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

activateRocketTurret.name: Activate Rocket Turret
activateRocketTurret.description: Once per turn at any time during Brisbane’s activation, you can place a Rocket Turret anywhere completely within 3" of him unless he already has a Rocket Turret in play. The Rocket Turret cannot activate the turn it is put into play.

desperatePaceTrencherAction.name: Desperate Pace [Trencher] (★Action)
desperatePaceTrencherAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Trencher trooper model. If the model is in range,  models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

rocketPack.name: Rocket Pack
rocketPack.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one focus point to use Rocket Pack. During that activation, this model gains +2 SPD and Flight.

companionColonelBrisbane.name: Companion [Colonel Brisbane]
companionColonelBrisbane.description: This model is included in any army that includes Colonel Markus "Siege" Brisbane. If Brisbane is destroyed or removed from play, remove this model from play. This model is part of Brisbane’s battlegroup.

packItUp.name: Pack It Up
packItUp.description: If this model is in play during your Maintenance Phase, you can remove it from play.

sentryFire.name: Sentry Fire
sentryFire.description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed within 8" of this model, this model can immediately make one basic ranged attack targeting that model.

turret.name: Turret
turret.description: This model cannot advance. This model cannot become knocked down or be pushed and is automatically hit by melee attacks. This model does not suffer blast damage.

arcaneAccumulator.name: Arcane Accumulator
arcaneAccumulator.description: When another model in this model’s control range casts a spell, this model gains one power token. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. After this model replenishes its focus during your next Control Phase, replace each power token with 1 focus point.

overpower.name: Overpower
overpower.description: After this model replenishes its focus during your Control Phase but before it allocates focus, this model can spend focus to increase its control range for one round by 2" for each focus point spent.

foxholeBuddy.name: Foxhole Buddy
foxholeBuddy.description: While B2B with a friendly model that is dug in, this model gains cover, Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS.

bondSiege.name: Bond [Siege]
bondSiege.description: If Triumph begins the game in Siege’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Triumph is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Triumph is bonded to Siege and in his control range, it gains boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

rapidFire.name: Rapid Fire
rapidFire.description: This model can make one basic ranged attack during your Maintenance Phase.

chainAttackFlash.name: Chain Attack: Flash
chainAttackFlash.description: If this model hits the same target with both its initial melee attacks, after resolving the attacks you can immediately place this model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location.

repairD3Action__d257609f.name: Repair [d3] (★Action)
repairD3Action__d257609f.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

focusMatrix.name: Focus Matrix
focusMatrix.description: This model can allocate focus points during its activation. Once per turn during its activation, you can remove focus points from warjacks in this model’s battlegroup that are in its control range and give those focus points to this model. This model cannot have more focus points than its ARC as a result of Focus Matrix.

timeProjection.name: Time Projection
timeProjection.description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. During your Control Phase, this model can allocate focus points to warjacks in its control range that are in Haley Prime’s battlegroup. This model can channel spells through warjacks in Haley Prime’s battlegroup that have the Arc Node advantage and are in this model’s control range.

rawTalent.name: Raw Talent
rawTalent.description: This model gains an additional die on damage rolls.

bondHaley.name: Bond [Haley]
bondHaley.description: If Thorn begins the game in Haley’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Thorn is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Thorn is bonded to Haley and in her control range, Haley can channel spells through Thorn as if it were not engaged.

reactionDrive.name: Reaction Drive
reactionDrive.description: Once per turn immediately after this model’s controller channels a spell through it, this model can advance 3".

rangeAmplifier.name: Range Amplifier
rangeAmplifier.description: When this model casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +5 RNG.

dualShot.name: Dual Shot
dualShot.description: If this model/unit uses its Normal Movement to aim, this model can make one additional ranged attack this activation.

overload.name: Overload
overload.description: Once per activation, you can roll one to three dice. This model gains a bonus to its melee attack damage rolls equal to the total of that roll. Then roll the same dice again. This model suffers damage equal to the total of that roll. This model cannot spend a focus point to reduce this damage. This bonus expires at the end of this model’s activation.

ionization10.name: Ionization [10"]
ionization10.description: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within 10" of this model, add +2 to the roll.

combatEngineer.name: Combat Engineer
combatEngineer.description: This model gains an additional die on its damage rolls against buildings and structures.

timeWalker.name: Time Walker
timeWalker.description:
At any time during this model's activation, it can spend 2 focus points to return Haley Past or Haley Future to play. Place that model completely within 2" of this model. The returned model gains a number of focus points equal to its ARC and cannot activate this turn.

After this model replenishes its focus points during your Control Phase, it can spend 2 focus points each to keep Haley Past and/or Haley Future in play. If it does not, that model is removed from the table.

reiteration.name: Reiteration
reiteration.description: This model can cast any spell cast by another friendly Haley model this activation as if it were one of its own spells.

leadershipTrencher.name: Leadership [Trencher]
leadershipTrencher.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Trencher models gain Dodge.

polarityField.name: Polarity Field
polarityField.description: This model cannot be targeted by a charge or slam power attack made by a construct model.

buildUpPower.name: Build Up Power
buildUpPower.description: If this model advances during its Normal Movement, it gains 3 power tokens. This model can have up to three power tokens at any time. During its activation, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

repulsorField__8b763fde.name: Repulsor Field
repulsorField__8b763fde.description: When this model is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from this model.

desperatePaceSmallBasedStormKnight.name: •Desperate Pace [small-based Storm Knight]
desperatePaceSmallBasedStormKnight.description: RNG 5. Target friendly small-based Storm Knight trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2" movement during their Normal Movement this turn

flankTrencher.name: Flank [Trencher]
flankTrencher.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Trencher model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

reinforcementsTrencher.name: Reinforcements [Trencher]
reinforcementsTrencher.description: During your Maintenance Phase, return d3 small-based friendly destroyed Trencher Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts within 8" this model and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

trenchNetwork.name: Trench Network
trenchNetwork.description: Immediately after placing this model during deployment, you can place up to two trench terrain features on the table. These trench terrain features must be placed either in base contact with this model or in contact with a trench terrain feature that is in base contact with this model. These trench terrain features cannot be placed in contact with a non-trench terrain feature.

ammoFeederAction.name: Ammo Feeder (★Action)
ammoFeederAction.description: While this model is B2B with the Gunner, the Gunner’s ranged attack damage rolls against warrior models are boosted. Ammo Feeder lasts for one round.

cautiousAdvance.name: Cautious Advance
cautiousAdvance.description:
This model can use Cautious Advance once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. This activation, this unit must make a full advance as its Normal Movement, then each model in the unit performs the Dig In special action and can take their Combat
Actions.

grantedPrecisionFire.name: Granted: Precision Fire
grantedPrecisionFire.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit can reroll ranged attack damage rolls. Each damage roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Precision Fire.

grantedSpellWard.name: Granted: Spell Ward
grantedSpellWard.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit cannot be targeted by spells.

craftThrallRuneAction.name: •Craft Thrall Rune (★Action)
craftThrallRuneAction.description: Choose a Risen Grunt in this unit and replace it with a Thrall Warrior solo. Remove the Risen Grunt model from play.

dominateUndeadAttack.name: •Dominate Undead (★Attack)
dominateUndeadAttack.description: Dominate Undead is a RNG 10 arcane attack. Take control of target enemy non-Leader undead warrior model hit. You can immediately make a full advance with that model followed by a basic melee attack, then Dominate Undead expires. A model can be affected by Dominate Undead only once per turn.

bodySnatcherStirTheDead.name: Body Snatcher: Stir the Dead
bodySnatcherStirTheDead.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living model is destroyed within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. At the end of your next Control Phase, remove all corpse tokens from this model and add one Risen Grunt to this unit for each corpse token removed. Place Risen Grunts within 2" on another model in this unit. This unit cannot have more than ten Risen Grunts in play at any time.

graveSummonsAction.name: •Grave Summons (★Action)
graveSummonsAction.description: When this model uses Grave Summons it can spend any number of soul tokens. For each soul token spent put one friendly Thrall Warrior solo into play anywhere completely within 3" of this model.

nullMagicAction.name: •Null Magic (★Action)
nullMagicAction.description: For one round, models cannot cast spells while within 10" of this model.

powerOfDeathAction.name: •Power of Death (★Action)
powerOfDeathAction.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly undead models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Power of Death lasts for one turn.

flankUndead.name: Flank [Undead]
flankUndead.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Undead model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

leadershipUndead.name: Leadership [Undead]
leadershipUndead.description: While a friendly Undead is within 10" of this model, it gains Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

passiveNecromancy.name: Passive Necromancy
passiveNecromancy.description: Once per turn when another living warrior model is boxed while within 10" of this model, you can choose to remove the boxed model from play and replace it with a Thrall Warrior model. The Thrall Warrior must forfeit its Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

grantedReposition3.name: Granted: Reposition [3"]
grantedReposition3.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Reposition [3"]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

ayislasVeilAction.name: •Ayisla’s Veil (★ Action)
ayislasVeilAction.description: Models in this unit gain Stealth for one round.

kissOfLylissAttack.name: •Kiss of Lyliss (★ Attack)
kissOfLylissAttack.description: Kiss of Lyliss is a RNG 10 arcane attack. When a friendly Faction model makes a damage roll against a model/unit hit by Kiss of Lyliss, add +2 to the roll. Kiss of Lyliss lasts for one turn.

grantedForceBarrier.name: Granted: Force Barrier
grantedForceBarrier.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Force Barrier. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

artificeOfDomination.name: Artifice of Domination
artificeOfDomination.description: When this model hits an enemy model with an attack, it gains a mind token. This model can have up to 5 mind tokens on it at any time. This model can spend mind tokens for the following:

mentalReservoir.name: •Mental Reservoir
mentalReservoir.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend mind tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each token spent.

manifestControl.name: •Manifest Control
manifestControl.description: After this model casts a spell, it can spend a mind token to cast a spell it has not already cast this turn.

psychicOverloadAttack.name: •Psychic Overload (★Attack)
psychicOverloadAttack.description: Psychic Overload is a RNG 8, POW 13 arcane attack. When this attack boxes a living or undead enemy model, you can take control of it and make a 3" advance. Then, enemy models within 2" of it suffer a POW 10 unboostable magical blast damage roll. These damage rolls are not from an attack. The boxed model is then removed from play.

expendableAssetAction.name: Expendable Asset (★Action)
expendableAssetAction.description: RNG 3. Remove target friendly model from play. This model gains a mind token.

telekineticShiftAction.name: •Telekinetic Shift (★Action)
telekineticShiftAction.description: Place the spellcaster completely within 5" of its current location.

longShadows.name: Long Shadows
longShadows.description: When one or more living enemy models are destroyed by an arcane attack while in this model’s control range, this model gains one focus or fury point.

instigateAction.name: •Instigate (★Action)
instigateAction.description: While within 5"of this model, friendly large-based and smaller monstrosities gain +2 on attack and damage rolls. Instigate lasts for one turn.

sacrificialPawnMonstrosity.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Monstrosity]
sacrificialPawnMonstrosity.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Monstrosity within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

healD33Action.name: •Heal [d3+3] (★Action)
healD33Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+3 damage points from it.

tuneUpAction.name: •Tune Up (★ Action)
tuneUpAction.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction cohort. If the cohort is in range, it immediately stands up and is no longer stationary, continuous effects on the cohort expire, and the cohort gains Pathfinder for one turn.

defenseFormation.name: Defense Formation
defenseFormation.description: While in this model’s control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, models in this model's battlegroup with an extra-large base or smaller gain +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down.

battleDriven.name: Battle-Driven
battleDriven.description: When one or more models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gains +2 ARM, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

lastWord.name: Last Word
lastWord.description: When this model is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.

cerebralChanneling.name: Cerebral Channeling
cerebralChanneling.description: While this model is in a friendly Faction Leader’s control range, the Leader can channel spells through it. After a spell has been channeled through this model it becomes disabled.

mindBurst.name: Mind Burst
mindBurst.description: Once per turn at any time during this model's activation, you can choose one grunt in this unit. Enemy models within 2" of the chosen grunt suffer an unboostable POW 12 magic blast damage roll, then the chosen grunt is removed from play.

grantedShieldGuard.name: Granted: Shield Guard
grantedShieldGuard.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

grantedBloodBound.name: Granted: Blood-Bound
grantedBloodBound.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Blood-Bound. (When a model with Blood-Bound destroys a living enemy model with an attack, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in its unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of the attacking model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed enemy model is removed from play and does not provide a soul or corpse token.)

vitalizerAction.name: •Vitalizer (★ Action)
vitalizerAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly monstrosity. If the target monstrosity is in range, it gains 1 focus point.

befuddleAttack.name: •Befuddle (★Attack)
befuddleAttack.description: Befuddle  is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a hit, you can immediately take control and advance target  enemy non-Leader model up to 3" then Befuddle expires. A model can move only once per turn as a result of Befuddle.

healD31Action__acef6735.name: •Heal [d3+1] (★ Action)
healD31Action__acef6735.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

alphaHunter.name: Alpha Hunter
alphaHunter.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range can run, charge, or make power attacks without being forced. When this model destroys one or more enemy models during its activation, warbeasts in its battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and MAT for one turn.

exorcist.name: Exorcist
exorcist.description: While within 10" of this model, enemy models lose Incorporeal.

leadershipBlightedOgrun.name: Leadership [Blighted Ogrun]
leadershipBlightedOgrun.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Ogrun models gain Rise.

unbindingAction__d4813fb8.name: Unbinding (★Action)
unbindingAction__d4813fb8.description: Enemy upkeep spells on models/units within 5" of this model expire. For each upkeep spell that expires as a result of Unbinding, the model maintaining the spell suffers d3 damage points.

ritualSlaughter.name: Ritual Slaughter
ritualSlaughter.description: Once during each of your turns when another friendly Blighted Ogrun model destroys an enemy model with an attack while in this model’s control range, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending fury. This model can spend fury to boost attack and damage rolls on spells cast as a result of Ritual Slaughter.

blightedBreath.name: Blighted Breath
blightedBreath.description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, choose one of the following Blighted Breath effects. While within 6" of this model, models are affected by the chosen effect. Blighted Breath effects last for one round. If this model frenzies, it must choose Withering Ash at the start of its activation.

dragonSBreath.name: •Dragon's Breath
dragonSBreath.description: Affected friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 ARM and +2 to their melee attack damage rolls.

spiritualCorruption.name: •Spiritual Corruption
spiritualCorruption.description: Affected enemy models cannot cast or channel spells.

sittingVulture.name: Sitting Vulture
sittingVulture.description: While B2B with this model, enemy models suffer –1 DEF.

ferocious.name: Ferocious
ferocious.description: During its activation, this model can spend fury points to make additional attacks or to boost attack or damage rolls. It can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each fury point spent.

blightShroudAction.name: •Blight Shroud (★Action)
blightShroudAction.description: Remove all fury points from this model. Enemy models within 1" of this model for each fury point removed suffer a POW 8 magical damage roll. Add an additional die to the damage roll for each focus or fury point on the enemy model. This model must have at least 1 fury point to make a Blight Shroud special action.

consumeFuryAction.name: •Consume Fury (★Action)
consumeFuryAction.description: RNG 8. Target friendly Faction warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, remove up to 5 fury points from it and place them on this model. This model can have up to 5 fury points at any time.

bondAnamag.name: Bond [Anamag]
bondAnamag.description: If Golab begins the game in Anamag’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Golab is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Golab is bonded to Anamag and in her control range, Anamag and Golab both gain Swarm. (A model with Swarm gains concealment. Living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of a model with Swarm.)

carrionFeast.name: Carrion Feast
