carrionFeast.description: When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of this model, you can choose to have that model be removed from play. If a model is removed from play as a result of Carrion Feast, it does not generate a corpse token and this model can remove d3 damage points.

veteranLeaderBlightedRotwing.name: Veteran Leader [Blighted Rotwing]
veteranLeaderBlightedRotwing.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Rotwing models gain +1 to attack rolls.

leadershipGrotesques.name: Leadership [Grotesques]
leadershipGrotesques.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Grotesques models gain Stealth.

tendrils.name: Tendrils
tendrils.description: If there are fewer than three Tentacles in this unit in play during your Maintenance Phase, you can put one Tentacle into play within 2" of this model. If this model is destroyed or removed from play, the Tentacles in its unit are removed from play.

blazingPath.name: Blazing Path
blazingPath.description: While in this model's' control range, warbeasts in its battlegroup can charge or power attack slam an enemy model suffering the Fire continuous effect without being forced. Additionally, when a friendly Faction model in this model's control range begins a charge or slam power attack targeting an enemy model suffering the Fire continuous effect the charging or slamming model gains +2 SPD

fieldMarshalHandOfTheDragon.name: Field Marshal [Hand of the Dragon]
fieldMarshalHandOfTheDragon.description: The weapons of warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Continuous Effect: Fire.

bondAbsylonia.name: Bond [Absylonia]
bondAbsylonia.description: If Proteus begins the game in Absylonia's battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Proteus is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Proteus is bonded to Absylonia and in her control range, its melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. (A model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

flankFriendlyFactionWarbeast.name: Flank [friendly Faction warbeast]
flankFriendlyFactionWarbeast.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Faction warbeast, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

athanc.name: Athanc
athanc.description: Immediately after leeching, this model gains up to its ARC in fury points. It cannot exceed its ARC in fury points as a result of Athanc.

spontaneousMutation.name: Spontaneous Mutation
spontaneousMutation.description: This model can suffer damage at any time during its activation to gain one of the following special rules for each damage point suffered. This damage cannot be transferred. Each special rule lasts until the start of this model’s next activation.

ashenVeil__0da80bef.name: •Ashen Veil
ashenVeil__0da80bef.description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

bondThagrosh.name: Bond [Thagrosh]
bondThagrosh.description: If Typhon begins the game in Thagrosh’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Typhon is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. When Typhon is forced to use Regeneration while bonded to Thagrosh and in his control range, instead of rolling to determine how many damage points this model removes, Typhon and Thagrosh can each remove up to 3 damage points.

bloodSpawn.name: Blood Spawn
bloodSpawn.description: Once per game, when this model suffers damage from an enemy attack and the damage is not transferred, after the attack is resolved you can place a non-character Faction lesser warbeast in play anywhere completely within 3" of this model. The warbeast is part of this model’s battlegroup. The warbeast cannot activate this turn.

sacrificialPawnLesserWarbeast.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Lesser Warbeast]
sacrificialPawnLesserWarbeast.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal lesser warbeast within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

frostbiteAttack.name: •Frostbite (★Attack)
frostbiteAttack.description: Frostbite is a RNG Sp 8 arcane attack. Models hit suffer a POW 12 cold damage roll. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

spineBurstAttack.name: •Spine Burst (★Attack)
spineBurstAttack.description: Spine Burst is a RNG 10, POW 10 arcane attack. If target model is hit, the d3 nearest models within 5" of it suffer a POW 10 magical damage roll. These additional damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Spine Burst damage rolls are simultaneous.

bloodDrinker.name: Blood Drinker
bloodDrinker.description: Immediately after this model resolves a melee attack in which it destroys one or more living models, it can end its activation and remove d3 damage points.

leadershipBlightedOgruns.name: Leadership [Blighted Ogruns]
leadershipBlightedOgruns.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Ogrun models gain Blood Drinker.

desperatePaceImmortal.name: •Desperate Pace [Immortal]
desperatePaceImmortal.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Immortal trooper model. If the model is in range, the models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

wingsOfDeath.name: •Wings of Death
wingsOfDeath.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Construct warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Incorporeal for one round. If the model is in range and is a trooper model, the models in its unit also gain Incorporeal for one round.

agonies.name: Agonies
agonies.description: Once at any time during its activation, this model can be forced to use one of the following effects:

gnawingPain.name: •Gnawing Pain
gnawingPain.description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Gnawing Pain lasts for one round.

maddening.name: •Maddening
maddening.description: Enemy warbeasts currently within 6" of this model gain 1 fury point.

spiritualAffliction.name: •Spiritual Affliction
spiritualAffliction.description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models cannot cast spells. Spiritual Affliction lasts for one round.

spiritDriven.name: •Spirit-Driven
spiritDriven.description: At the beginning of this model’s activation, it can spend one soul token to gain +2 SPD that activation.

huntingPackAradus.name: Hunting Pack [Aradus]
huntingPackAradus.description: This model gains a +1 cumulative bonus to melee attack and damage rolls for each other friendly Aradus warbeast with the target of this model’s melee attack in its melee range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

fieldMarshalPathfinder.name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder]
fieldMarshalPathfinder.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder.

bondXekaar.name: Bond [Xekaar]
bondXekaar.description: If Chiron begins the game in Xekaar’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Chiron is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Chiron is bonded to Xekaar and in his control range, it gains boosted ranged attack rolls.

leadershipBasilisks.name: Leadership [Basilisks]
leadershipBasilisks.description: When another friendly Basilisk model ends its activation while within 10" of this model, you can remove 1 fury point from that model.

craftTalismanAction.name: Craft Talisman (★ Action)
craftTalismanAction.description: RNG 5. Target a friendly Leader model. If the Leader is in range, when it casts a spell and is the point of origin, the spell gains +2 RNG. Spells with RNG SELF or CTRL are not affected. Craft Talisman lasts for one turn.

primalMagic.name: Primal Magic
primalMagic.description: This model can be forced to cast the animus of any friendly Faction warbeast within 5" of it as if the animus were its own.

bondMordikaar.name: Bond [Mordikaar]
bondMordikaar.description: If Despoiler begins the game in Mordikaar’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Despoiler is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Despoiler is bonded to Mordikaar and in his control range, once per turn when a living enemy warrior model is boxed while within 5" of this model, remove the boxed model from play and replace it with a friendly Void Spirit model.

sacrificialPawnImmortal.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Immortal]
sacrificialPawnImmortal.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Immortal model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

graveMist.name: •Grave Mist
graveMist.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to give models in its unit +2 DEF for one round.

leadershipConstruct.name: Leadership [Construct]
leadershipConstruct.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Construct models cannot become knocked down.

stonesWrathAction.name: •Stones’ Wrath (★Action)
stonesWrathAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls this turn.

spiritGuideAction.name: •Spirit Guide (★Action)
spiritGuideAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model with Soul Taker: Requiem. If the model is in range, move any number of soul tokens to it from this model.

vampiricHarvest.name: Vampiric Harvest
vampiricHarvest.description: When a living enemy model is destroyed in this model’s control range, a model in this model’s battlegroup that is in its control range can remove 1 damage point.

veteranLeaderPaingiverBloodrunners.name: Veteran Leader [Paingiver Bloodrunners]
veteranLeaderPaingiverBloodrunners.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Paingiver Bloodrunner models gain +1 to attack rolls.

directSpirits.name: Direct Spirits
directSpirits.description: When a friendly living Faction warrior model is destroyed within 10" of this model and generates a soul token, you choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model’s soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from friendly models destroyed within 10" of this model.

vaultOfTheFaithful.name: Vault of the Faithful
vaultOfTheFaithful.description: During your Maintenance Phase, you can remove up to three soul tokens from this model to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within within 12" of this model and completely within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

leadershipVoidSpirits.name: Leadership [Void Spirits]
leadershipVoidSpirits.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Void Spirit models gain Tough and Stealth.

annihilator.name: Annihilator
annihilator.description: This model gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls against living models. When a living model is destroyed within 3" of this model, it never generates a soul token.

spymaster.name: Spymaster
spymaster.description: The first time Ashmael hits an enemy model with each of the following types of attack each turn, he gains one hunger point: melee attack, ranged attack, arcane attack. Friendly Faction models have the following hunger abilities.

misdirect2.name: •Misdirect [2]
misdirect2.description: When a friendly Faction model within 3" of this non-leader, non-incorporeal model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, this model can spend two hunger points to be directly hit by the attack instead. Each model can only use this ability once per turn.

stolenFate1.name: •Stolen Fate [1]
stolenFate1.description: When this model makes an attack roll, it can spend one hunger point to roll a separate die that is not added to the total. If that separate die result is the same as another die used in the attack roll, and the attack hits, it is a critical hit.

corrupt6.name: •Corrupt [6]
corrupt6.description: When the opponent scores one or more victory points by securing one of their scenario elements, Ashmeal can spend six hunger points to place a corruption token on it. When you score one or more victory points by securing a scenario element with a corruption token, score one additional point and remove the token. This ability can only be used on each scenario element once per game.

flankFinalHunt.name: Flank [Final Hunt]
flankFinalHunt.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Final Hunt model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

allyOfNecessity.name: Ally of Necessity
allyOfNecessity.description: This model cannot use hunger abilities.

unholyGlamour.name: Unholy Glamour
unholyGlamour.description: When this model directly hits an enemy non-Leader model with an attack, you can take control of the enemy model and make a 3" advance with it, then Unholy Glamour expires. A model can be affected by Unholy Glamour only once per turn.

grantedAshenVeil.name: Granted: Ashen Veil
grantedAshenVeil.description: While this model is in play, models in this unit gain Ashen Veil. (A model with Ashen Veil has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of a model with Ashen Veil.)

grantedResistanceBlast__7eabc3bb.name: Granted: Resistance Blast
grantedResistanceBlast__7eabc3bb.description: Whie this model is in play, models in this unit gain Resistance: Blast.

unbowed.name: Unbowed
unbowed.description: While this model is within 10" of a friendly Faction Eldritch Leader model, it gains +3 ARM.

executioner.name: Executioner
executioner.description: When Hysene destroys an enemy model, she gains one hunger point. Hysene and friendly Faction Eldritch models have the following Hunger Abilities.

brutalStrike7.name: •Brutal Strike [7]
brutalStrike7.description: This model can spend seven hunger points to gain Decapitation on their next melee attack this turn. If the attack destroys an enemy model, Hysene gains three hunger points. (Damage from an attack with Decapitation that exceeds the ARM of the model hit is doubled. A model disabled by the attack cannot make a tough roll.)

murderousImpulse2.name: •Murderous Impulse [2]
murderousImpulse2.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, after that attack is resolved this model can spend two hunger points to make one additional melee attack.

deathlyRepose1.name: •Deathly Repose [1]
deathlyRepose1.description: This model can spend one hunger point at the start of its Maintenance Phase. If it does, all shakeable and Continuous effects on it expire.

ruptureEssence.name: Rupture Essence
ruptureEssence.description: During a friendly Eldritch Leader model’s activation, this model can be removed from play. If it is, the Leader model gains a number of hunger points equal to the current round number.

sorcerousUnbindingAction.name: •Sorcerous Unbinding (★ Action)
sorcerousUnbindingAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Eldritch Leader model. If the model is in range, enemy upkeep spells on it expire.

limitedBattlegroupBenkeiAndSasha.name: Limited Battlegroup [Benkei and Sasha]
limitedBattlegroupBenkeiAndSasha.description: The only warbeasts that can be in this model’s battlegroup are Benkei and Sasha.

feast1.name: Feast [1]
feast1.description: Once per turn during this model's activation, when it boxes an enemy model with a melee attack, it can remove the enemy model from play. If it does, this model’s battlegroup controller gains one hunger point.

destructiveTorpor.name: Destructive Torpor
destructiveTorpor.description: If this model frenzies during your Control Phase, it can activate that turn as normal.

bondedEssence.name: Bonded Essence
bondedEssence.description: This first time this model suffers damage from an enemy attack each turn, its battlegroup controller gains one hunger point.

rabid.name: Rabid
rabid.description: During its activation, this model can suffer 1 damage point to its Body to boost a melee attack or damage roll. The damage is suffered after the roll is resolved.

feast2.name: Feast [2]
feast2.description: Once per turn during this model's activation, when it boxes an enemy model with a melee attack, it can remove the enemy model from play. If it does, this model’s battlegroup controller gains two hunger points.

snatchDrag.name: Snatch & Drag
snatchDrag.description: When this model hits an enemy non-Leader model with an initial melee attack, it can advance 2" after the attack is resolved. The model hit can then be pushed any distance directly towards this model.

conditioned.name: Conditioned
conditioned.description: When this model frenzies, you can choose any non-Leader enemy model within 10" of it to be the charge target, instead of the closest model.

cloakedInDarkness.name: Cloaked in Darkness
cloakedInDarkness.description: When this model uses the Shadow Shift hunger ability, it can spend the hunger points when it is hit, instead of after the attack has been resolved. If it does, it suffers no damage from the attack and resolves the Shadow Shift effects immediately.

bitterReprisal.name: Bitter Reprisal
bitterReprisal.description: If a friendly Final Hunt model within 10" of this unit was damaged by an enemy attack during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase models in this unit can make a Vengeance Move. (A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic attack. A model can only make one Vengeance move each turn.)

predatory.name: Predatory
predatory.description: This model’s melee attack rolls against non-Leader warrior models are boosted.

homeBack.name: Home Back
homeBack.description: After this model frenzies, it can make a full advance towards its battlegroup controller.

rampantFury.name: Rampant Fury
rampantFury.description: Once per turn, after this model frenzies, it immediately frenzies again as part of the same activation.

bondSeverius.name: Bond [Severius]
bondSeverius.description: If this model begins the game in Severius’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. Once per turn, when Severius channels a spell through this model, he gains +2 to that spell’s attack and damage rolls.

passageAction.name: •Passage (★Action)
passageAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it cannot be targeted by non-magical ranged attacks. Passage lasts for one round.

battleAction.name: •Battle (★Action)
battleAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it gains +2 to its damage rolls. Battle lasts for one turn.

hymn.name: Hymn
hymn.description: When a model in this unit performs a Hymn special action, choose a hymn. Each activation, all models in this unit performing a hymn must perform the same one. A model can only be affected by one hymn at any time.

shieldingAction.name: •Shielding (★Action)
shieldingAction.description: RNG 5.  Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range, it cannot be targeted by enemy spells. Shielding lasts for one round.

sideStep__84be4050.name: Side Step
sideStep__84be4050.description: When this model hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, it can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.

driveRhythmOfSteel.name: Drive: Rhythm of Steel
driveRhythmOfSteel.description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Flank [Bastion]. (When a model with Flank [Bastion] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Bastion model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

leadershipExemplarBastions.name: Leadership [Exemplar Bastions]
leadershipExemplarBastions.description: Friendly Exemplar Bastion models can remove 1 damage point when they begin an activation within 10" of one or more Exemplar Bastion Seneschals

bondKreoss.name: Bond [Kreoss]
bondKreoss.description: If this model begins the game in Kreoss’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to Kreoss and in his control range, it gains Divine Inspiration. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

relentlessCharge__bfa913af.name: Relentless Charge
relentlessCharge__bfa913af.description: While advancing as part of a charge, this model gains Pathfinder.

roadblock__67d34acf.name: Roadblock
roadblock__67d34acf.description: This model provides cover to friendly models as if it were an obstacle. This model loses Roadblock while it is incorporeal or knocked down.

grantedTakeDown.name: Granted: Take Down
grantedTakeDown.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Take Down. (Models disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down cannot make a Tough roll. Models boxed by a melee attack made by a model with Take Down are removed from play.)

vengeance__9d6cee60.name: Vengeance
vengeance__9d6cee60.description: During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in this unit were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

selfSacrifice__acd6e19c.name: Self-Sacrifice
selfSacrifice__acd6e19c.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in this unit within 3" of this model to be destroyed and this model removes 1 damage point.

purity.name: Purity
purity.description: This model can use Purity once per game at any time during its unit’s activation. Enemy upkeep spells and animi on this unit immediately expire. Models in this unit cannot be targeted by enemy spells. Purity lasts for one round.

callToSacrificeExemplarErrantTrooper.name: Call to Sacrifice [Exemplar Errant trooper]
callToSacrificeExemplarErrantTrooper.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Exemplar Errant trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

leadershipExemplarErrants.name: Leadership [Exemplar Errants]
leadershipExemplarErrants.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar Errants models gain Unyielding.

inhumanResolve__285ccca6.name: Inhuman Resolve
inhumanResolve__285ccca6.description: When a friendly Faction model within 10" of this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model can remove 1 damage point. When this model is disabled, it becomes knocked down instead of becoming boxed and its activation immediately ends. While this model is disabled, it cannot activate. If this model is disabled at the beginning of your Maintenance Phase, it is destroyed.

paragonOfTheFaith.name: Paragon of the Faith
paragonOfTheFaith.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar warrior models gain Tough.

eyeOfMenoth.name: Eye of Menoth
eyeOfMenoth.description: While in this model’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.

ashenVeil__d1b8dfab.name: Ashen Veil
ashenVeil__d1b8dfab.description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Immunity: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

desperateMission.name: •Desperate Mission
desperateMission.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Last Word. Desperate Mission lasts for one round. (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.)

brothersKeeperExemplar.name: Brother’s Keeper [Exemplar]
brothersKeeperExemplar.description: While  within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar models cannot become knocked down or stationary.

desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedExemplar_.name: •Desperate Pace [small- or medium-based Exemplar]
desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedExemplar_.description: RNG 5. Target friendly small- or medium-based Exemplar trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2" movement during their Normal Movement this turn.

reliquary.name: Reliquary
reliquary.description: This model gains an additional die on attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Reliquary.

battleDriven__23e1b5c2.name: Battle-Driven
battleDriven__23e1b5c2.description: When one or more models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gain +2 ARM, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

glimpseOfFate.name: •Glimpse of Fate
glimpseOfFate.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, it gains Future Sight. Glimpse of Fate lasts for one turn. (A model with Future Sight can boost attack and damage rolls after rolling.)

ashesOfUrcaen.name: •Ashes of Urcaen
ashesOfUrcaen.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model. If the target model is in range, it gains Ashen Veil. Ashes of Urcaen lasts for one round.

soulTransferAction.name: •Soul Transfer (★Action)
soulTransferAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with a Soul Taker special rule. If the model is in range, remove any number of soul tokens from this model and place them on the target friendly model.

feretory.name: Feretory
feretory.description: This model ignores concealment and Stealth. Additionally, this model’s weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. While its S system is disabled, this model loses the benefits of Feretory.

bondReznik.name: Bond [Reznik]
bondReznik.description: If Scourge of Heresy begins the game in Reznik’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Scourge of Heresy is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. Once per turn when Reznik destroys an enemy model or causes it to be removed from play as a result of a melee attack while Scourge of Heresy is bonded to him and in his control range, immediately after the attack is resolved Scourge of Heresy can make a full advance.

curseBattlegroup.name: Curse [Battlegroup]
curseBattlegroup.description: This model can use Curse once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model/unit within 10" of this model. Models in this model’s battlegroup gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Curse lasts for one turn.

threshingBlades.name: Threshing Blades
threshingBlades.description: This model gains +4 to its trample power attack damage rolls.

pathOfUrcaen.name: •Path of Urcaen
pathOfUrcaen.description: You can spend soul tokens on this model at any time during its activation to use Path of Urcaen. For each soul token you spend, you can choose one friendly Faction model in this model’s control range to gain Ghostly for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

wellOfSouls.name: Well of Souls
wellOfSouls.description: This model begins the game with three soul tokens.

arcaneBoltAttack.name: •Arcane Bolt (★Attack)
arcaneBoltAttack.description: Arcane Bolt is a RNG 12, POW 11 arcane attack.

menothSSightAction.name: •Menoth's Sight (★Action)
menothSSightAction.description: Choose a friendly Faction model. While within 6" of this model, the chosen model gains Eyeless Sight. Menoth’s Sight lasts for one turn.

wagesOfDeath.name: Wages of Death
wagesOfDeath.description: When this model makes an attack or damage roll, it can suffer 1 damage point to reroll the roll. Each attack or damage roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Wages of Death.

ammoCrate.name: Ammo Crate
ammoCrate.description: Once per attack, when a friendly Gravedigger model within 2" of this model makes a ranged attack during its activation, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the attacking model’s ranged weapon gains +2 POW when resolving that attack.

crate.name: Crate
crate.description: This model cannot have damage removed from it.

arcaneAmmunition.name: Arcane Ammunition
arcaneAmmunition.description: While within 2" of this model, friendy Faction models' ranged weapons gain Damage Type: Magical.

medicalCrate.name: Medical Crate
medicalCrate.description: At any time during its activation, a friendly living Faction model within 2" of this model can cause it to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, either remove d3+2 damage from the living model or return one destroyed non-character model to its unit. The model returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned model within 2" of the model that caused this model to suffer damage. The returned model must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is returned to play.

battlefieldMedicine.name: Battlefield Medicine
battlefieldMedicine.description: When a friendly model with Tough is disabled while within 2" of this model, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, remove 1 damage point from the model with Tough; it is no longer disabled and does not become knocked down.

weaponCrate.name: Weapon Crate
weaponCrate.description: When a friendly Valiant warjack without a Heavy Weapon contacts this crate, it can gain a Heavy Flamethrower, Howitzer, or Rocket Pod Heavy Weapon, then the crate is removed from play. The warjack gains the heavy weapon and +1 ARM for the rest of the game. Additionally, the turn the warjack gains the Heavy Weapon it also gains one focus point.

heavyWeaponHardpoint.name: Heavy Weapon Hardpoint
heavyWeaponHardpoint.description: This model can have an airdropped heavy weapon.

eliteCadreJackMarshal.name: Elite Cadre [Jack Marshal]
eliteCadreJackMarshal.description: When a model controlling this warjack makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of this warjack the controller gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

mantlet.name: Mantlet
mantlet.description: Friendly medium and small-based warrior models in base contact with this defence gain +3 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.

fuelCanister.name: Fuel Canister
fuelCanister.description: At any time during its activation before making its Normal Movement a friendly Gravedigger construct model within 2" of this model can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the construct model gains +2 SPD that activation.

augment.name: Augment
augment.description: Once per attack, when a friendly Gravedigger construct model within 2" of this model makes a melee attack during its activation, it can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the attacking model gains +2 to its next melee damage roll.

arcaneFuel.name: Arcane Fuel
arcaneFuel.description: At the start of its activation, a friendly Gravedigger cohort model within 2" of this model can cause this model to suffer 1 damage point. If it does so, the cohort model gains 1 focus point.

frago.name: FRAGO
frago.description: Once per turn, when a Light Airdrop is played on Bandit, it can be treated as a Heavy Airdrop instead. Heavy Airdrops, or Light Airdrops treated as Heavy Airdrops, can be played on Bandit during round one.

fireteam.name: Fireteam
fireteam.description: While Bandit is marshalling one or more of the warjacks listed below, gain the associated special rules:

marshalledSkirmisher.name: •Marshalled Skirmisher
marshalledSkirmisher.description: Bandit and its marshalled warjacks' ranged weapons gain Flare. (On a direct hit, models hit by this attack lose Stealth and suffer –2 DEF for one turn.)

marshalledBlocker.name: •Marshalled Blocker
marshalledBlocker.description: While Bandit is B2B with one or more of its marshalled warjacks, Bandit and the B2B marshalled warjacks gain +2 ARM.

marshalledRaider.name: •Marshalled Raider
marshalledRaider.description: Warjacks marshalled by Bandit gain Flank [Bandit]. (When a model with Flank [Bandit] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of Bandit, it gains +2 to attack rolls and rolls an additional damage die.)

vanguardCommandCortex.name: Vanguard Command Cortex
vanguardCommandCortex.description: Heavy Airdrops can be played on Bandit even if it’s already marshalling a warjack. Bandit can 'jack marshal multiple warjacks. Warjacks marshalled by Bandit count as part of the friendly Faction Leader model's battlegroup for the purposes of spells and feats. When Bandit is targeted by a friendly spell, you can choose a warjack within 8" of Bandit that it is marshalling to be the target instead, ignoring LOS and the spell’s RNG.

initiateSecondaryCoilingBypass.name: Initiate Secondary Coiling Bypass
initiateSecondaryCoilingBypass.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend one focus point to remove d3 damage points from itself.

arcWeb.name: Arc Web
arcWeb.description: When this model's controller channels a spell through it, this model can channel the spell through another friendly Faction warjack with the Arc Node advantage within 10" of this model. The other model with the Arc Node advantage becomes the channeling model.

accumulatorStormForgeWarrior.name: Accumulator [Storm Forge warrior]
accumulatorStormForgeWarrior.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Storm Forge warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

leadershipGunMages.name: Leadership [Gun Mages]
leadershipGunMages.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Gun Mage models gain Reciprocate.

veteranLeaderAssaultStrider.name: Veteran Leader [Assault Strider]
veteranLeaderAssaultStrider.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Assault Strider models gain +1 to attack rolls.

oathOfVengeanceUndead.name: Oath of Vengeance [Undead]
oathOfVengeanceUndead.description: This model gains +2 to its attack and damage rolls against Undead models.

augmentedMunitions.name: Augmented Munitions
augmentedMunitions.description: When a model in this model’s battlegroup gains +2 POW from Ammo Crate, it also gains +2 RAT when resolving that attack.

butcherSBill.name: Butcher's Bill
butcherSBill.description: If one or more friendly warrior models were damaged by enemy attacks while in this model's control range during your opponent’s last turn, during your Maintenance Phase one model in this model’s battlegroup in its control range can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.

paintTargetAction.name: Paint Target (★Action)
paintTargetAction.description: RNG 3. Target enemy model. If the model is within range, it suffers Flare. (A model suffering Flare loses Stealth and suffers  –2 DEF for one turn.)

accumulatorGunMage.name: Accumulator [Gun Mage]
accumulatorGunMage.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Gun Mage models, this model gains 1 focus point.

driveFoxholeBuddy.name: Drive: Foxhole Buddy
driveFoxholeBuddy.description: While within 10" of this model, a warjack under its control gains Foxhole Buddy. (While B2B with a friendly model that is dug in, a model with Fox Hole Buddy gains cover, Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS.)

coordinatedBarrage.name: Coordinated Barrage
coordinatedBarrage.description: This model can make ranged attacks targeting enemy models suffering Flare, ignoring RNG and LOS.

dangerClose.name: Danger Close
dangerClose.description: Once per turn during a friendly Faction model’s activation, after an attack or special action that applies Flare to an enemy model is resolved, this model may immediately make a basic ranged attack targeting the enemy model.

leadershipGunMage.name: Leadership [Gun Mage]
leadershipGunMage.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Gun Mage models gain Head Shot.

fieldMarshalEvasive.name: Field Marshal [Evasive]
fieldMarshalEvasive.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Evasive.

gatecrasher.name: Gatecrasher
gatecrasher.description: If this model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models during its activation, at any time during this model's activation it can be placed completely within 5" of its current location then its activation ends.

arcaneMachinery.name: Arcane Machinery
arcaneMachinery.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can use one of the following effects. Arcane Machinery effects last for one round.

arcaneCalibrations.name: •Arcane Calibrations
arcaneCalibrations.description: Reduce the COST of each spell this model casts this activation by 1 to a minimum of 1.

ionizationCtrl.name: •Ionization [Ctrl]
ionizationCtrl.description: When a model without Resistance: Electricity suffers an electrical damage roll while within this model's control range of this model, add +2 to the roll.

vexingAlignment.name: •Vexing Alignment
vexingAlignment.description: Increase this model’s control range by 4".

strafingRun.name: Strafing Run
strafingRun.description: This model gains an additional die on ranged attack damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

windWeaver.name: •Wind Weaver
windWeaver.description: This model gains Warping Winds. Windweaver lasts for one round. (When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers –3 RNG. Additionally, while with 3" of this model friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.)

galvanicCapacitor.name: Galvanic Capacitor
galvanicCapacitor.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can use one of the following effects. A model in a unit with Galvanic Capacitor cannot choose the same effect as another model in the unit. Galvanic Capacitor effects last for one round.

lightningWreath.name: •Lightning Wreath
lightningWreath.description: RNG 3. Target friendly model’s melee weapons gain Electro Leap until the end of the turn. (When a model is directly hit with a basic attack made with a weapon with Electro Leap, you can have lightning arc to the nearest model within 3" of the model hit, ignoring the attacking model. The model the lightning arcs to suffers an unboostable pow 10 electrical damage roll. Lightning arc damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack. Resolve lightning arc damage rolls simultaneously with the damage resulting from the attack that caused the leap.

polarityFieldGenerator.name: •Polarity Field Generator
polarityFieldGenerator.description: Models in this unit cannot be targeted by a charge or a slam power attack made by a construct model.

precisionFire.name: Precision Fire
precisionFire.description: This model can reroll its ranged attack damage rolls. Each damage roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Precision Fire.

breathTakerAction.name: •Breath Taker (★Action)
breathTakerAction.description: For one round, living enemy models suffer –2 DEF and –2 to their melee attack damage rolls while within 5" of this model.

parlayAction.name: •Parlay (★Action)
parlayAction.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy warrior models cannot target this model or its Leader with attacks. Parlay lasts for one round.

swampGasAction.name: •Swamp Gas (★Action)
swampGasAction.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a gas effect and hazard that remains centered on the model for one round. While in the template, living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls.

darkUnraveling.name: •Dark Unraveling
darkUnraveling.description: This model can immediately negate any spell that targets it or a model within 3" of it by spending 1 corpse token. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

graveSecrets.name: Grave Secrets
graveSecrets.description: If this model is in its Leader’s control range during your Control Phase, its Leader can spend corpse tokens on this model to upkeep one spell for each token spent.

rattleBones.name: Rattle Bones
rattleBones.description: While this model has one or more corpse tokens and is in its Leader’s control range, its Leader can channel spells through it.

alcoholFueled.name: Alcohol-Fueled
alcoholFueled.description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Temperamental and is removed from play.

temperamental.name: Temperamental
temperamental.description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

timeStutter.name: Time Stutter
timeStutter.description: Once per turn, when one or more of this model’s aspects are crippled by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place this model anywhere completely within 3" of its current location.

neverEndingPile.name: Never Ending Pile
neverEndingPile.description: At the start of this model’s activation, if it does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token.

warmthOfTheGrave.name: Warmth of the Grave
warmthOfTheGrave.description: While this model has one or more corpse tokens, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM while within 4" of this model +1" for each corpse token on this model.

burningAshAction.name: •Burning Ash (★ Action)
burningAshAction.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Immunity: Fire suffer –2 to attack rolls.

bodySnatcherBagMan.name: Body Snatcher: Bag Man
bodySnatcherBagMan.description: A model disabled by a melee attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll. When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token and the destroyed model is removed from play. This model can have up to one corpse token at any time.

victualsYouCanNeitherRaiseNorBuy.name: Victuals You Can Neither Raise Nor Buy
victualsYouCanNeitherRaiseNorBuy.description: At any time during its activation while within 5" of this model, a friendly non-Dread Rot model with a Body Snatcher special rule can remove corpse tokens from this model and place them on itself.

boneWorking.name: •Bone Working
boneWorking.description: When a model within 8" of this model makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a corpse token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Bone Working.

graveDiggerAction.name: Grave Digger (★Action)
graveDiggerAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly non-Leader Faction model. If the model is in range, it becomes dug in. (While dug in, a model gains cover and Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.)

iFoundOneAction.name: I Found One! (★Action)
iFoundOneAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction model with a Body Snatcher special rule. If the model is in range and does not have any corpse tokens, it gains one corpse token. A model can only be targeted by I Found One once per turn.

undertaker.name: Undertaker
undertaker.description: This model gains an additional die on attack and damage rolls against undead models.

mischief.name: Mischief
mischief.description: When an enemy warjack or battle engine begins its activation B2B with this model, roll a d3. On a roll of 1, the warjack or battle engine suffers –2 SPD that activation. On a 2, it suffers –2 to attack rolls that activation. On a 3, it suffers –2 to damage rolls that activation.

grantedSnapFire.name: Granted: Snap Fire
grantedSnapFire.description: While this model is in play the ranged weapons of models in its unit gain Snap Fire. (When a model destroys one or more enemy models with a weapon with Snap Fire during its Combat Action, immediately after that attack is resolved the model can make one basic ranged attack with the same weapon. Attacks gained from Snap Fire cannot generate additional attacks from Snap Fire.)

leadershipDreadRot__ea80651c.name: Leadership [Dread Rot]
leadershipDreadRot__ea80651c.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Dread Rot models gain Ghostly.

enrageAction__25ae956a.name: •Enrage (★Action)
enrageAction__25ae956a.description: RNG 3. Target friendly warbeast. If the warbeast is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. Enrage lasts for one turn.

sorrowfulRampage.name: Sorrowful Rampage
sorrowfulRampage.description: If this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, during your next turn friendly Faction models gain +1 to attack and damage rolls.

ghostLightAttack.name: •Ghost Light (★ Attack)
ghostLightAttack.description: Ghost Light is a RNG 10 arcane attack. On a hit, you take control of target living enemy non-Leader warrior model. You can immediately advance the enemy model up to 3", then Ghost Light expires. A model can be affected by Ghost Light only once per turn.

caskTapperAction.name: Cask Tapper (★ Action)
caskTapperAction.description: Place d3 friendly Cask Imp solos into play completely within 4" of this model. Cask Imps cannot activate the turn they are put into play.

ventFumes.name: Vent Fumes
ventFumes.description: While within 3" of this model, living friendly faction models gain Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

cradleSongAction.name: •Cradle Song (★Action)
cradleSongAction.description: When a living enemy model ends its activation within 5" of this model, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round. Cradle Song lasts for one round.

somethingWickedAction.name: •Something Wicked (★ Action)
somethingWickedAction.description: While within 8" of this model, Monkeys gain an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls and Killing Spree. Something Wicked lasts for turn activation. (When a model with Killing Spree destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, after that attack is resolved, it can advance up to 1" and make one additional melee attack.)

playingDead__c94e17bf.name: Playing Dead
playingDead__c94e17bf.description: At any time during its activation, Grunts in this model’s unit are knocked down. Additionally Grunts in this model’s unit gain Feign Death for one round. (A mode with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

deathVoid.name: Death Void
deathVoid.description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, enemy animi and upkeep spells on models within 5" of it immediately expire.

grantedRetaliatoryStrike.name: Granted: Retaliatory Strike
grantedRetaliatoryStrike.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

escapees__607b238d.name: Escapees
escapees__607b238d.description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, you can replace it with with a Gremlin Swarm solo. Then this model is removed from play.

otherworldlyEntity.name: Otherworldly Entity
otherworldlyEntity.description: This model can be healed as if it were a living model.

darkSeductionAttack.name: •Dark Seduction (★Attack)
darkSeductionAttack.description: RNG 8. Target enemy non-Leader warrior model. If the attack hits you take control of the target model and can immediately make a full advance with that enemy model followed by a basic attack, then Dark Seduction expires. Dark Seduction can be cast only once per activation. A model can be affected by Dark Seduction only once per turn.

shadowWalk.name: Shadow Walk
shadowWalk.description: Once per activation, when this model hits an enemy model with an arcane attack, after the attack is resolved, you may place this model completely within 5" of this current location.

noEscape.name: No escape
noEscape.description: Enemy model/units that are this model’s Prey roll one less die on attack rolls when attacking this model.

aFateWorseThanDeathAction.name: •A Fate Worse Than Death (★Action)
aFateWorseThanDeathAction.description: When a non-Leader model that is this model’s Prey activates within 6" of this model, it becomes stationary for one round. A Fate Worse than Death lasts for one round.

fieldMarshalPainResponse.name: Field Marshal [Pain Response]
fieldMarshalPainResponse.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Pain Response. (While damaged, a model with Pain Response can charge and make power attacks without being forced.)

arcanaInfused.name: Arcana Infused
arcanaInfused.description: This model can have up to two Command Cards played on it each turn.

outrage.name: Outrage
outrage.description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model gains +2 ARM, +2 to its melee attack damage rolls, and Pathfinder for one round.

dreamState.name: Dream State
dreamState.description: At the End of your Control Phase, this model can use Dream State. If it does, models in its battlegroup gain Incorporeal for one round. This model cannot use Dream State if it became Incorporeal during the last round.

hatTrick.name: Hat Trick
hatTrick.description: When an enemy model is boxed while in this model’s control range, you can replace the boxed model with a Phantasm model with the same or smaller base size. The replaced model is removed from play. You can have only one Phantasm model of each base size in play at any time.

theEndOfAllThings.name: The End of All Things
theEndOfAllThings.description: At the start of this model’s activation, choose one of the following special rules:

entropicForce.name: •Entropic Force
entropicForce.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them. Entropic Force lasts for one round.

famine.name: •Famine
famine.description: This model’s melee weapons gain Starve this activation. (A model damaged by a weapon with Starve must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation.)

pestilence.name: •Pestilence
pestilence.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. The template is a hazard and remains centered on this model for one round. Enemy models suffer –2 DEF while in the template.

divinity.name: Divinity
divinity.description: This model cannot become knocked down and never suffers Blind.

godlikePower.name: Godlike Power
godlikePower.description: Once per turn during its activation, this model can cast a non-animus spell that was cast by the enemy leader while in this model’s control range during your opponent’s last turn as if it were one of its own spells without spending fury. This model cannot upkeep spells that do not appear on its card.

masterOfRuinAction.name: Master of Ruin (★Action)
masterOfRuinAction.description: Other models, friendly or enemy, suffer –2 ARM while within 5" of this model. Master of Ruin lasts for one round.

kingdomOfSilence.name: Kingdom of Silence
kingdomOfSilence.description: Once per turn, when a Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending fury.

crossroads.name: Crossroads
crossroads.description: At the end of your turn, place three road markers anywhere completely within 6" of this model. At the start of your Maintenance Phase, you can place this model in the location of any of its road markers. The road markers are then removed whether or not this model was placed. If a model contacts a road marker, remove the road marker from the table.

hiddenPaths.name: Hidden Paths
hiddenPaths.description: When an enemy model contacts a road marker while advancing, after that model completes its movement one friendly Faction model currently in this model’s control range can advance up to 2". A model can move only once per turn as a result of Hidden Paths.

trapDoorAction.name: Trap Door (★ Action)
trapDoorAction.description: Replace this model with a trap door marker. At the beginning of each of your Maintenance Phases, you can choose to put this model back in play. If you do, place this model anywhere completely within 3" of the trap door marker, then remove the marker from the table. This model cannot use Trap Door that turn.

immovable.name: Immovable
immovable.description: This model has no Normal Movement, cannot become knocked down or be moved, and is automatically hit by melee attacks.

divinator.name: •Divinator
divinator.description: While in this model’s control range, models in its battlegroup can reroll failed attack rolls. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Divinator.

hellhole.name: •Hellhole
hellhole.description: Return d3 friendly destroyed Faction Grunts to play. Models return with 1 unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within this model’s control range and within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

bloodQuenched__a9d0dab2.name: Blood-Quenched
bloodQuenched__a9d0dab2.description: This model gains a cumulative +1 ARM and +1 to its melee damage rolls for each enemy model it destroys with a melee attack during its activation. This bonus lasts for one round.

hyperAggressive__b7659c11.name: Hyper-Aggressive
hyperAggressive__b7659c11.description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it can immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

quickDraw.name: Quick Draw
quickDraw.description: Once per turn, when an enemy model within 12" of this model directly hits a friendly model within 3" of this model with a non-spray ranged attack, this model can make a ranged attack roll against the enemy model. If this attack roll hits, the enemy ranged attack automatically misses.

spiritSiphon.name: Spirit Siphon
spiritSiphon.description: When this model makes an attack, it can suffer 1 damage to remain incorporeal.

flankSasha.name: Flank [Sasha]
flankSasha.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of Sasha, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

awakenTheVoid.name: •Awaken the Void
awakenTheVoid.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Soulless trooper model. If the model is in range, the weapons of models in its unit gain Blessed for one turn.

desperatePaceSoulless.name: •Desperate Pace [Soulless]
desperatePaceSoulless.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Soulless trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

arcaneStasis.name: Arcane Stasis
arcaneStasis.description: Friendly models can upkeep spells on this model without spending focus or fury points.

accumulatorUndead.name: Accumulator [Undead]
accumulatorUndead.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly undead warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

invocationsOfDust.name: Invocations of Dust
invocationsOfDust.description: When a friendly undead non-Leader Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled, this model can spend 1 focus point to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model.

phoenixProtocols.name: Phoenix Protocols
phoenixProtocols.description: Choose a protocol at the beginning of each of this model’s activations. It retains that protocol until the beginning of its next activation. A protocol cannot be chosen a second time until each protocol has been chosen once. A protocol cannot be chosen a third time until each protocol has been chosen twice.

wildfireProtocol.name: •Wildfire Protocol
wildfireProtocol.description: This model gains Evasive and cannot be made stationary. (When a model with Evasive is hit by an enemy ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

retributionProtocol.name: •Retribution Protocol
retributionProtocol.description: This model gains Side Step and can charge without spending focus. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or special attack, it can advance 2" after the attack is resolved.)

rekindled.name: Rekindled
rekindled.description: The first time this model would be disabled, each model within 2" of it suffers an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll. Then remove all damage from its System boxes, ignoring all effects that prevent damage from being removed from a model. It gains inconsequential until the end of the turn. If it is within its battlegroup controller’s control range, it can be placed within 2" of that model. (A model with Inconsequential cannot score or contest scenario elements.)

voidwalkerProtocol.name: •Voidwalker Protocol
voidwalkerProtocol.description: This model gains Ghostly, Dodge, +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls, and cannot become knocked down. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.) (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

generator.name: Generator
generator.description: When this model would suffer damage, it can immediately spend up to 1 focus point to reduce the damage it would suffer by 5. The model is still considered to have suffered damage even if the damage is reduced to 0 or less. Excess damage prevention is lost. This model cannot spend focus points to reduce damage while its Generator (G) or Head system (H) is crippled

bondChanneler.name: Bond (Channeler)
bondChanneler.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, your Leader can channel spells through it.

bondReposition3.name: Bond (Reposition [3"])
bondReposition3.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Reposition [3]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

bondUnyielding.name: Bond (Unyielding)
bondUnyielding.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

soothingCallAction.name: Soothing Call (★Action)
soothingCallAction.description: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 10" of this model.

fieldMarshalChiller.name: Field Marshal [Chiller]
fieldMarshalChiller.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Chiller. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models suffer -2 DEF unless they have Resistance: Cold.)

flankBenkei.name: Flank [Benkei]
flankBenkei.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of Benkei, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

atAllCosts.name: •At All Costs
atAllCosts.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Shield Guard for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack during your opponent’s turn while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard directly hit instead. It is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

funeralRites.name: Funeral Rites
funeralRites.description: Once per turn, when a a friendly living Ghost of Ios model is destroyed by an enemy attack while in Morayne's control range, immediately after the attack is resolved Morayne can cast a spell without spending focus.

phantasmalField.name: Phantasmal Field
phantasmalField.description: This model gains +1 DEF against ranged and arcane attack rolls for each focus point on it.

kineticCapacitor.name: Kinetic Capacitor
kineticCapacitor.description: The first time this model is hit by an enemy attack each turn, after the attack is resolved this model gains 1 focus point.

tasteOfDeath.name: Taste of Death
tasteOfDeath.description:
When a living or undead enemy model within 5" of this model is
destroyed, this model’s controller can gain 1 focus or fury point. A model’s focus or fury point total cannot exceed its ARC as a result of Taste of Death.

sanguineFate.name: Sanguine Fate
sanguineFate.description: When this model makes an attack roll, roll a separate die that is not added to total. If the separate die result is the same as another die used in the attack roll, and the attack hits, it is a critical hit.

fieldMarshalSanguineFate.name: Field Marshal [Sanguine Fate]
fieldMarshalSanguineFate.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Sanguine Fate.

exorcismAction.name: •Exorcism (★Action)
exorcismAction.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the Cohort model is in range, enemy upkeep spells and animi on the Cohort model immediately expire. Additionally, the Cohort model gains Magic Resistance for one round. (When a model with Magic Resistance is targeted by an arcane attack roll, roll one additional die. Discard the highest die of each roll.)

restorationD31Action.name: •Restoration [d3+1] (★Action)
restorationD31Action.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, remove d3+1 damage points from it.

flankWarjack.name: Flank [Warjack]
flankWarjack.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction Warjack model, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

spiritVessel.name: Spirit Vessel
spiritVessel.description: This model begins the game as Living Vaelyss. When Living Vaelyss is destroyed by an enemy attack, before removing her from the table place the Avenging Spirit anywhere completely within 5" of her current location.

arcantrikCapacitor.name: Arcantrik Capacitor
arcantrikCapacitor.description: When a model within 10" of this model casts a spell, this model gains 1 power token. This model can have up to 3 power tokens at any time. During its Combat Action, this model can spend power tokens to boost one attack or damage roll for each power token spent.

voidInduction.name: Void Induction
voidInduction.description: When a friendly soulless model is disabled by an enemy attack while within 10" of this model, this model can spend one power token to replace that model with a Wight model. The replaced model is destroyed. You can have up to three friendly Wights in play at any time for each friendly Void Engine in play.

powerChargedKineticField.name: Power-Charged [Kinetic field]
powerChargedKineticField.description: This model can spend 1 power token at any time during its activation to gain Kinetic Field for one round. (A model with Kinetic Field and friendly Faction models within 3" of it gain +2 ARM against ranged attacks and gain Resistance: Blast.)

recalibrationAction.name: •Recalibration (★Action)
recalibrationAction.description: RNG 1. Target friendly Faction construct model. If the model is in range, you can have it reroll one attack or damage roll, then Recalibration expires. Recalibration lasts for one turn.

revelationsOfTheOuterDarkness.name: Revelations of the Outer Darkness
revelationsOfTheOuterDarkness.description: Once per turn, when a friendly Faction warrior within 12" of this model is destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can cast a spell without spending essence, focus, or fury.

soulTakerSoulRipper.name: Soul Taker: Soul Ripper
soulTakerSoulRipper.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed within 2" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. After this model replenishes its essence during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token with 1 essence point.

willingVessel.name: Willing Vessel
willingVessel.description: When an infernal master summons a horror and chooses this model to remove from play, the infernal master does not need to spend any essence points to summon the horror.

anathema.name: Anathema
anathema.description: When this model is summoned, center a cloud effect template on it. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round.  A model without Resistance: Corrosion entering or ending its activation in the template suffers 1 point of corrosion damage.

psychoStatic.name: Psycho Static
psychoStatic.description: Spells channeled through this model the turn it is summoned suffer –3 RNG.

channeling.name: Channeling
channeling.description: While this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller can channel spells through it

soulParasites.name: Soul Parasites
soulParasites.description: Living non-soulless enemy models and enemy models with Soul Vessel suffer –2 to their attack rolls while within 4" of this model.

wailing.name: Wailing
wailing.description: While within 5" of this model, enemy models cannot cast spells or be used to channel spells.

soulClaiming.name: Soul Claiming
soulClaiming.description: When a living enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

soulVoid.name: Soul Void
soulVoid.description: Enemy models are not eligible to gain soul tokens from enemy models destroyed within 6" of this model.

insidiousPlans.name: Insidious Plans
insidiousPlans.description: This model can use one of the following plans at any time during its activation:

curseHorror.name: •Curse [Horror]
curseHorror.description: RNG 10. Target enemy model/unit. If the target enemy model/unit is in range, friendly horrors gain +2 to attack rolls against it. Curse lasts for one turn.

shadow.name: •Shadow
shadow.description: RNG 10. Target enemy model. If the target enemy model is in range, when it advances or is placed, after its movement or placement is resolved one friendly non-trooper warrior model within 10" of this model can make a full advance. Shadow lasts for one round.

ritualsOfShadowAction.name: •Rituals of Shadow (★Action)
ritualsOfShadowAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly horror. If the horror was in range, it gains 1 essence point.

touchOfDarknessAction.name: •Touch of Darkness (★Action)
touchOfDarknessAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly living soulless model. If that model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

grantedSelfSacrifice.name: Granted: Self-Sacrifice
grantedSelfSacrifice.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Self-Sacrifice. (If a model with Self-Sacrifice is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled model in its unit within 3" of the model with Self-Sacrifice to be destroyed and the model with Self-Sacrifice removes 1 damage point.)

annihilationAttack.name: •Annihilation (★Attack)
annihilationAttack.description: Annihilation is a RNG 10, AOE 2, POW 10/10 arcane attack. Models destroyed by Annihilation are removed from play and do not generate corpse tokens. When a living enemy model is destroyed by Annihilation, the spellcaster gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

knowledgeOfTheDamned.name: •Knowledge of the Damned
knowledgeOfTheDamned.description: When a model in this model’s control range makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a soul token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Knowledge of the Damned.

masterInfernalist.name: Master Infernalist
masterInfernalist.description: This model is not an infernal master or Leader but has all the rules of an infernal master except it does not have a feat and cannot summon horrors. This model can have only light or lesser horrors in its battlegroup and must start with one in it's battlegroup at the begining of the game. This model replenishes its essence without sacrificing a model during its Control Phase.

hollowWard.name: Hollow Ward
hollowWard.description: While within 4" of this model, friendly horrors gain +2 ARM against melee attack damage rolls made by construct, soulless, or undead models.

soulClaiming__e5ac4fe6.name: Soul Claiming
soulClaiming__e5ac4fe6.description: When a living non-soulless enemy model is destroyed within 4" of this model while this model is in its controller’s control range, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

soulRavager.name: Soul Ravager
soulRavager.description: When this model destroys an enemy model with an attack, its controller gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models and the destroyed model is removed from play.

soulShatter.name: Soul Shatter
soulShatter.description: Once per turn, when a non-soulless living enemy model advances and ends is movement or is placed within 4" of this model, this model can spend 1 essence point. When it does the living model gains Soulless for the rest of the game and this model's Leader gains its soul token.

illGottenRelics.name: Ill-Gotten Relics
illGottenRelics.description: This model can use one of the following relics at any time during its activation.

effigyOfWar.name: •Effigy of War
effigyOfWar.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit was in range, it gains Relentless Charge this turn. (While advancing as part of a charge, a model with Relentless Charge gains Pathfinder.)

shimmeringVisage.name: •Shimmering Visage
shimmeringVisage.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in RNG, it gains Dodge. Shimmering Visage lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

tomeOfLivingShade.name: •Tome of Living Shade
tomeOfLivingShade.description: While within 8" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 RNG on their ranged and arcane attacks. Tome of Living Shade lasts for one round.

wiltingHorn.name: •Wilting Horn
wiltingHorn.description: While within 10" of this model, when an enemy model casts a spell, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while within 10" of this model, enemy models must pay double to upkeep spells. Wilting Horn lasts for one round.

hellhounds.name: Hellhounds
hellhounds.description: When a Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with a melee or ranged attack, while the Cohort model is within 12" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token regardless of the proximity of other models.

flysKissAttack.name: •Fly’s Kiss (★Attack)
flysKissAttack.description: Fly's Kiss is a RNG 8, POW 12 arcane attack. If this attack boxes an enemy model, models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion blast damage roll, then the boxed model is removed from play.

invocationOfBitterestNightAction.name: •Invocation of Bitterest Night (★Action)
invocationOfBitterestNightAction.description: This model gains Stealth and Black Mantle for one round. (While B2B with a model with Black Mantle, friendly Faction models gain Stealth.)

darkCallingAction.name: •Dark Calling (★Action)
darkCallingAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly horror. If the horror is in range, it immediately makes one basic melee or ranged attack. A model can be targeted by Dark Calling special action only once per turn.

shadowGuardian.name: Shadow Guardian
shadowGuardian.description: You can choose not to deploy this model at the start of the game. If it is not deployed normally, you can put it into play when a friendly non-Umbral Faction model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack. Place this model completely within 3" of the hit model. This model is automatically hit by the ranged attack instead and suffers all damage and effects.

brothersKeeper.name: •Brother’s Keeper
brothersKeeper.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down or made stationary. Brothers Keeper lasts for one round.

alterTheDealAction.name: Alter the Deal (★Action)
alterTheDealAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly non-soulless warrior model/unit gains Marked Soul for one turn. (Mark Soul - This model is a Marked Soul.)

masterSummoner.name: Master Summoner
masterSummoner.description: Horrors summoned by this model enter play with essence equal to their ESSENCE stat.

darkLegacy.name: Dark Legacy
darkLegacy.description: When a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model is targeted by a ranged attack, the attack suffers –3 RNG.

veneficium.name: Veneficium
veneficium.description: When a spell or special rule on an enemy model causes one or more of this model’s upkeep spells to expire, the enemy model suffers d3 damage points for each of this model’s upkeep spells that expire. Roll a separate d3 for each spell.

infernalPortal.name: Infernal Portal
infernalPortal.description: When a model summons a horror while within 8" of this model, reduce the number of essence points the summoning model must spend by 1

soulTakerVortexOfSouls.name: Soul Taker: Vortex of Souls
soulTakerVortexOfSouls.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a living model is destroyed while within 15" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to five soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

gateOfWorlds.name: •Gate of Worlds
gateOfWorlds.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one soul token to place a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed as a result of Gate of Worlds only once per turn.

soulConduit.name: Soul Conduit
soulConduit.description: At the start of this models activation, if this model has no soul tokens on it, and there are no living non souless enemy modles within 15" of this model, this model gains a soul token.

darkAbyss.name: •Dark Abyss
darkAbyss.description: Anytime during this models activation, you can remove up to three soul tokens from this model to return one destroyed small- or medium-based friendly Faction soulless Grunt to play for each token removed. Grunts return with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunts completely within within 12" of this model and completely within 2" of another model in their unit. Returned Grunts must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

wetWork.name: •Wet Work
wetWork.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Anatomical Precision and Overtake for one round. (When a model with Anatomical Precision’s melee damage roll fails to exceed the ARM of the living model hit, that model suffers 1 damage point. A model disabled by a melee attack made by a model with Anatomical Precision cannot make a Tough roll.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

subCortex.name: Sub-Cortex
subCortex.description: The S boxes of this warjack's damage grid represent its Sub-Cortex system. While this warjack's Sub-Cortex system is not crippled, its ranged weapons gain Powerful Attack. (When attacking with a weapon with Powerful Attack, a model can spend 1 focus point to boost all attack and damage rolls for the attack.)

grantedSilence.name: Granted: Silence
grantedSilence.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit do not have to make Berserk attacks.

sacrificialPawnDoomReaver.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Doom Reaver]
sacrificialPawnDoomReaver.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Doom Reaver model within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

bondVladimir.name: Bond [Vladimir]
bondVladimir.description: If Drago begins the game in Vladimir’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Drago is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Vladimir and in his control range, Drago gains Poltergeist. (When an enemy model misses a model with Poltergeist with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can choose to push the enemy model d3" directly away from the model with Poltergeist.)

leadershipDoomReavers.name: Leadership [Doom Reavers]
leadershipDoomReavers.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Doom Reaver models gain Relentless Charge.

blizzardAction.name: •Blizzard (★Action)
blizzardAction.description: Choose a friendly Faction model within 5" of this model. Center a cloud effect template on the chosen model. The template remains centered on the model for one round. If the chosen model is destroyed or removed from play, remove the template from play.

noSleepingOnTheJobIronFang.name: No Sleeping on the Job [Iron Fang]
noSleepingOnTheJobIronFang.description: This model and friendly  Iron Fang models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

veteranLeaderIronFang.name: Veteran Leader [Iron Fang]
veteranLeaderIronFang.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Iron Fang models gain +1 to attack rolls.

wintersWindAction.name: •Winter’s Wind (★ Action)
wintersWindAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model with Resistance: Cold. If the model is in range, it gains Freezer. Winter’s Wind lasts for one round. (When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold ends its activation within 2" of a model with Freezer, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round.)

arcaneArtifacts.name: Arcane Artifacts
