arcaneArtifacts.description: When this model casts a spell, you can choose to use one of the following special rules. Each special rule can be used only once per activation and expires after the spell is cast.

focusSphere.name: •Focus Sphere
focusSphere.description: Reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

trueSight__eb643559.name: •True Sight
trueSight__eb643559.description: This model ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. This model also ignores Stealth.

rangeAmplifier__e3c1148b.name: •Range Amplifier
rangeAmplifier__e3c1148b.description: When this model casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +5 RNG.

leadershipGreylords.name: Leadership [Greylords]
leadershipGreylords.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Greylord models gain Battle Wizard.

brittleFrostAttack.name: •Brittle Frost (★Attack)
brittleFrostAttack.description: Brittle Frost is a RNG 10 arcane attack. A model hit by this attack suffers a POW 10 cold damage roll and suffers  –2 ARM for one turn unless it has Resistance: Cold.

windRavagerAction.name: •Wind Ravager (★Action)
windRavagerAction.description: While within 6" of this model, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks.

arcaneDementia.name: Arcane Dementia
arcaneDementia.description: Zoktavir begins the game with 7 focus points and a base ARC of 7. At the start of each of your turns, if Zoktavir destroyed three or more enemy models with melee attacks during the last round, his base ARC becomes 7 for one round. Otherwise, his ARC becomes d6 + 1 for one round.

conferredRage.name: Conferred Rage
conferredRage.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models during its activation, Cohort models in its battlegroup beginning their activations in its control range gain +2 SPD and MAT for one turn.

homicidalManiac.name: Homicidal Maniac
homicidalManiac.description: If there are no models in this model’s melee range after resolving a basic melee attack in which this model destroyed one or more enemy models, this model can advance up to 1".

sacrificialPawnWarArgus.name: Sacrificial Pawn [War Argus]
sacrificialPawnWarArgus.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal War Argus within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

sacrificialPawnReaverGuard.name: Sacrificial Pawn [Reaver Guard]
sacrificialPawnReaverGuard.description: When this model is directly hit by an enemy ranged attack, you can have one friendly, non-incorporeal Reaver Guard within 3" of it directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

silence.name: Silence
silence.description: This model does not have to make Berserk attacks.

bondTheOldWitchOfKhador.name: Bond [The Old Witch of Khador]
bondTheOldWitchOfKhador.description: If Scrapjack begins the game in the Old Witch’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Scrapjack is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. When the Old Witch is damaged by an enemy attack while Scrapjack is bonded to her. Scrapjack gains +2 SPD and +2 to attack and damage rolls for one round.

totalObedience.name: Total Obedience
totalObedience.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly warrior models gain Tough.

mightOfKings.name: Might of Kings
mightOfKings.description: While this model is damaged, it gains +2 ARM and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls. If a friendly model damages this model with an attack, this model loses Might of Kings for the rest of the game.

trapperAction.name: Trapper (★Action)
trapperAction.description: Place a 3" template anywhere within 2" of this model. The template remains in play for one round. Living and undead models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer a POW 10 damage roll. Models damaged by Trapper become knocked down. Models with Flight are not affected.

powerMagnifier.name: •Power Magnifier
powerMagnifier.description: This model can spend 1 focus point at any time during its activation to give 2 focus points to a warjack in its battlegroup that is in its control range.

grantedDuelist.name: Granted: Duelist
grantedDuelist.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +2 DEF against melee attacks.

grantedOvertake.name: Granted: Overtake
grantedOvertake.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

pressTheAdvantage.name: •Press the Advantage
pressTheAdvantage.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Swift Hunter for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

earthworks.name: Earthworks
earthworks.description: After deployment but before the first turn, place three Trapdoor markers within 24" of the rear edge of your Deployment Zone and not with 5" of each other.

fieldMarshalAmbushAndTunnelAmbush.name: Field Marshal [Ambush and Tunnel Ambush]
fieldMarshalAmbushAndTunnelAmbush.description: Medium based cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Ambush and Tunnel Ambush. (When a model with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, it can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table.)

bruteForce.name: Brute Force
bruteForce.description: Each turn, the first medium based cohort model in this model’s battlegroup to ambush gains Sneak Attack until the end of the turn. (The turn a model with Sneak Attack ambushes, it gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against models within 5".)

tunnelAmbush.name: Tunnel Ambush
tunnelAmbush.description: When a model with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, it can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table.

leadershipFactionWarriorModels.name: Leadership [Faction Warrior Models]
leadershipFactionWarriorModels.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly faction warrior models gain Prowl.

hideOnBush.name: Hide on Bush
hideOnBush.description: When this model ends its activation with concealment, it gains Admonition for one round. (When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of a model with Admonition, the model with Admonition can immediately advance up to 3", then Admonition expires.)

arcaneSinkhole.name: Arcane Sinkhole
arcaneSinkhole.description: Once per turn at any point during Wroughtmourn’s activation, choose a friendly Trapdoor marker in her control range. While within 5" of the marker, enemy models cannot cast or channel spells. Arcane Sinkhole lasts for one round.

earthenConduit.name: Earthen Conduit
earthenConduit.description: Wroughtmourn can determine line of sight and channel spells through friendly Trapdoor markers in her control range. After using a Trapdoor marker to channel, remove it from the table.

foundations.name: Foundations
foundations.description: While within 1" of a friendly Trapdoor marker, friendly Faction models gain +1 ARM.

securedPerimeter6.name: Secured Perimeter [6"]
securedPerimeter6.description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF while within 6" of this model.

compostAction.name: Compost (★Action)
compostAction.description: Place a 3" diameter template anywhere in base contact with this model. The template is forest terrain and remains in play for one round. After making this special action, this model cannot move during the same activation.

supportWeaponsKithguardInfantry.name: Support Weapons [Kithguard Infantry]
supportWeaponsKithguardInfantry.description: Each time you add this unit to your army, choose two Support Weapon Troopers to add to the unit. You can add two of the same Support Weapon Trooper to the unit. The options for Support Weapon Troopers to add to this unit are Flamethrower, Mortar, and Slugger.

beenHereBefore.name: Been Here Before
beenHereBefore.description: Models in this unit gain Ambush and Extended Ambush. (when a model/unit with Extended Ambush ambushes, it can be placed completely within 5"of the table edge, instead of 3".)

closeControl.name: Close Control
closeControl.description: While a cohort model in this model’s battlegroup is in play, this model cannot go into the tunnels.

veteranLeaderSteelback.name: Veteran Leader [Steelback]
veteranLeaderSteelback.description: While within 10" of this model, Steelback models gain +1 to attack rolls.

eliteCadreGuardPost.name: Elite Cadre [Guard Post]
eliteCadreGuardPost.description: Friendly Guard Post models gain Carapace. (Models with Carapace gain +4 ARM against ranged attack damage rolls.)

healD3Action__1f9a1716.name: Heal [d3] (★ Action)
healD3Action__1f9a1716.description: RNG 1. Target friendly living Faction model. If the model is in range, remove d3 damage points from it.

collapseTunnelAction.name: Collapse Tunnel (★Action)
collapseTunnelAction.description: Remove a friendly Trapdoor marker from anywhere on the table.

makeAHoleAction.name: Make a Hole! (★Action)
makeAHoleAction.description: If there are fewer than three friendly Trapdoor markers on the table, place one within 3" of this model.

redirectAction.name: Redirect (★Action)
redirectAction.description: RNG 6. Choose a friendly Trapdoor marker within range. Place it completely within 3" of its current location.

trapdoor.name: Trapdoor
trapdoor.description:
Trapdoor markers are not models and do not block line of sight. Models can advance through a marker, or be pushed, thrown, or slammed through a marker, if they have enough movement to move completely past it; otherwise, they must stop short of the marker. A slammed or thrown model does not suffer an additional damage die for contacting a marker. A marker is removed from the table if it is contacted by a colossal or gargantuan model.

Trapdoor markers cannot be placed overlapping a model’s base, obstacle or obstruction terrain.

A friendly Faction non-Leader warrior model/unit that ends its Normal Movement in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker can immediately go into the tunnels. If it does, it is removed from the table and gains Ambush and Tunnel Ambush. When the model/unit is returned to play, do not remove damage from it. (When a model/unit with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, one model can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table and other models in the unit are placed in base contact with the first model.)

sneakAttack.name: Sneak Attack
sneakAttack.description: The turn this model ambushes, it gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against models within 5".

extendedAmbush.name: Extended Ambush
extendedAmbush.description: When a model/unit with Extended Ambush ambushes, it can be deployed completely within 5" of the table edge, instead of 3".

tunnelAmbush__fd6400a5.name: Tunnel Ambush
tunnelAmbush__fd6400a5.description: When a model/unit with Tunnel Ambush ambushes, instead of being deployed to a table edge, one model can be placed in base contact with a friendly Trapdoor marker. The marker is then removed from the table and the other models in the unit are placed in base contact with the first model.

tunnelNetwork.name: Tunnel Network
tunnelNetwork.description: All models within 2" of friendly Trapdoor markers are considered to be in Craghorn's control range.

notMyFirstRodeo.name: Not My First Rodeo
notMyFirstRodeo.description: When a friendly Faction model/unit goes into the tunnels, Craghorn’s upkeep spells on it do not expire. Craghorn must still spend fury to upkeep spells on models in the tunnels as if they were on the table.

placeCharges.name: Place Charges
placeCharges.description: RNG 6. One model in this unit can use Place Charges once per game at any time during its activation to remove a defence within range from the table

wings.name: •Wings
wings.description: This model gains +1 SPD and Flight.

bondKryssa.name: Bond [Kryssa]
bondKryssa.description: If this model begins the game in Kryssa’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to Kryssa and in her control range, it gains Reposition [3"̋]. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

grantedShadowBind.name: Granted: Shadow Bind
grantedShadowBind.description: While this model is in play, the melee weapons of models in this unit gain Shadow Bind.

fieldMarshalFightOrFlight.name: Field Marshal [Fight-or-Flight]
fieldMarshalFightOrFlight.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup can run or charge without being forced.

limitedBattlegroupBeastMistress.name: Limited Battlegroup [Beast Mistress]
limitedBattlegroupBeastMistress.description: The only warbeasts that can be in this model’s battlegroup are non-character Faction lesser warbeasts.

bondBethayneVoiceOfEverblight.name: Bond [Bethayne, Voice of Everblight]
bondBethayneVoiceOfEverblight.description: Belphagor begins the game bonded to Bethayne. Belphagor is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Belphagor is bonded to Bethayne and in her control range, she can channel spells through it.

fleshMeld.name: Flesh Meld
fleshMeld.description:
Bethayne can use Flesh Meld at any time during her activation while B2B with Belphagor. Remove Bethayne from the table. Upkeep spells she cast do not immediately expire, and warbeasts in her battlegroup do not go wild. Any effects on Bethayne when she melds are applied to Belphagor. Remove the fury points currently on Belphagor. If there are any fury points on Bethayne when she melds, place them on Belphagor. Belphagor cannot activate later in a turn in which it becomes flesh melded.

While melded, Belphagor becomes a warlock warrior model, loses Soulless, takes control of Bethayne’s battlegroup, and can upkeep spells cast by Bethayne. While melded, Belphagor loses its FURY and THR stats and gains AAT 7, ARC 7, and CTRL 14. While melded, Belphagor can cast Bethayne’s spells and use her feat. While melded, Belphagor is not considered to be a warbeast and loses its animus. While melded, Belphagor suffers damage like a warbeast but does not suffer the effects of crippled aspects. Effects modifying the amount of damage to or the manner in which damage is applied to a warbeast still apply to Belphagor, even while it is melded. If Belphagor is destroyed or removed from play while melded, Bethayne is also destroyed.

Bethayne can separate from Belphagor during your Maintenance Phase. When she returns to play, place her B2B with Belphagor. Bethayne returns to play with the same amount of damage she had when she was removed from the table as a result of Flesh Meld. After Bethayne returns to play, she can upkeep spells cast by Belphagor when they were melded.

cloakOfMistAction.name: •Cloak of Mist (★Action)
cloakOfMistAction.description: Model's in this unit gain Stealth for one round.

veteranLeaderBlighted.name: Veteran Leader [Blighted]
veteranLeaderBlighted.description: While within 10" of this model, Blighted models gain +1 to attack rolls.

huntingPackBlightWasp.name: Hunting Pack [Blight Wasp]
huntingPackBlightWasp.description: This model gains a +1 cumulative bonus to melee attack and damage rolls for each other friendly Blight Wasp with the target of this model’s melee attack in its melee range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3.

grantedReadyAmmo.name: Granted: Ready Ammo
grantedReadyAmmo.description: While this model is in play, the ROF of Nyss Longbows on models in this unit becomes 2.

aerialCoordination.name: Aerial Coordination
aerialCoordination.description: Friendly Faction warbeasts with Flight beginning their activations within 10" of this model can charge without being forced.

deathlyPowerAction__609fc3ce.name: •Deathly Power (★Action)
deathlyPowerAction__609fc3ce.description: This model gains Dark Shroud for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

grantedDefensiveStrike.name: Granted: Defensive Strike
grantedDefensiveStrike.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Defensive Strike. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.)

leadershipBlightedNyssSwordsmen.name: Leadership [Blighted Nyss Swordsmen]
leadershipBlightedNyssSwordsmen.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Blighted Nyss Swordsmen models gain Blade Shield.

fieldMarshalOvertake.name: Field Marshal [Overtake]
fieldMarshalOvertake.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

host.name: Host
host.description: Incubus models do not begin the game in play. When a friendly living non-soulless, small-based Faction warrior model is disabled by an enemy attack, collateral damage, or a continuous effect, you can replace it with an Incubus model that has not been put into play. The replaced model is removed from play.

unconquerable.name: Unconquerable
unconquerable.description: While while within 10" of this model, friendly Faction warrior models gain Unyielding.

keepOnTheMove.name: •Keep On the Move
keepOnTheMove.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Run & Gun for one turn. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

targetLock.name: •Target Lock
targetLock.description: RNG 10. Target enemy model/unit in this model’s LOS. While within 10" of this model, friendly warrior models gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Target Lock lasts for one turn.

channelerSaeryn.name: Channeler [Saeryn]
channelerSaeryn.description: While Rhyas is in Saeryn’s control range, Saeryn can channel spells through her.

twinSister.name: Twin Sister
twinSister.description: Saeryn and Rhyas share a single battlegroup. If Saeryn is destroyed or removed from play, Rhyas becomes a warlock and Leader model and is no longer considered to be a solo. Your warlock is destroyed only if both Saeryn and Rhyas are destroyed or removed from play.

supportingWarlock.name: Supporting Warlock
supportingWarlock.description: This model is not a warlock or Leader, but has the following warlock special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Fury Manipulation, Healing, Spellcaster, and Transferring Damage

channelerRhyas.name: Channeler [Rhyas]
channelerRhyas.description: While Saeryn is in Rhyas’s control range, Rhyas can channel spells through her.

focalPoint.name: Focal Point
focalPoint.description: If this model is destroyed or removed from play, remove the remaining models in this unit from play.

bodySnatcherRecycle.name: Body Snatcher: Recycle
bodySnatcherRecycle.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead model is destroyed within 4" of this model +1" for each Grunt in this unit currently in play, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time.

spawnHorrorAction.name: Spawn Horror (★Action)
spawnHorrorAction.description: Remove three corpse tokens from this model to place a non-character Faction lesser warbeast into play under your control. Place the warbeast completely within 3" of this model and choose a friendly Faction battlegroup controller. This warbeast becomes part of that battlegroup controller’s battlegroup.

leadershipStriders.name: Leadership [Striders]
leadershipStriders.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Strider models gain Swift Hunter.

deathShroud.name: Death Shroud
deathShroud.description: While within  10" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls.

darkSentinel.name: Dark Sentinel
darkSentinel.description: Once per turn, when an enemy model advances and ends its movement within 5" of this model, a friendly Faction Cohort model within 5" of this model can immediately make a full advance followed by a basic melee or ranged attack targeting the enemy model.

causticPresenceCorrosion.name: Caustic Presence [Corrosion]
causticPresenceCorrosion.description: Corrosion continuous effects that affect enemy models in this model’s control range cannot expire.

freezingMistAction.name: •Freezing Mist (★ Action)
freezingMistAction.description: Place a cloud effect template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. While in the template, living enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 to attack rolls.

bondRhyasOrSaeryn.name: Bond [Rhyas or Saeryn]
bondRhyasOrSaeryn.description: If Zuriel begins the game in Rhyas’ or Saeryn’s battlegroup, it is bonded to that model. Zuriel is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to Rhyas and in her control range, it gains Stealth. While this model is bonded to Saeryn and in her control range, it gains Unstoppable.

leadershipDawnguardDestors.name: Leadership [Dawnguard Destors]
leadershipDawnguardDestors.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Dawnguard Destor models gain Tough and Steady.

coordinatedMovement.name: Coordinated Movement
coordinatedMovement.description: Friendly models can ignore this model when determining LOS and can advance through this model if they have enough movement to move completely past it.

psychoMatrix.name: Psycho Matrix
psychoMatrix.description: This model can spend power tokens to use the following effects:

forceShield.name: •Force Shield
forceShield.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one power token to gain Force Barrier for one round. (A model with Force Barrier gains +2 DEF against ranged attack rolls and gains Resistance: Blast.)

telekineticWave.name: •Telekinetic Wave
telekineticWave.description: When this model ends its Normal Movement, it can spend one power token to use Telekinetic Wave. When it does so, choose one non-huge-based friendly Faction Cohort model within 2" of it. You can place the chosen model any where completely within 2" of its current location. A model can be placed as a result of Telekinetic Wave only once per turn.

totalDevotion.name: Total Devotion
totalDevotion.description: While this model is within 10" of its Leader, it gains +4 ARM and cannot become knocked down.

forceGate.name: Force Gate
forceGate.description: This model can spend focus points at any time during its activation to gain the following special rules, one per focus point spent. Force Gate special rules last for one round. This model loses all benefits of Force Gate while its G system is crippled.

broadcastPower.name: •Broadcast Power
broadcastPower.description: Other friendly Faction warjacks that activate within 6" of this model gain 1 focus point at the start of their activations. A warjack can gain only 1 focus point per round as a result of Broadcast Power.

repulsorField.name: •Repulsor Field
repulsorField.description: When this model is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from this model.

empoweredArcNode.name: Empowered Arc Node
empoweredArcNode.description: Once per turn, when its controller channels a spell through this model, reduce the COST of the spell by 1.

bondIssyria.name: Bond [Issyria]
bondIssyria.description: If Hemera begins the game in Issyria’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Hemera is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Hemera is bonded to Issyria and in her control range, Issyria can upkeep one spell without spending focus.

forceStrikeAttack.name: •Force Strike (★ Attack)
forceStrikeAttack.description: Force Strike is a RNG 8, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes knocked down.

concentratedPowerAction.name: •Concentrated Power (★Action)
concentratedPowerAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the warjack is in range, it gains +2 on melee damage rolls this turn.

bondOssyan.name: Bond [Ossyan]
bondOssyan.description: If Hypnos begins the game in Ossyan’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Hypnos is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Hypnos is bonded to Ossyan and in his control range, enemy models directly hit by Hypnos’ Phase Cannon weapon suffer Shadow Bind.

bondVyros.name: Bond [Vyros]
bondVyros.description: If Imperatus begins the game in Vyros’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Imperatus is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Imperatus is bonded to Vyros and in his control range, it can run or charge without spending focus.

phoenixProtocol.name: Phoenix Protocol
phoenixProtocol.description: This model can use Phoenix Protocol once per game during your Maintenance Phase or when disabled. Remove up to 1 damage point from each of its systems.

fieldMarshalTelemetry.name: Field Marshal [Telemetry]
fieldMarshalTelemetry.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Telemetry. (Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to arcane attack rolls against enemy models within 8" of a model with Telemetry.)

combustionAttack.name: Combustion (★ Attack)
combustionAttack.description: This attack does not need a target. Other models within 2" of this model suffer a POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. Combustion damage is simultaneous. This model can make additional melee attacks after making this special attack.

grantedInspiration__84dbd66e.name: Granted: Inspiration
grantedInspiration__84dbd66e.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.

grantedInspiration__d3557ad0.name: Granted: Inspiration
grantedInspiration__d3557ad0.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain +1 to attack rolls.

hooked.name: Hooked
hooked.description: When this model is placed as a result of Reel In, it may immediately make a basic melee attack targeting the enemy model hit.

carrionHex.name: •Carrion Hex
carrionHex.description: During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to cast its animus without being forced.

butcherSCurse.name: •Butcher's Curse
butcherSCurse.description: During its activation this model can spend a corpse token to cast one of the spells on its Leaders Card with a cost of 3 or less.This model cannot cast Upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL.

independentWarjack.name: Independent Warjack
independentWarjack.description: This model cannot be part of battlegroup or be 'jack marshaled. During the focus allocation step of your Control Phase, this model gains 3 focus points.

disengageSafety.name: •Disengage Safety
disengageSafety.description: This model gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls and Berserk. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.)

igniteThrusters.name: •Ignite Thrusters
igniteThrusters.description: This model gains +2 SPD, Flight, and Flame Trail. (When a model with Flame Trail advances into B2B contact with an enemy model during its activation, the enemy model suffers the Fire continuous effect.)

telescopingShields.name: •Telescoping Shields
telescopingShields.description: This model gains +2 ARM. Additionally, this model provides cover to friendly models as if it were an obstacle. This model does not provide cover while it is incorporeal or knocked down.

theButton.name: The Button
theButton.description: This model can use The Button once per game at the start of its activation. This model gains the benefits of all of its Arcane Machinery effects this activation.

heavyArtillery.name: Heavy Artillery
heavyArtillery.description: This model is not a warrior model. If this model is placed during its unit’s activation, Crewmen in the unit cannot make a Fire! special attack that activation. This model is automatically hit by melee attacks and cannot become knocked down or stationary.

fireAttack.name: Fire! (★Attack)
fireAttack.description: This model must be within 1" of the Commodore to make a Fire! special attack. Only one model in this unit can make a Fire! special attack each activation. This model makes a ranged attack with the Commodore. Both models must have LOS to the target. This model does not gain a bonus for aiming when resolving a Fire! special attack. Base the RNG and all modifiers for the attack on the Commodore.

gunneryAction.name: Gunnery (★ Action)
gunneryAction.description: RNG 3. Target Commodore. If the Commodore is in range, a model attacking with the Commodore this activation gains a cumulative +2 RAT.

selfPropelled.name: Self-Propelled
selfPropelled.description: This model cannot forfeit its Normal Movement. When this model makes its Normal Movement, instead of moving it normally you must choose the direction it is moving. It then advances its SPD +d6 in a straight line. On a roll of 6, instead of moving this model explodes with the same effect as Explosive Decomposition and is removed from play.

explosiveDecomposition.name: Explosive Decomposition
explosiveDecomposition.description: This model explodes if it contacts an enemy model while advancing or if it becomes knocked down. When this model explodes, models within 2" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 corrosion damage roll and the Corrosion continuous effect, then this model is removed from play.

skullsOfHate.name: Skulls of Hate
skullsOfHate.description: This model is a spellcaster. During your Control Phase, this model gains 1 soul token for each of its non-crippled arm systems.

necrotheurgy.name: •Necrotheurgy
necrotheurgy.description: Once during its activation this model can spend a soul token to cast a spell without spending focus.

soulGenerator.name: •Soul Generator
soulGenerator.description: At the start of this model’s activation, you can spend soul tokens on this model to give it 1 focus point for each token spent.

devourSoul.name: Devour Soul
devourSoul.description: When this model destroys a living enemy model with this weapon and generates a soul token, you can choose which model with the Soul Taker ability gains the destroyed model’s soul, regardless of the proximity of other models. Enemy models cannot gain soul tokens from models destroyed by this weapon.

chopShop.name: Chop Shop
chopShop.description: When a model in this model's battlegroup destroys an enemy construct model with a melee attack, remove d3 +1 damage points from one model in this model's battlegroup currently in its control range and remove the destroyed model from play.

fieldMarshalRetaliatoryStrike__5e463481.name: Field Marshal [Retaliatory Strike]
fieldMarshalRetaliatoryStrike__5e463481.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

carapaceGrenades.name: Carapace Grenades
carapaceGrenades.description: Once per turn when this model is hit by a melee attack, after the attack has been resolved this model can use Carapace Grenades. When it does so, enemy models within 3" of it suffer an unboostable POW 12 blast damage roll. This model loses Carapace Grenades while its S system is crippled.

tunneler.name: Tunneler
tunneler.description: This model can forfeit its Normal Movement to be placed anywhere completely within 10" of its current location. Colossal Movement does not apply to this model while resolving this rule. After it has been placed, enemy models within 2" of this model can be pushed up to 3" directly away from this model in the order you choose.

debrisField.name: Debris Field
debrisField.description: Enemy models treat open terrain within 4" of this model as rough terrain.

threshingMaw.name: Threshing Maw
threshingMaw.description: After this model is placed by Tunneler but before pushing enemy models as a result of Tunneler, enemy models within 2" of this model suffer an unboostable POW 12 melee damage roll.

voidDisruptor.name: Void Disruptor
voidDisruptor.description:
The first time each turn each enemy warjack or monstrosity ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 focus. The first time each turn each enemy horrors ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it loses 1 essence. The first time each turn each enemy warbeast ends a movement or is placed within 3" of one more more models with Void Disruptor, it gains 1 fury.

While the Hellraker has two functional Void Disruptors, enemy cohorts are affected by this ability within 6" rather than 3".

weaponsPlatform.name: Weapons Platform
weaponsPlatform.description: As long as a model has two options that include Weapons Platform special rule this model gains the Gunfighter advantage.

lostSouls.name: Lost Souls
lostSouls.description: At the start of this model’s activation, if there are no living non-soulless enemy models within 12" of this model, this model gains d3 soul tokens.

specialOrders__d1cd3306.name: •Special Orders
specialOrders__d1cd3306.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

enlivenAction__8c184128.name: Enliven (★Action)
enlivenAction__8c184128.description: RNG 3. Target friendly Faction Cohort model. If the target is in range, the next time it suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the target can make a full advance, then Enliven expires. Enliven lasts for one round.

thrallCrafting.name: •Thrall Crafting
thrallCrafting.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend up to three corpse tokens to put one friendly Corpse Crawler into play for each token spent. You can have up to three friendly Corpse Crawlers in play at any time for each friendly Necroharvester in play. Place the Crawlers B2B with this model.

bodySnatcherHarvester.name: Body Snatcher: Harvester
bodySnatcherHarvester.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When a living or undead friendly model is destroyed by an enemy attack within 8" of this model or when a living or undead enemy model is destroyed within 8" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to three corpse tokens at any time. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

acidicMist.name: Acidic Mist
acidicMist.description: This model has concealment. Living enemy models without Resistance: Corrosion suffer –2 to attack rolls while within 2" of this model.

acidBlast.name: Acid Blast
acidBlast.description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it suffer a POW 12 corrosion blast damage roll and the corrosion continuous effect.

leadershipMechanithrallSwarm.name: Leadership [Mechanithrall Swarm]
leadershipMechanithrallSwarm.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Mechanithrall Swarm models gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

desperateMissionAction.name: •Desperate Mission (★ Action)
desperateMissionAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Last Word. Desperate Mission lasts for one round. (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.)

mortalFear.name: Mortal Fear
mortalFear.description: While within 8" of this model, living enemy models suffer –2 to damage rolls.

stygianAbyssAttack.name: •Stygian Abyss (★ Attack)
stygianAbyssAttack.description: Stygian Abyss is a RNG 10, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit, the model hit suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or magic attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

wraithbinder.name: Wraithbinder
wraithbinder.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Incorporeal models gain +3 ARM.

grapplingHook.name: Grappling Hook
grapplingHook.description: At the end this models activation, this model can spend 1 focus point to be placed completely within 5" of its current location.

limitedBattlegroupRazor.name: Limited Battlegroup [Razor]
limitedBattlegroupRazor.description: The only warjack that can be in this model’s battlegroup is Razor.

razorWindAttack.name: •Razor Wind (★Attack)
razorWindAttack.description: Razor Wind is a RNG SP 10, POW 12 arcane attack. On a critical hit on a warjack or warbeast, fill in the unmarked damage boxes or circles on the last column or branch damaged.

invokeTheBeastAction.name: •Invoke the Beast (★Action)
invokeTheBeastAction.description: RNG 8. Target friendly Marked model. If the target is in range, replace it with Shapeshifer model that has not yet been put into play. The replaced model is removed from play. When a Shapeshifter model replaces a model that has entered play this turn or that had already activated this turn, it must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn. When the Shapeshifter model replaces a  model, that model is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area. When the Shapeshifter is destroyed, remove it from play.

ritesOfSpringAction.name: •Rites of Spring (★Action)
ritesOfSpringAction.description: Remove d3 damage points from each friendly living Faction model currently within 6" of this model.

toilAndTrouble.name: Toil and Trouble
toilAndTrouble.description: While within 3" of this model, +1" for every corpse token on this model,  enemy models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the highest die of each roll.

peakAndPineAttack.name: •Peak and Pine (★ Attack)
peakAndPineAttack.description: This model can spend a corpse token to make a range 8, POW 12 arcane attack. If this attack damages an enemy model, this model’s Leader can transfer damage to the affected model one time, then Peak and Pine expires. Peak and Pine lasts for one round.

fogAndFilthyAir.name: •Fog and Filthy Air
fogAndFilthyAir.description:
During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to use
Fog and Filthy Air. Target friendly Faction model within 5" of this model. If the model is in range, it gains Concealment for one round.

liveDeliciously.name: Live Deliciously
liveDeliciously.description: Friendly faction Shapeshifter models within 5" of this model gain Bloodthirst. (When a model with Bloodthirst charges a living or undead model, this model gains +2" movement.)

primordialRage.name: Primordial Rage
primordialRage.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Retaliation. (If a model with Retaliation was damaged by an enemy attack during the last round, during your Maintenance Phase it can advance up to 3" and make one basic melee attack.)

primordialResillience.name: Primordial Resillience
primordialResillience.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Unyielding. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

primordialWarding.name: Primordial Warding
primordialWarding.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Shapeshifter models gain Sacred Ward. (A model with Sacred Ward cannot be targeted by enemy spells.)

boneWorking__52951f94.name: Bone Working
boneWorking__52951f94.description: When a model within 8" of this model makes an attack or damage roll, this model can spend a corpse token to cause that model to reroll the roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Bone Working.

buzzingSwarm.name: Buzzing Swarm
buzzingSwarm.description: While within 2" of this model, models gain concealment. Additionally, while within 2" of this model, enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls.

temperedShifting.name: Tempered Shifting
temperedShifting.description: Morozov begins the game in Human Form. When Morozov suffers damage from a continuous effect or enemy attack, after the damage has been resolved you can choose to replace Morozov's Human Form with his Shifted Form. If you choose to do so, remove all damage from Morozov. Effects on the replaced model are applied to the alternate form. When one form replaces another, the new form is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering.

fieldMarshalRighteousVengeance.name: Field Marshal [Righteous Vengeance]
fieldMarshalRighteousVengeance.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Righteous Vengeance.

ursineShifted.name: Ursine Shifted
ursineShifted.description: This model counts as an Ursine Shifted and shapeshifter model.

soothingCall.name: •Soothing Call
soothingCall.description: Remove up to 1 fury point from each friendly living Faction warbeast currently within 10" of this model.

battleFormation.name: •Battle Formation
battleFormation.description: While in this model's control range and B2B with one or more models in its battlegroup, friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down. Battle Formation lasts for one round.

imbuedWrath.name: Imbued Wrath
imbuedWrath.description: Warjacks in this model's battlegroup can be allocated or gain up to 4 focus instead of 3.

primalAspects.name: Primal Aspects
primalAspects.description: This model can use one of the following special rules at any time during each of its unit’s activations. Each model in this unit gains the benefits listed.

cunningOfTheWolf.name: •Cunning of the Wolf
cunningOfTheWolf.description: Affected models gain Prowl for one round. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

chargeOfTheStag.name: •Charge of the Stag
chargeOfTheStag.description: Affected models' melee weapons gain Brutal Charge for one turn. (A weapon with Brutal Charge gains +2 to charge attack damage rolls.)

pathOfTheLynx.name: •Path of the Lynx
pathOfTheLynx.description: Affected models gain Tree Walker for one round. (A model with Treewalker ignores forests when determining LOS. While completely within a forest, this model gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls.)

desperatePaceSmallBasedLiegemen.name: •Desperate Pace [Small-Based Liegemen]
desperatePaceSmallBasedLiegemen.description: RNG 5. Target friendly small based Liegemen trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

veteranLeaderLiegemen.name: Veteran Leader [Liegemen]
veteranLeaderLiegemen.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Liegemen models gain +1 to attack rolls.

bodySnatcherTrophyHunter.name: Body Snatcher: Trophy Hunter
bodySnatcherTrophyHunter.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can have up to five corpse tokens at any time. It gains the following abilities based on the number of corpse tokens it has:

1OrMoreCorpseTokens__fab13ce7.name: •1 or more corpse tokens
1OrMoreCorpseTokens__fab13ce7.description: When this model has at least one corpse token, enemy models within 10" and LOS lose Stealth.

3OrMoreCorpseTokens.name: •3 or more corpse tokens
3OrMoreCorpseTokens.description: When this model has at least three corpse tokens, Lord of the Hunt gains Hunter and its Thrown Javelin becomes ROF 2. (A model with Hunter ignores concealment and cover when making ranged attacks.)

5OrMoreCorpseTokens.name: •5 or more corpse tokens
5OrMoreCorpseTokens.description: When this model has at least five corpse tokens it gains Hunt Eternal. (When a model with Hunt Eternal is disabled, remove all corpse tokens and damage from it; it is no longer disabled.)

shapeshifter.name: Shapeshifter
shapeshifter.description: This model does not begin the game in play. When a friendly Marked model is disabled by an enemy attack or as the result of a continuous effect, this model can immediately  replace it. The replaced model is removed from play. When a Shapeshifter model replaces a model that entered play this turn or that already activated this turn, it must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn. When this model replaces a disabled model, this model is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area. When this model is destroyed, remove it from play.

leadershipLupineShifted.name: Leadership [Lupine Shifted]
leadershipLupineShifted.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Lupine Shifted models gain Jump.

fieldMarshalTreewalker.name: Field Marshal [Treewalker]
fieldMarshalTreewalker.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Treewalker.

1OrMoreCorpseTokens.name: •1 or more corpse tokens
1OrMoreCorpseTokens.description: When this model has at least one corpse it can run or charge without being forced.

3OrMoreCorpseTokens__bb352338.name: •3 or more corpse tokens
3OrMoreCorpseTokens__bb352338.description: When this model has at least three corpse tokens, it's weapons gain Grievous Wounds.  (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

5OrMoreCorpseTokens__d9132daa.name: •5 or more corpse tokens
5OrMoreCorpseTokens__d9132daa.description: When this model has at least five corpse tokens this model gains +2 on damage rolls

curseShapeshifter.name: Curse [Shapeshifter]
curseShapeshifter.description: This model can use Curse once per activation at any time. Choose an enemy model/unit within 10" of this model. Friendly Shapeshifter models gain +2 to attack rolls against the chosen model/unit. Curse lasts for one turn.

invokeTheBeast.name: Invoke the Beast
invokeTheBeast.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can cause a friendly Marked model within 8" of it to be replaced with Shapeshifer model that has not yet been put into play. The replaced model is removed from play. When a Shapeshifter model replaces a model that entered play this turn or that already activated this turn, it must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn. When the Shapeshifter model replaces a  model, that model is not considered to have entered an area and does not trigger effects triggered by entering that area. When the Shapeshifte is destroyed, remove it from play.

marked.name: Marked
marked.description: This model is a Marked model.

scapegoat.name: Scapegoat
scapegoat.description: When a friendly Faction model is directly hit by a melee attack while within 3" of a model with Scapegoat, you can choose to have the model with Scapegoat be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Scapegoat only once per round and cannot use Scapegoat if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Scapegoat can only be used once per attack.

admonition.name: Admonition
admonition.description: Once per round when an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed within 6" of this model, this model can immediately advance up to 3".

putridDecay.name: •Putrid Decay
putridDecay.description: During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to gain Foul Stench for one round. (While within 5" of a model with Foul Stench, living enemy warbeasts suffer –1 FURY and THR.)

hungerPain.name: •Hunger Pain
hungerPain.description: During its activation, this model can spend a corpse token to gain Gnawing Pain for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Gnawing Pain, enemy models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls.)

defiantRage.name: Defiant Rage
defiantRage.description: When this model is damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved this model gains +2 ARM and +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round.

leadershipUrsineShifted.name: Leadership [Ursine Shifted]
leadershipUrsineShifted.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Ursine Shifted models gain Defiant Rage, and Retaliatory Strike.

protectiveRage.name: Protective Rage
protectiveRage.description: When a friendly Faction model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack, if this model is not yet in play you can choose to have this model replace a friendly Faction Marked model within 3" of the model hit.  This model is automatically hit instead and suffers all damage and effects. Remove the replaced Marked model from play. Protective Rage can only be used once per attack.

arcaneManifestation.name: Arcane Manifestation
arcaneManifestation.description: Once per turn, at any time during its activation, place this model anywhere completely within 10" of its current location.

briarThicket.name: Briar Thicket
briarThicket.description: An enemy model without Flight entering or ending its activation within 2" of this model suffers a POW 10 damage roll. Warrior models damaged by this roll become knocked down.

shiftingSandsStance.name: Shifting Sands Stance
shiftingSandsStance.description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action to gain +2 DEF. If an enemy attack misses it at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved this model can immediately make a full advance. Shifting Sands Stance lasts for one round.

avatar.name: Avatar
avatar.description: This model cannot be part of a battlegroup or be ’jack marshaled and does not have a functional cortex. This model never suffers Disruption. This model can have up to 4 focus points at any time. During the focus allocation step of your Control Phase, this model receives d3+1 focus points.

menothsGaze.name: Menoth’s Gaze
menothsGaze.description: This model can spend 1 focus point at any time during its activation to use Menoth’s Gaze. For one round, enemy models that begin their activation within 8" of this model and in its LOS can advance only toward this model.

bondThyra.name: Bond [Thyra]
bondThyra.description: If Blood of Martyrs begins the game in Thyra’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Blood of Martyrs is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Blood of Martyrs is bonded to Thyra and in her control range, it gains Apparition. (During your Control Phase, place models with Apparition anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations.)

leadershipPaladin.name: Leadership [Paladin]
leadershipPaladin.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Paladin models gain Girded.

bondMalekus.name: Bond [Malekus]
bondMalekus.description: If Eye of Truth begins the game in Malekus’ battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Eye of Truth is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While Eye of Truth is bonded to Malekus and in his control range, he can channel spells through it.

holyLight.name: Holy Light
holyLight.description: While within 5" of this model, friendly models ignore bonuses from spells that add to an enemy model’s ARM or DEF.

fieldMarshalAggressive.name: Field Marshal [Aggressive]
fieldMarshalAggressive.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup can run or charge without spending focus.

whipTheFlames.name: Whip the Flames
whipTheFlames.description: Enemy models suffering the fire continuous effect while in this model’s control range suffer –2 to attack rolls.

causticPresenceFire.name: Caustic Presence [Fire]
causticPresenceFire.description: Fire continuous effects that affect enemy models in this model’s control range cannot expire.

righteousFlames.name: Righteous Flames
righteousFlames.description: An enemy model that ends its activation within 2" of this model suffers the Fire continuous effect.

flameTrail.name: Flame Trail
flameTrail.description: When this model advances into B2B contact with an enemy model during its activation, the enemy model suffers the Fire continuous effect.

blazingWrath.name: Blazing Wrath
blazingWrath.description: This model can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without spending focus or being forced.

bondFeora.name: Bond [Feora]
bondFeora.description: If Hand of Judgment begins the game in Feora’s battlegroup, it is bonded to her. Hand of Judgment is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Hand of Judgment is bonded to Feora and in her control range, it gains boosted ranged attack rolls.

fieldMarshalOracularVision.name: Field Marshal [Oracular Vision]
fieldMarshalOracularVision.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Oracular Vision.

oracularVision.name: Oracular Vision
oracularVision.description: Once per turn when this model is directly hit by an attack, it can immediately spend 1 focus or fury point to not suffer a damage roll from the attack.

fieldMarshalUnstoppable__d8b969f4.name: Field Marshal [Unstoppable]
fieldMarshalUnstoppable__d8b969f4.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup gain Unstoppable.

excruciator.name: Excruciator
excruciator.description: When this model boxes a living enemy warrior model with a melee attack, you can place a Wrack into play completely within 4" of this model. If you do, remove the boxed model from play.

witchHound.name: Witch Hound
witchHound.description: When an enemy model hits one or more models in this model’s battlegroup with an arcane attack, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in this model’s battlegroup in its control range can advance up to 3" and make one basic attack.

sufferingsPrayer.name: Suffering’s Prayer
sufferingsPrayer.description:
This model begins the game with 1 focus point. During your Control Phase, this model receives 1 focus point if it does not have any. This model cannot have more than 1 focus point at any time. While this model has a focus point, it cannot be damaged by ranged attacks. During a friendly Faction warcaster’s activation, it can remove 1 focus point from this model in its control range and gain that focus point. Each warcaster can do this only once per turn. When a focus point is removed from this model, roll a d6. On a 1 or 2, this model explodes with the same effect as Fiery Blast and is removed from
play.

leadershipPaladinsOfTheOrderOfTheWall.name: Leadership [Paladins of the Order of the Wall]
leadershipPaladinsOfTheOrderOfTheWall.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Paladins of the Order of the Wall gain Righteous Vengeance.

stoneAndMortarStance.name: Stone-and-Mortar Stance
stoneAndMortarStance.description: During its activation, this model can forfeit its Normal Movement or Combat Action to gain +3 ARM. The affected model cannot become knocked down. Stone-and-Mortar Stance lasts for one round.

prayers.name: Prayers
prayers.description: At the start of this unit's activation, choose one of the following special rules:

fervor.name: •Fervor
fervor.description: Models in this unit gain +2 to damage rolls this activation.

pathOfFlames.name: •Path of Flames
pathOfFlames.description: Models in this unit gain Resistance: Fire for one round.

warding.name: •Warding
warding.description: Models in this unit cannot be trargeted by enemy spells for one round.

greaterDestiny.name: Greater Destiny
greaterDestiny.description: This model can use Greater Destiny once per game at the start of its unit’s activation. Immediately return all Grunts to this unit that were destroyed during your opponent’s last turn to play. Place them within 2" of this model. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

holyMonolith.name: Holy Monolith
holyMonolith.description: When one or more other models in this unit are damaged by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved models in this unit gain +4 ARM for one turn.

callToSacrificeHolyZealot.name: Call to Sacrifice [Holy Zealot]
callToSacrificeHolyZealot.description: If this model is disabled by an enemy attack, you can choose a non-disabled friendly Holy Zealot trooper model within 5" of this model to be destroyed. If another model is destroyed as a result of Call to Sacrifice, remove 1 damage point from this model.

consecration.name: Consecration
consecration.description: While within 6" of this model, enemy models cannot cast, channel, or upkeep spells.

soulTakerCenotaph.name: Soul Taker: Cenotaph
soulTakerCenotaph.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living Faction model is destroyed within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. At the start of this model’s activation, you can remove soul tokens from this model to give it 1 focus point for each token removed.

leadershipExemplarVengers.name: Leadership [Exemplar Vengers]
leadershipExemplarVengers.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Exemplar Venger models gain Divine Inspiration.

fieldMarshalBlazingWrath.name: Field Marshal [Blazing Wrath]
fieldMarshalBlazingWrath.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Blazing Wrath. (A model with Blazing Wrath can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without spending focus of being forced.)

impenetrableShield.name: Impenetrable Shield
impenetrableShield.description: While this model is B2B with one or more friendly Temple Flameguard models, it does not suffer damage from non-magical melee or ranged attacks.

soulPhase.name: Soul Phase
soulPhase.description: This model can spend a soul token at the beginning of your Control Phase to gain Incorporeal for one turn.

flamesOfWrathAction.name: •Flames of Wrath (★Action)
flamesOfWrathAction.description: Choose a friendly Faction model/unit. For one round, enemy models directly hit by melee or ranged attacks made by the affected models suffer the Fire continuous effect.

lawgiversCreedAction.name: •Lawgiver’s Creed (★Action)
lawgiversCreedAction.description: For one round, enemy models cannot cast spells while within 10" of this model.

powerOfFaithAction.name: •Power of Faith (★Action)
powerOfFaithAction.description: For one round, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down or stationary while within 5" of this model.

martyrdom.name: Martyrdom
martyrdom.description: When a friendly living Faction non-Leader warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled, this model can suffer d3 damage points to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model. This model cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.

eliteCadreDaughtersOfTheFlame.name: Elite Cadre [Daughters of the Flame]
eliteCadreDaughtersOfTheFlame.description: Friendly Daughters of the Flame models gain Vengeance.  (During your Maintenance Phase, if one or more models in a unit with Vengeance were damaged by enemy attacks during the last round, each model in the unit can make a Vengeance Move. A model making a Vengeance Move can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only make one Vengeance Move each turn.)

gatesOfDeath.name: Gates of Death
gatesOfDeath.description: At the end of your turn, place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location.

holyReliquary.name: Holy Reliquary
holyReliquary.description: This model can use each of the following miracles once per turn. This model suffers d3 damage points each time it uses a miracle. This damage is suffered immediately after the miracle takes effect.

bondsOfFaith.name: •Bonds of Faith
bondsOfFaith.description: This model can use this miracle at any time during its activation. Remove d3 damage points from each other friendly Faction models within 10" of this model. Additionally, when this miracle is used, enemy upkeep spells and animi on models/units within 10" of this model immediately expire. A spellcaster can keep any of its upkeep spells in play by suffering d3 damage points per spell.

doorsOfJudgment.name: •Doors of Judgment
doorsOfJudgment.description: Once per turn when a friendly living Faction warrior model within 10" of this model is disabled by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, this model can use this miracle. The disabled model can immediately make a full advance and can make one basic attack, then the disabled model is destroyed.

eruptionOfFaith.name: •Eruption of Faith
eruptionOfFaith.description: This model can use this miracle once per turn at any time during its activation. When this miracle is used, enemy models currently within 2" of this model suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect and are pushed 4" directly away from this model in the order you choose.

godsWrath.name: •God’s Wrath
godsWrath.description: This model can use this miracle at any time during its activation. This model can make one additional ranged attack during its Combat Action this activation.

giftsOfAnnihilation.name: Gifts of Annihilation
giftsOfAnnihilation.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can use one of the following effects. Gifts of Annihilation effects last for one round.

darkRituals.name: •Dark Rituals
darkRituals.description: This model can channel spells through friendly Faction warrior models in its control range. Immediately after a spell is channeled through a model as a result of Dark Rituals, the model it was channeled through suffers d3 points of magical damage.

fateBinder.name: •Fate Binder
fateBinder.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Shield Guard. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

nightReaper.name: •Night Reaper
nightReaper.description: This model gains Carrion Feast and Entropic Force. (When a living or undead model is destroyed while within 5" of a model with Carrion Feast, you can choose to have that model be removed from play. If a model is removed from play as a result of Carrion Feast, it does not generate a corpse token and the model with Carrion Feast can remove d3 damage points.) (While within 5" of a model with Entropic Force, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them.)

accursedArmor.name: Accursed Armor
accursedArmor.description: A living enemy model that hits this model with an attack gains Weaken for one round. (A model with Weaken suffers -2 DEF and -2 to its melee attack damage rolls.)

forceMastery.name: Force Mastery
forceMastery.description: This model cannot become knocked down. While in this model's control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast and do not suffer collateral damage.

accumulatorEllowuyr.name: Accumulator [Ellowuyr]
accumulatorEllowuyr.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Ellowuyr warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

focusedPower.name: Focused Power
focusedPower.description: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, its ranged weapon gains +2 RNG and it gains +2 to its ranged attack damage rolls that activation.

bondRahn.name: Bond [Rahn]
bondRahn.description: If Discordia begins the game in Rahn’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Discordia is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. When Discordia spends a focus point to use Focus-Charged: Kinetic Field while it is bonded to Rahn and in his control range, Rahn also gains Kinetic Field for one round.

focusChargedKineticField.name: Focus-Charged: Kinetic Field
focusChargedKineticField.description: This model can spend 1 focus point at any time during its activation to gain Kinetic Field for one round. (A model with Kinetic Field and friendly Faction models within 3" of it gain +2 ARM against ranged attacks and gain: Resistance Blast.)

fieldMarshalRetaliatoryStrike.name: Field Marshal [Retaliatory Strike]
fieldMarshalRetaliatoryStrike.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike.

bondGarryth.name: Bond [Garryth]
bondGarryth.description: If Moros begins the game in Garryth’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Moros is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Moros is bonded to Garryth and in his control range, it gains Acrobatics. (A model with Acrobatics can advance through other models if it has enough movement to move completely past their bases. A model with Acrobatics ignores intervening models when declaring its charge target.)

fieldMarshalPathfinderAndProwl.name: Field Marshal [Pathfinder and Prowl]
fieldMarshalPathfinderAndProwl.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Pathfinder and Prowl.

leadershipHouseEllowuyr.name: Leadership [House Ellowuyr]
leadershipHouseEllowuyr.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly House Ellowuyr models gain Side Step.

forceBoltAttack.name: •Force Bolt (★Attack)
forceBoltAttack.description: Force Bolt is a RNG 10, POW 10 arcane attack. An enemy model hit by this attack can be pushed d3" directly toward or directly away from this model. Choose the direction before rolling the distance. On a critical hit, the enemy model becomes knocked down after being pushed.

forceWallAction.name: •Force Wall (★Action)
forceWallAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Force Barrier for one round.

leadershipBattleMages.name: Leadership [Battle Mages]
leadershipBattleMages.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Battle Mage models gain Battle Wizard.

whipSnapAttack.name: •Whip Snap (★Attack)
whipSnapAttack.description: Whip Snap is a RNG 6, POW 12 arcane attack. If this attack hits an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved this model or a friendly Faction non-trooper model within 3" of it can advance up to 2". A model can advance only once per turn as a result of Whip Snap.

veteranLeaderShyeelTrooper.name: Veteran Leader [Shyeel trooper]
veteranLeaderShyeelTrooper.description: While within 10" of this model, Shyeel trooper models gain +1 to attack rolls.

desperatePaceHouseguard.name: •Desperate Pace [Houseguard]
desperatePaceHouseguard.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Houseguard trooper model. If the model is in range,  models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

firingSolutionHouseguard.name: •Firing Solution [Houseguard]
firingSolutionHouseguard.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Houseguard trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit ignore Stealth this turn.

fieldMarshalArcaneVortex.name: Field Marshal [Arcane Vortex]
fieldMarshalArcaneVortex.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Arcane Vortex.

phantomBarrage.name: Phantom Barrage
phantomBarrage.description: Once per game at any time during its unit’s activation, this model can use Phantom Barrage. This activation, models in this unit can ignore cloud effects, forest terrain, and intervening models when determining LOS.

leadershipMageHunter.name: Leadership [Mage Hunter]
leadershipMageHunter.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Mage Hunter models gain Sprint.

arcaneAnnihilation.name: Arcane Annihilation
arcaneAnnihilation.description: When this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, models within 8" of it lose their focus and fury points and cannot cast spells, channel spells, summon horrors, or be forced for one round.

fieldMarshalSideStep.name: Field Marshal [Side Step]
fieldMarshalSideStep.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Side Step.

limitedBattlegroupBarrowGhoulAndCharnelH.name: Limited Battlegroup [Barrow Ghoul and Charnel Hound]
limitedBattlegroupBarrowGhoulAndCharnelH.description: The only warbeasts that can be in this model’s battlegroup are Barrow Ghoul and Charnel Hound.

takeUp__bdc4f9fe.name: Take Up
takeUp__bdc4f9fe.description: If this model is destroyed by an effect other than Take Up, you can choose a grunt in this unit within 1" of it to be destroyed instead. Remove that grunt from the table instead of this model. This model has the same number of unmarked damage boxes as the chosen grunt.

bladeGlide.name: Blade Glide
bladeGlide.description: While making a trample power attack, this model gains +3 SPD and does not stop when it contacts a model with a medium or larger base, an obstacle, or an obstruction. This model makes trample attacks against models regardless of their base size. This model cannot hit models occupying buildings with its trample power attacks.

hellMarked__d23853ba.name: Hell Marked
hellMarked__d23853ba.description: Models destroyed by attacks made by this model never generate soul tokens.

hellHunter.name: Hell Hunter
hellHunter.description: When this model destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack during its activation, immediately after the attack is resolved one Cohort model in this model’s battlegroup that is in its control range can advance up to 3".

bondProwl.name: Bond (Prowl)
bondProwl.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Prowl. (While a model with Prowl has concealment, it gains Stealth.)

soulBank.name: Soul Bank
soulBank.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, once during each of your Leader’s activations it can remove one soul token from this model to gain one focus point.

fateBlessed.name: Fate Blessed
fateBlessed.description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack or damage roll during its activation while in this model’s control range, this model can spend 1 focus or fury point to allow the model to reroll that roll. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fate Blessed.

fieldMarshalHomicidalManiac.name: Field Marshal [Homicidal Maniac]
fieldMarshalHomicidalManiac.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Homicidal Maniac.

rageHowler.name: •Rage Howler
rageHowler.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend one rage token to gain Mortal Fear. Rage Howler lasts for one round. (While within 8" of a model with Mortal Fear, living enemy models suffer –2 to damage rolls.)

veteranLeaderWarwitchCoven.name: Veteran Leader [Warwitch Coven]
veteranLeaderWarwitchCoven.description: While within 10" of this model, Warwitch models gain +1 to attack rolls.

deathlyPowerAction.name: •Deathly Power (★ Action)
deathlyPowerAction.description: This model gains Dark Shroud for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.)

empowerAction__d8c59268.name: •Empower (★Action)
empowerAction__d8c59268.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction warjack. If the target warjack is in range and it was suffering Disruption, it is no longer disrupted. The warjack gains 1 focus point.

fleshEaterAttack.name: •Flesh Eater (★ Attack)
fleshEaterAttack.description: Flesh Eater is a RNG 8, POW 10 arcane attack. When Flesh Eater destroys an enemy warrior model, you can remove d3 damage points from a friendly living model within 6" of this model.

innatePower.name: Innate Power
innatePower.description: Reduce the COST of spells cast by this model by 1.

entropicPresence.name: Entropic Presence
entropicPresence.description: This model can be forced to gain Master of Ruin once per activation. Entropic Presence lasts for one round. (Other models, friendly or enemy, suffer -2 ARM while within 5" of a model with Master of Ruin.)

firestarterAction.name: •Firestarter (★Action)
firestarterAction.description: RNG 6. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, its melee and ranged weapons gain Continuous Effect: Fire for one turn.

howlingFlamesAttack.name: •Howling Flames (★Attack)
howlingFlamesAttack.description: Howling Flames is a RNG SP 10 and POW 13 arcane attack. This attack causes fire damage and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

fieldMarshalRunGun.name: Field Marshal [Run & Gun]
fieldMarshalRunGun.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Run & Gun.

blightedSurge.name: Blighted Surge
blightedSurge.description: When this model is hit by an enemy melee or ranged attack, you can remove one fury point from it. After the attack has been resolved, this model can be forced to cast its animus.

temperedRage.name: Tempered Rage
temperedRage.description: During your Maintenance Phase, if this model is within its battlegroup controller’s control range, you can remove any number of fury points from this model.

rejuvenatingMiasma.name: Rejuvenating Miasma
rejuvenatingMiasma.description: While within 3" of this model, friendly Faction models gain concealment. Friendly Faction models activating within 3" of this model can immediately remove d3 damage points.

arcaneNegation.name: Arcane Negation
arcaneNegation.description: When an enemy model targets this model or another model within 3" of it with a spell, you can force this model to negate the spell. The negated spell does not take effect, but its COST remains spent.

mageWard.name: Mage Ward
mageWard.description: While within 6" of this model, friendly models gain Magic Resistance. (When this model is targeted by an arcane attack roll, roll one additional die. Discard the highest die of each roll).

warpingWinds.name: Warping Winds
warpingWinds.description: When a friendly Faction model is targeted by a ranged attack while within 3" of this model, the attack suffers –3 RNG. Additionally, while within 3" of this model friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Blast.

destructionSpawned.name: Destruction-Spawned
destructionSpawned.description: This model does not begin the game in play. When a friendly Exalted solo with Soul Taker: Requiem is destroyed in Supreme Aptimus Zaal’s control range, replace the Exalted solo with a Kovaas unless there is already a friendly Kovaas in play. If the Exalted solo had soul tokens on it when it was destroyed, place up to three of those soul tokens on the Kovaas replacing it. Effects on the destroyed Exalted solo expire. The Kovaas cannot activate the turn it is put in play.

vampiricReaving.name: Vampiric Reaving
vampiricReaving.description: This model can reave fury points from enemy warbeasts destroyed in its control range if it is closer to the warbeast than all other models that could reave its fury.

flankReptileHound.name: Flank [Reptile Hound]
flankReptileHound.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another friendly Reptile Hound, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

flagellant.name: Flagellant
flagellant.description: Friendly models can target this model with attacks. This model is automatically hit by melee attacks made by friendly models.

ritesOfSuffering.name: Rites of Suffering
ritesOfSuffering.description: When this model suffers damage from an attack, it gains one blood token. For each blood token on this model, it gains +1 ARM and +1 to its melee attack damage rolls. This model can have up to five blood tokens at any time. Remove all blood tokens from this model at the start of your Control Phase.

noSleepingOnTheJobMercenary.name: No Sleeping on the Job [Mercenary]
noSleepingOnTheJobMercenary.description: This model and friendly Mercenary models within 10" of it cannot become knocked down.

painDriverAction.name: Pain Driver (★Action)
painDriverAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly non-Leader Mercenary warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains +2 to its melee attack damage rolls for one turn.

scutterAction.name: Scutter (★Action)
scutterAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly non-Leader Mercenary warrior model. If the model is in range, it gains Reposition [3"] for one turn. (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

temperFleshAction.name: Temper Flesh (★Action)
temperFleshAction.description: RNG 3. Target friendly non-Leader Mercenary warrior model/unit. If the model/unit is in range, it gains Tough for one round.

ghostSight.name: Ghost Sight
ghostSight.description: This model does not require LOS to a target when casting spells or making making ranged or arcane attacks. This model ignores concealment and cover when resolving ranged and arcane attacks.

soulConverter.name: Soul Converter
soulConverter.description: Once per turn at any time during its activation, this model can spend 1 fury point to give each friendly Exalted model with Soul Taker: Requiem currently in its control range one soul token.

battleConfigurationSkyStormerOrGroundAss.name: Battle Configuration [Sky Stormer or Ground Assault]
battleConfigurationSkyStormerOrGroundAss.description: Before the start of the game and at the start of each of your Maintenance Phases after your first turn, choose a configuration for this model to take: Sky Stormer or Ground Assault. Use that configuration’s stats and rules for one round.

fieldMarshalSteadySturdy.name: Field Marshal [Steady & Sturdy]
fieldMarshalSteadySturdy.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup cannot become knocked down or pushed.

superconduction3.name: Superconduction [3"]
superconduction3.description: When a friendly Faction model makes an attack with a ranged weapon with Damage Type: Electricity targeting an enemy model within 3" of this model, the attacking model gains +2 to its attack roll.

gmpBlast.name: GMP Blast
gmpBlast.description: When this model is destroyed, models within 2" of it and without Resistance: Electricity, suffer disruption.

targetable.name: Targetable
targetable.description: This model can be targeted by attacks made by either player. Friendly models cannot target this model with a charge

journeymanWarcaster__b79a4f47.name: Journeyman Warcaster
