journeymanWarcaster__b79a4f47.description: This model is not a warcaster or Leader, but has the following warcaster special rules: Battlegroup Controller, Focus Manipulation, Power Field, and Spellcaster. This model must have at least one warjack in its battlegroup at the start of the game.

fieldMarshalSwiftHunter.name: Field Marshal [Swift Hunter]
fieldMarshalSwiftHunter.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Swift Hunter.

accumulatorStormLegionWarrior.name: Accumulator [Storm Legion warrior]
accumulatorStormLegionWarrior.description: When this model begins its activation within 3" of one or more friendly Storm Legion warrior models, this model gains 1 focus point.

bondBeatBack.name: Bond (Beat Back)
bondBeatBack.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Beat Back. (Immediately after a basic attack with a weapon with Beat Back is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.)

bondRetaliatoryStrike.name: Bond (Retaliatory Strike)
bondRetaliatoryStrike.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Retaliatory Strike. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

bondGuardDog.name: Bond (Guard Dog)
bondGuardDog.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Guard Dog. (While a model with Guard Dog is within 3" of its Leader and is not knocked down or stationary, its Leader gains +2 DEF against melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down.)

secondaryNeuralCoupling.name: Secondary Neural Coupling
secondaryNeuralCoupling.description: Remove 1 damage point from this model at the start of each of its activations.

launchDroneServitor.name: Launch Drone Servitor
launchDroneServitor.description: Once per turn at any time during this model’s activation, you can place one Drone Servitor into play completely within 2" of this model if you do not pesently have two Drone Servitor in play.

powerSurgeAttack.name: Power Surge (★Attack)
powerSurgeAttack.description: This attack does not need a target. Each enemy model within 3" of this model or 1" of a Drone Servitor is automatically hit and suffers a POW 12 electrical damage roll. Energy Pulse damage rolls are simultaneous. After a Power Surge attack, this model can make additional melee attacks.

tempestAnchor.name: Tempest Anchor
tempestAnchor.description: Once per turn, at any time during its activation this model can advance up to 3" directly towards a friendly Drone Servitor, which is then destroyed.

galvanicStrikeAction.name: Galvanic Strike (★Action)
galvanicStrikeAction.description: Target  friendly Drone within 8" of this model is slammed D6" in a direction of your choice. Collateral damage from this slam is POW 14

ballisticCorrection.name: Ballistic Correction
ballisticCorrection.description: If this model uses its Normal Movement to aim, its ranged weapons gain +2 RNG that activation.

bigGameHunter.name: Big Game Hunter
bigGameHunter.description: This model gains an additional die on its melee and ranged damage rolls against Cohorts.

fieldMarshalNorthkin.name: Field Marshal [Northkin]
fieldMarshalNorthkin.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup are Northkin models and gain Resistance: Cold.

elementalCommunion.name: Elemental Communion
elementalCommunion.description: While within 2" of shallow water, this model gains +2 DEF. While within 2" of an obstacle or obstruction, this model gains +2 ARM. If this model begins its activation within 2" of rough terrain, it gains +2 SPD this activation.

stormsEmbrace5.name: Storm’s Embrace [5"]
stormsEmbrace5.description: While within 5" of this model, friendly Northkin models gain concealment.

beerWagon.name: Beer Wagon
beerWagon.description: While within 5" of this model, friendly Northkin warbeasts and warrior models gain Stumbling Drunk. Beer Wagon lasts for one round. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

owlsWisdomAction.name: Owl’s Wisdom (★Action)
owlsWisdomAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction model. If the model is in range, enemy upkeep spells and animi on it expire and it cannot be targeted by enemy spells for one round.

protectiveAura.name: Protective Aura
protectiveAura.description: Friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM while within 8" of this model.

northkinUnit.name: Northkin Unit
northkinUnit.description: Models in this model’s unit are Northkin models and gain Resistance: Cold.

stoneWarp.name: Stone Warp
stoneWarp.description: This model can use one of the following effects each turn at any time during its unit’s activation:

stoneCold.name: •Stone Cold
stoneCold.description: While within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, friendly Northkin warrior models gain +2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Stone Cold lasts for one round.

wildWinds.name: •Wild Winds
wildWinds.description: This unit and friendly Northkin models activating within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura gain +1 SPD. Wild Winds lasts for one turn.

winterMagic.name: •Winter Magic
winterMagic.description: When a friendly model makes a cold damage roll while within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, add +2 to the roll. Winter Magic lasts for one turn.

combatWarding.name: •Combat Warding
combatWarding.description: Continuous effects on friendly Faction models affected by this unit’s Protective Aura expire. While affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, a model is immune to continuous effects. Combat Warding lasts for one round.

spiritChaser.name: •Spirit Chaser
spiritChaser.description: While within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, enemy models lose Incorporeal and Stealth. Spirit Chaser lasts for one round.

stoneStrength.name: •Stone Strength
stoneStrength.description: While within the area affected by this unit’s Protective Aura, friendly Faction models gain +1 to their melee attack damage rolls. Stone Strength lasts for one turn.

whelpShedding.name: Whelp Shedding
whelpShedding.description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can place a Troll Whelp model into play B2B with this model.

alternateFoodSource.name: Alternate Food Source
alternateFoodSource.description: If this model is within 1" of a friendly Faction warbeast during the warbeast’s activation, the warbeast can remove d3 damage points. If the warbeast removes damage as a result of Alternate Food Source, remove this model from play.

comfortFood.name: Comfort Food
comfortFood.description: If this model is within 1" of a friendly Faction warbeast at the beginning of your Control Phase, before leeching you can remove this model from play to remove any number of fury points from the warbeast.

spawnWhelps.name: Spawn Whelps
spawnWhelps.description: This model does not have to be put into play at the start of the game. When a friendly Faction warbeast is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved you can put one Troll Whelp that did not begin the game in play into play. You can place this model anywhere completely within 2" of the warbeast.

bondDoomshaper.name: Bond [Doomshaper]
bondDoomshaper.description: If Mulg begins the game in Doomshaper’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Mulg is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Mulg is bonded to Doomshaper, it gains +1 FURY.

selfImmolationAction.name: Self-Immolation (★Action)
selfImmolationAction.description: This model suffers the fire continuous effect.

pyg.name: Pyg
pyg.description: This model is a Pyg model.

coldSnapAction.name: •Cold Snap (★Action)
coldSnapAction.description: This model gains Chiller for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Chiller, enemy models without Resistance: Cold suffer –2 DEF.)

freakStormAction.name: •Freak Storm (★Action)
freakStormAction.description: Center a cloud effect template on this model. Then place this model anywhere completely within 5" of its current location. The template remains in play for one round.

frostbiteAttack__cc727c54.name: •Frostbite (★Attack)
frostbiteAttack__cc727c54.description: Frostbite is a RNG SP 8 arcane attack. Models hit suffer a POW 12 cold damage roll. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

bondBorka.name: Bond [Borka]
bondBorka.description: If Rök begins the game in Borka’s battlegroup, it is bonded to him. Rök is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While bonded to Borka and in his control range, Rök gains Stumbling Drunk. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

leadershipTrollkinChampions.name: Leadership [Trollkin Champions]
leadershipTrollkinChampions.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Trollkin Champions models gain Retaliatory Strike.

partyFoul.name: Party Foul
partyFoul.description: If this model is destroyed by an enemy attack, during your next Maintenance Phase one friendly Faction model can advance 3" and make one basic melee attack.

topOffAction.name: Top Off (★Action)
topOffAction.description: RNG B2B. Target Borka Kegslayer. If Borka Kegslayer is in range, he gains 2 fury points and Stumbling Drunk. Stumbling Drunk lasts for one round. (A model with Stumbling Drunk cannot become knocked down. If it is hit by an enemy attack at any time except while it is advancing, after the attack is resolved it is pushed d3" directly away from the attacking model.)

leadershipTrollkinHighwaymen.name: Leadership [Trollkin Highwaymen]
leadershipTrollkinHighwaymen.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Trollkin Highwaymen models gain Dodge.

bringItDown.name: •Bring it Down
bringItDown.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction warrior model/unit. If the target model/unit is in range, it gains Combat Engineer this tun. (A model with Combat Engineer gains an additional die on its damage rolls against buildings and structures.)

fieldMarshalRunGun__b921d134.name: Field Marshal [Run & Gun]
fieldMarshalRunGun__b921d134.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Run & Gun. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

wildCommunion.name: Wild Communion
wildCommunion.description: When a warbeast within 3" of this model makes a Threshold check, you can have the warbeast reroll one or more dice of your choice. Dice can be rerolled only once as a result of Wild Communion.

bondGunnbjorn.name: Bond [Gunnbjorn]
bondGunnbjorn.description: If Dozer & Smigg begin the game in Gunnbjorn’s battlegroup, they are bonded to him. Dozer & Smigg are not considered to be bonded while under your opponent's control. While Dozer & Smigg are bonded to Gunnbjorn and in his control range, they gain boosted ranged attack damage rolls.

leadershipFennblade.name: Leadership [Fennblade]
leadershipFennblade.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Fennblade models gain Side Step.

veteranLeaderPyg.name: Veteran Leader [Pyg]
veteranLeaderPyg.description: While within 10" of this model, other Pyg models gain +1 to attack rolls.

desperatePaceTrollkin.name: •Desperate Pace [Trollkin]
desperatePaceTrollkin.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Trollkin trooper model. If the model is in range, models inits unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

scrollBearer.name: Scroll Bearer
scrollBearer.description: This model can use one of the following scrolls at any time during its activation while within 1" of Hoarluk. Each scroll can be used only once per game.

scrollOfTheCallOfTroqal.name: •Scroll of the Call of Troqal
scrollOfTheCallOfTroqal.description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, each warbeast in his battlegroup can gain 0 fury when forced to use its animus instead of gaining fury points equal to the COST of the animus. Scroll of the Call of Troqal lasts for one turn.

scrollOfTheHandOfYolandi.name: •Scroll of the Hand of Yolandi
scrollOfTheHandOfYolandi.description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, enemy models pay double the focus or fury point cost to cast or upkeep spells. Scroll of the Hand of Yolandi lasts for one round.

scrollOfTheStrengthOfTheMolgur.name: •Scroll of the Strength of the Molgur
scrollOfTheStrengthOfTheMolgur.description: While in Doomshaper’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain an additional die on attack rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Scroll of the Strength of the Molgur lasts for one turn.

prod.name: Prod
prod.description: When a warbeast in this model’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can force the warbeast to advance up to 2".

scrollOfTheWillOfBalasar.name: Scroll of the Will of Balasar
scrollOfTheWillOfBalasar.description: This model can use Scroll of the Will of Balasar once per game when a warbeast frenzies in its control range. This model’s controller chooses the warbeast’s frenzy target.

burntMeat.name: Burnt Meat
burntMeat.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup can charge enemy models suffering the Fire continuous effect without being forced.

fieldMarshalResistanceFire.name: Field Marshal [Resistance: Fire]
fieldMarshalResistanceFire.description: Cohort models in this model’s battlegroup gain Resistance: Fire.

leadershipLongRiders.name: Leadership [Long Riders]
leadershipLongRiders.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Long Rider models gain Relentless Charge.

leadershipRuneshapers.name: Leadership [Runeshapers]
leadershipRuneshapers.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Runeshaper models gain Battle Wizard.

highGroundAction.name: •High Ground (★Action)
highGroundAction.description: Place a 3" template anywhere completely within the spellcaster’s control range. The template remains in play for one round. While completely within the template, models gain +2 DEF against ranged and arcane attacks and their ranged weapons gain Arcing Fire. (When attacking with a weapon with Arcing Fire, a model can ignore intervening models.)

tectonicShiftAction__dcac0357.name: •Tectonic Shift (★Action)
tectonicShiftAction__dcac0357.description: Choose a table edge. Enemy models currently within 3" of this model are pushed 3" directly toward the chosen edge in the order you choose.

leadershipPygTank.name: Leadership [Pyg Tank]
leadershipPygTank.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Pyg Tank models gain Evasive.

scrollOfGrindarsPerseverance.name: Scroll of Grindar’s Perseverance
scrollOfGrindarsPerseverance.description: This model can use Scroll of Grindar’s Perseverance once per game when directly hit by an attack. This model suffers no damage roll from the attack. Declare use of the scroll after this model is hit but before the damage roll is made.

grimSalvation.name: Grim Salvation
grimSalvation.description: If this model is directly hit by a basic attack made by an enemy model, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of it to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.

fieldMarshalSteady.name: Field Marshal [Steady]
fieldMarshalSteady.description: Cohort models in this model's battlegroup cannot become knocked down.

grantedClear.name: Granted: Clear!
grantedClear.description: While this model is in play, when a model in this unit makes a ranged attack against a friendly model the attack automatically misses.

callToActionAction.name: Call to Action (★Action)
callToActionAction.description: Knocked down friendly Faction models within 10" of this model immediately stand up.

callOfDefianceAction.name: Call of Defiance (★Action)
callOfDefianceAction.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction models do not lose Tough while knocked down. Call of Defiance lasts for one round.

callOfFervorAction.name: Call of Fervor (★Action)
callOfFervorAction.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction warrior models gain +1 to their melee attack damage rolls. Call of Fervor lasts for one round.

chargeOfTheTrolls.name: •Charge of the Trolls
chargeOfTheTrolls.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 to melee attack and melee damage rolls against enemy models in the melee range of a friendly Faction warbeast. Charge of the Trolls lasts for one turn.

herosTragedy.name: •Hero’s Tragedy
herosTragedy.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction trooper model. If the model is in range, when an enemy warrior model destroys one or more models in the target's unit with a melee attack during its activation, the enemy model becomes knocked down at the end of its activation. Hero’s Tragedy lasts for one round.

taleOfMist.name: •Tale of Mist
taleOfMist.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Faction trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down and gain concealment. Tale of Mist lasts for one round.

desperatePaceWeaponCrewAction__9cefee4f.name: Desperate Pace [Weapon Crew] (★Action)
desperatePaceWeaponCrewAction__9cefee4f.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Weapon Crew trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

tremblerAction.name: •Trembler (★Action)
tremblerAction.description: Enemy models within 1" of this model become knocked down.

crashAndBurn.name: Crash and Burn
crashAndBurn.description: When this model is disabled, make a RNG 7, AOE 4, POW 15/10 ranged attack then remove this model from play. Models hit suffer the fire continuous effect.

overdriveAction.name: Overdrive (★Action)
overdriveAction.description: RNG 3: Target friendly Faction large-based or smaller warjack gains +2 SPD for one turn.

advancedSubCortex.name: Advanced Sub-Cortex
advancedSubCortex.description: The S boxes of this warjack's damage grid represents its Advanced Sub-Cortex system. While this warjack's Sub-Cortex system is not crippled, it gains Gunfighter and its ranged attack rolls are boosted.

massive.name: Massive
massive.description: This model is treated as having the massive rule as if it were a Colossal.

enhancedAlchemicalMask.name: Enhanced Alchemical Mask
enhancedAlchemicalMask.description: This model does not suffer gas effects. When determining LOS, this model ignores cloud effects. This model ignores concealment.

leadershipManOWar.name: Leadership [Man-O-War]
leadershipManOWar.description: Other friendly Faction Man-O-War models beginning their activation within 10" of this model gain +2 SPD for one turn.

killOrder.name: •Kill Order
killOrder.description: RNG 10. Target an enemy model/unit. Friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 to attack damage rolls against the chosen model/unit. Kill Order lasts for one turn.

arcaneAuthority.name: Arcane Authority
arcaneAuthority.description: This model can upkeep spells on friendly Faction warrior models without spending focus, fury, or essence points.

fabricatedDefense.name: Fabricated Defense
fabricatedDefense.description: Once per game, during its activation this model can place a Barrier, Fire Pit, Powder Keg, or Spike Trap Defense within 1" of this model. You can not place this defense within 3" of another defense, overlapping a model, obstruction or obstacle.

bondOvertake.name: Bond (Overtake)
bondOvertake.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Overtake. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

bondSprint.name: Bond (Sprint)
bondSprint.description: This model is bonded to your Leader. This model is not considered to be bonded while under your opponent’s control. While this model is bonded to your Leader and in its control range, it gains Sprint. (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

leadershipManOWar__47f8b078.name: Leadership [Man-O-War]
leadershipManOWar__47f8b078.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Man-O-War models gain Tough.

veteranLeaderManOWar.name: Veteran Leader [Man-O-War]
veteranLeaderManOWar.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Man-O-War models gain +1 to attack rolls.

supportWeaponsWinterKorpsInfantry.name: Support Weapons [Winter Korps Infantry]
supportWeaponsWinterKorpsInfantry.description: Each time you add this unit to your army, choose two Support Weapon Troopers to add to the unit. You can add two of the same Support Weapon Trooper to the unit. The options for Support Weapon Troopers to add to this unit are Auto Cannon, Grenade Porter, and Rocketeer.

humanWave.name: Human Wave
humanWave.description: During your Maintenance Phase, return all destroyed Grunts in this unit to play. Place the returned Grunts within 2" of this model. Returned Grunts must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

grantedFragmentationGrenades.name: Granted: Fragmentation Grenades
grantedFragmentationGrenades.description: While this model is in play, models in its unit gain Fragmentation Grenade weapons.

desperatePaceSmallAndMediumBasedWinterKo.name: •Desperate Pace [Small and Medium-Based Winter Korps]
desperatePaceSmallAndMediumBasedWinterKo.description: RNG 5. Target friendly small or medium-based Winter Korps trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

sniper__d600fdf3.name: Sniper
sniper__d600fdf3.description: Instead of making a damage roll to resolve a ranged attack, this model can inflict 1 damage point. A model disabled by a ranged attack made by this model cannot make a Tough roll.

ancientShroud__e1577257.name: Ancient Shroud
ancientShroud__e1577257.description: When a damage roll against this model exceeds its ARM, it suffers 1 damage point instead of the total rolled.

blindSpot.name: Blind Spot
blindSpot.description: When an enemy warbeast or horror misses this model with a melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make one basic melee attack against the warbeast or horror.

bodySnatcherBonePicker.name: Body Snatcher: Bone Picker
bodySnatcherBonePicker.description: This model can gain corpse tokens. When this model destroys a living or undead enemy model with a melee attack, this model gains the destroyed model’s corpse token. This model can spend corpse tokens for the following:

brutality.name: •Brutality
brutality.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend rage tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

desperatePaceGrymkinAction.name: •Desperate Pace [Grymkin] (★ Action)
desperatePaceGrymkinAction.description: RNG 5. Target friendly Grymkin trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedLegionnai.name: •Desperate Pace [small or medium-based Legionnaire]
desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedLegionnai.description: RNG 5. Target friendly small or medium-based Legionnaire trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2" movement during their Normal Movement this turn.

desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedDawnguard.name: •Desperate Pace [small or medium-based Dawnguard]
desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedDawnguard.description: RNG 5. Target friendly small or medium-based Dawnguard trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2 SPD during their Normal Movement this turn.

desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedExemplar.name: Desperate Pace [small- or medium-based Exemplar]
desperatePaceSmallOrMediumBasedExemplar.description: RNG 5. Target friendly small- or medium-based Exemplar trooper model. If the model is in range, models in its unit gain +2" movement during their Normal Movement this turn.

detoxAction.name: Detox (★Action)
detoxAction.description: Remove any number of juice tokens from this model.

encumbered.name: Encumbered
encumbered.description: While this unit includes one or more models with the encumbered special rule, the base SPD of all models in the unit is reduced to 5

fieldMarshalAutoRepair.name: Field Marshal [Auto-Repair]
fieldMarshalAutoRepair.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup gain Auto-Repair.

fieldMarshalBloodQuenched.name: Field Marshal [Blood-Quenched]
fieldMarshalBloodQuenched.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain Blood-Quenched.

flankNegator.name: Flank [Negator]
flankNegator.description: When this model makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of another Negator, this model gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.

followTheLeader.name: Follow the Leader
followTheLeader.description: This model can use one of the following special rules at any time during each of its unit’s activations. Each model in this unit gains the benefits listed.

healthCare.name: Health Care
healthCare.description: This model does not suffer damage from juice tokens while it has two or fewer juice tokens and is within  5" of Little Alyce.

hyperAggression.name: •Hyper-Aggression
hyperAggression.description: When this model suffers damage from an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved, it can spend a rage token to immediately make a full advance directly toward the attacking model.

juicer.name: Juicer
juicer.description: During your Maintenance Phase, you can place one juice token on di Morray. For each juice token on di Morray, he gains +1 ARC and AAT. At the end of each of his activations, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the number of juice tokens on di Morray, he suffers 1 damage point for each juice token on him. Di Morray cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.

leadershipDreadRot.name: Leadership [Dread Rot]
leadershipDreadRot.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Dread Rot models gain Take Down.

leapFrog.name: •Leap Frog
leapFrog.description: Affected models gain Annoyance for one round. (Living enemy models within 1" of a model with Annoyance suffer –1 to attack rolls.)

maleficium.name: Maleficium
maleficium.description: When this model summons a horror, do not choose a marked soul to be removed from play. Instead, this model spends the essence to summon the horror and the horror is placed B2B with this model.

phaseShift.name: Phase Shift
phaseShift.description: When this model is summoned place it completely within 3" of the marked soul instead of replacing the marked soul. Then remove the marked soul from play.

playingDead.name: •Playing Dead
playingDead.description: Grunts in this unit are immediately knocked down. Additionally, Grunts in this unit gain Feign Death for one round. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

reconstructionAction.name: •Reconstruction (★ Action)
reconstructionAction.description:
RNG 5. Target friendly Faction construct trooper model. If the model is in range, you can spend one soul token from this model to return one destroyed medium-based friendly Faction construct Grunt to play, or remove up to three soul tokens from this model to return one destroyed small-based friendly Faction construct Grunt to play for each token removed. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the returned Grunt within 2" of the target trooper
model. Returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn it is returned to play.

sabotageD33Action.name: Sabotage [d3 + 3] (★ Action)
sabotageD33Action.description: RNG B2B. Target enemy warjack or battle engine. If the enemy model is in range, is suffers d3 +3 damage points and cannot have damage removed from it for one round. When damaging a warjack, choose which column suffers the damage.

soulTakerCrusadersRequiemLivingExemplar.name: Soul Taker: Crusader’s Requiem [Living Exemplar]
soulTakerCrusadersRequiemLivingExemplar.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living Exemplar model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

soulTakerRequiemFaction.name: Soul Taker: Requiem [Faction]
soulTakerRequiemFaction.description: This model can gain soul tokens. When a friendly living Faction model is destroyed while within 10" of this model, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token. This model can have up to three soul tokens at any time. This model can spend soul tokens for the following:

soulPowered__6d0d0c8a.name: •Soul-Powered
soulPowered__6d0d0c8a.description: During its Combat Action, this model can spend soul tokens to make additional melee attacks. It can make one additional attack for each token spent.

spellBarrier.name: Spell Barrier
spellBarrier.description: While this model is B2B with its battlegroup controller, its battlegroup controller cannot be targeted by enemy spells.

spellSlaveActionOrAttack__aa25e2a3.name: Spell Slave (★Action or ★Attack)
spellSlaveActionOrAttack__aa25e2a3.description: This model must be in its Leader’s control range to make the Spell Slave special action. When it does, it casts one of the spells on its Leader’s card with a COST of 3 or less. This model cannot cast upkeep spells or spells with a RNG of SELF or CTRL. When casting an offensive spell, Spell Slave is a arcane attack.

spiritMagic.name: •Spirit Magic
spiritMagic.description: Once per turn during its Combat Action, this model can spend one soul token to cast a Magic Ability spell without making a Special Action or a Special Attack.

suppressionInitiative.name: •Suppression Initiative
suppressionInitiative.description: This model gains Unstoppable. Additionally, while within 8" of this model, friendly models with Flight also gain Unstoppable. Suppression Initiative lasts for one turn.

tag.name: •Tag!
tag.description: The weapons of affected models gain Grievous Wounds this activation. (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

uncontrollableRage.name: Uncontrollable Rage
uncontrollableRage.description: This model can run and charge without spending focus points. This model must run or charge during its activation if it can, unless it is engaging an enemy model. If this model cannot run or charge, it activates normally.

valleyOfWoe.name: •Valley of Woe
valleyOfWoe.description: RNG 10. Target enemy model/unit. If the target enemy model/unit is in range, it loses Pathfinder and cannot gain it for one round.

variableMelee.name: Variable [melee]
variableMelee.description: At the start of this unit’s activation, choose one of the following special rules. The unit’s melee weapons gain the special rule chosen for one round.

variableRanged.name: Variable [ranged]
variableRanged.description: At the start of this unit’s activation, choose one of the following special rules. The unit’s ranged weapons gain the special rule chosen for one round.

veteranLeaderBlightedOgrun.name: Veteran Leader [Blighted Ogrun]
veteranLeaderBlightedOgrun.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Blighted Ogrun models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderBogTrog.name: Veteran Leader [Bog Trog]
veteranLeaderBogTrog.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Bog Trog models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderDawnguard.name: Veteran Leader [Dawnguard]
veteranLeaderDawnguard.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Dawnguard models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderFactionWarjack.name: Veteran Leader [Faction Warjack]
veteranLeaderFactionWarjack.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly Faction warjacks gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderFactionWarrior.name: Veteran Leader [Faction warrior]
veteranLeaderFactionWarrior.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Faction warrior models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderTharn.name: Veteran Leader [Tharn]
veteranLeaderTharn.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Tharn models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderTrencher.name: Veteran Leader [Trencher]
veteranLeaderTrencher.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Trencher models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderVenator.name: Veteran Leader [Venator]
veteranLeaderVenator.description: While within 10" of this model, other friendly Venator models gain +1 to attack rolls.

veteranLeaderWeaponCrew.name: Veteran Leader [Weapon Crew]
veteranLeaderWeaponCrew.description: While within 10" of this model, friendly weapon crew models gain +1 to attack rolls.

victoryHowl.name: Victory Howl
victoryHowl.description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving a melee attack in which it destroyed or removed from play an enemy model, this model can cast its animus without being forced.

voidGenerator.name: Void Generator
voidGenerator.description: At any time during its activation, this model can spend a power token to give a friendly Faction model/unit within 5" of it Mage Static for one round. (Spells cast by enemy models within 10" of a model with Mage Static suffer +1 COST and –3 RNG.)

cumbersome.name: Cumbersome
cumbersome.description: This model cannot attack with this weapon and with another weapon during the same activation.

powerfulAttack.name: Powerful Attack
powerfulAttack.description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can spend 1 focus point or be forced to boost all attack and damage rolls for the attack.

armorPiercingAttack.name: Armor-Piercing (★Attack)
armorPiercingAttack.description: When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.

beatBack.name: Beat Back
beatBack.description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

arcingFire.name: Arcing Fire
arcingFire.description: When attacking with this weapon, this model can ignore intervening models.

criticalKnockdown__870725a5.name: Critical Knockdown
criticalKnockdown__870725a5.description: On a critical hit, models hit become knocked down.

criticalShred__8545b96b.name: Critical Shred

witchMark.description: If this attack directly hits an enemy model during this model’s activation, until the end of that activation this model can target and automatically hit that enemy model with spells, ignoring RNG and LOS.

beatBack__d6842a11.name: •Beat Back
beatBack__d6842a11.description: Immediately after a basic attack with this weapon is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.

criticalRicochet.name: Critical Ricochet
criticalRicochet.description: When this model critically hits an enemy model with an attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved this model can make another ranged attack with this weapon targeting another model within 4" of the model originally hit, ignoring LOS and this weapon’s RNG. Attacks gained from Ricochet cannot generate additional attacks from Ricochet.

afflicter__572f3fcc.name: Afflicter
afflicter__572f3fcc.description: The model hit suffers the Torment continuous effect.

afflicter.name: •Afflicter
afflicter.description: The model hit suffers the Torment continuous effect.

huntsmansLure.name: •Huntsman’s Lure
huntsmansLure.description: Friendly Faction warbeasts gain +2 SPD when charging a model hit by this attack. Huntsman’s Lure lasts for one turn.

criticalSlow.name: Critical Slow
criticalSlow.description: A living model critically hit by this weapon has its base DEF reduced to 5. Slow lasts for one round.

blade.name: •Blade
blade.description: This weapon becomes RNG 2, POW 12 for this attack. If this attack destroys an enemy model, a friendly Eldritch Leader model gains one hunger point.

chain.name: •Chain
chain.description: This attack gains Decapitation. (Damage from an attack with Decapitation that exceeds the ARM of the model hit is doubled. A model disabled by the attack cannot make a tough roll.)

lure.name: Lure
lure.description: An enemy non-Leader model hit by this attack can be placed completely within 1" of its current location.

criticalAfflicter.name: Critical Afflicter
criticalAfflicter.description: On a critical hit, the model hit suffers the Torment continuous effect.

repel.name: Repel
repel.description: When this model hits an enemy model with this weapon, the model hit is pushed 1" directly away from this model. When this model is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from this model. This model loses Repel while this weapon system is crippled.

jawsOfUrcaen.name: Jaws of Urcaen
jawsOfUrcaen.description: If this attack’s original target is an enemy model and that model is boxed by this attack, you can make a SP 6 attack using the boxed model as the attack’s point of origin. Models hit suffer a POW 14 magical damage roll. Models boxed by an attack made with this weapon are removed from play.

soulFired1.name: Soul Fired [1]
soulFired1.description: This model can spend 1 soul token to make one additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

deathTollSmallOrMediumBased.name: Death Toll [small or medium-based]
deathTollSmallOrMediumBased.description: When this weapon boxes a living enemy warrior model, remove that model from play and return one Grunt to a friendly small or medium-based unit within 8" of this model. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

devourEssence.name: Devour Essence
devourEssence.description: A model hit by this weapon loses all essence points and soul tokens.

depressionFired.name: Depression Fired
depressionFired.description: After resolving a melee damage roll with this weapon, the target model immediately suffers a POW 14 ranged damage roll.

flakMunitions.name: Flak Munitions
flakMunitions.description: Attacks made with this weapon ignore Flying High and Warping Winds special rules.

capacitorDischarge.name: Capacitor Discharge
capacitorDischarge.description: If this model hits with an initial attack with this weapon, the target suffers d3 POW 14 unboostable electrical damage rolls after the attack is resolved. These damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack.

banish.name: •Banish
banish.description: When this weapon damages an enemy non-Leader model, immediately after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 1" of its current location.

shellShocked.name: Shell-Shocked
shellShocked.description: On a direct hit, models hit suffer –2 SPD and RAT for one round.

tracerRounds.name: Tracer Rounds
tracerRounds.description: The first attack made with this weapon each activation ignores Stealth when resolving the attack. A model hit by the first attack made with this weapon each activation suffers Flare. (A model suffering Flare loses Stealth and suffers –2 DEF for one turn.)

reloadInfinity.name: Reload [Infinity]
reloadInfinity.description: This model can spend focus points to make additional ranged attacks with this weapon during its Combat Action. It can make one additional attack for each focus point spent.

pinningFire.name: Pinning Fire
pinningFire.description: When an enemy warrior model is hit by this weapon, after the attack is resolved the enemy model becomes knocked down and can be pushed 2" directly away from the attacking model.

electrocutioner.name: Electrocutioner
electrocutioner.description: A model directly hit by this attack suffers a cumulative –1 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Electricity. When a model without Resistance: Electricity is directly hit with three or more Electrocutioner attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.

powerMultiplier.name: Power Multiplier
powerMultiplier.description: Models in this unit gain a +1 cumulative bonus to ranged attack and ranged attack damage rolls for each other model in this unit that has directly hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this activation.

chainAttackMageStorm.name: Chain Attack: Mage Storm
chainAttackMageStorm.description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, you can choose to center a cloud effect template on the model hit. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers a POW 12 fire damage roll.

electroBlast.name: •Electro Blast
electroBlast.description: This attack causes electrical damage. A warjack directly hit by this attack suffers Disruption.

electrocutioner__a3867171.name: •Electrocutioner
electrocutioner__a3867171.description: A model directly hit by this attack suffers a cumulative –1 DEF for one turn unless it has Resistance: Electricity. When a model without Resistance: Electricity is directly hit with three or more Electrocutioner attacks in the same turn, it becomes stationary for one round.

skyRumbler.name: •Sky Rumbler
skyRumbler.description: On a direct hit, the model hit and models within 5" of it lose Flight for one round.

slow.name: Slow
slow.description: A living model hit by this weapon has its base DEF reduced to 5. Slow lasts for one round.

eyeThief.name: Eye Thief
eyeThief.description: When a living or undead model is damaged by an attack with this weapon, it suffers Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

scoop.name: Scoop
scoop.description: Instead of suffering a damage roll, a living or undead model hit by this weapon automatically suffers 1 damage point. This weapon cannot damage construct models.

deathTollDreadRot.name: Death Toll [Dread Rot]
deathTollDreadRot.description: When this weapon boxes a living enemy warrior model, remove that model from play and return one Grunt to a friendly Dread Rot unit within 8" of this model. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

intoTheLight.name: Into the Light
intoTheLight.description: If this attack hits an enemy model with an equal or smaller base, immediately after the attack is resolved the enemy model can be pushed directly towards this model until it contacts this model. During this push, the enemy model can move through obstacles or obstructions if the push is enough to move completely past.

petrified.name: Petrified
petrified.description: A living warrior model hit by this attack becomes stationary for one round.

greedBound.name: Greed Bound
greedBound.description: When this model destroys a living enemy warrior model with this weapon, after the attack is resolved you can return one destroyed model in this unit to play. Place the returned model completely within 3" of this model. The returned model cannot activate the turn it returns to play. The destroyed model is removed from play.

guided.name: Guided
guided.description: Attacks made with this weapon automatically hit.

blackWings.name: Black Wings
blackWings.description: If this attack misses, nothing happens. On a direct hit against an enemy model, center a cloud effect template on the model hit. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Enemy living and undead models in the template when it is placed suffer Blind for one round. Enemy living or undead models entering or ending their activations in the template suffer 1 point of magical damage. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

spiritDrain.name: •Spirit Drain
spiritDrain.description: An enemy warbeast directly hit by this attack suffers –1 FURY for one round. The maximum number of focus points an enemy warjack or monstrosity directly hit by this attack can have is reduced by 1 for one round.

vortexBlast.name: Vortex Blast
vortexBlast.description: On a direct hit, before making the damage rolls, push models within 2" of the model hit 2" directly toward it in the order you choose. Models boxed by this weapon are removed from play.

dispel__796e9342.name: •Dispel
dispel__796e9342.description: When this weapon hits a model/unit, upkeep spells and animi on that model/unit immediately expire.

phoenixProjection.name: Phoenix Projection
phoenixProjection.description: This weapon has a different effect, depending on which Phoenix Protocol this model is in:

wildfire.name: •Wildfire
wildfire.description: Enemy models within 2" of the model hit can be pushed 2" directly away from it in the order you choose. The model hit suffers the Fire continuous effect.

retribution.name: •Retribution
retribution.description: This model can advance 2" towards the model hit.

voidwalker.name: •Voidwalker
voidwalker.description: Place non-Leader model hit completely within 1" of its current location.

radiantBlast.name: •Radiant Blast
radiantBlast.description: This weapon becomes AOE 3, POW 12/7 for this attack. On a direct hit, models hit by this attack lose Stealth and suffer –2 DEF for one turn.

criticalBanish.name: Critical Banish
criticalBanish.description: On a critical hit, when this weapon damages an enemy non-Leader model, immediately after the attack is resolved you can place the enemy model anywhere completely within 1" of its current location.

criticalBrainDamage.name: Critical Brain Damage
criticalBrainDamage.description: On a critical hit, a model damaged by an attack with this weapon cannot cast spells for one round.

deathBoon.name: Death Boon
deathBoon.description: When this model destroys an enemy warrior model with an attack with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in this model’s battlegroup currently in its control range can gain 1 focus or fury point.

sacralBlade.name: Sacral Blade
sacralBlade.description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which it destroyed an enemy model with this weapon, this model can cast a spell without spending essence points.

blackMark.name: Black Mark
blackMark.description: When this model destroys a living non-soulless enemy model with an attack with this weapon, this model gains the destroyed model’s soul token.

reelIn.name: •Reel In
reelIn.description: When this attack hits an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved place this model B2B with the enemy model.

skewer__a5b8cb15.name: •Skewer
skewer__a5b8cb15.description: When this weapon damages an enemy model with an equal or smaller base, immediately after the attack is resolved the damaged model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.

suppressingFire.name: Suppressing Fire
suppressingFire.description: A warrior model/unit hit by an attack made by this model this activation suffer –2 RAT for one round.

coveringFireAction.name: Covering Fire (★Action)
coveringFireAction.description: Place a wall template anywhere completely within this weapon’s RNG and this model’s LOS, ignoring intervening models. A model entering or ending its activation in the template suffers a damage roll with POW equal to the POW of this weapon. The template remains in play for one round. If this model is destroyed or removed from play, immediately remove the template from play.

fireInTheHoleAction.name: Fire in the Hole! (★ Action)
fireInTheHoleAction.description: Place a 3" diameter template anywhere in contact with an obstruction terrain feature, and completely within this weapon’s RNG. The template is rubble terrain and remains in play for one round.

fireBombAction.name: Fire Bomb (★Action)
fireBombAction.description: Choose a forest terrain feature within this weapon’s RNG. It becomes a burning earth hazard instead of a forest for the remainder of the game.

volumeFire__f87497c6.name: •Volume Fire
volumeFire__f87497c6.description: Gain +1 to attack and damage rolls with this weapon against medium-based models and +2 to attack and damage rolls against larger-based models.

clippedWings.name: Clipped Wings
clippedWings.description: A model with Flight hit by this weapon suffers -2 SPD for one round.

infection.name: Infection
infection.description: Once per activation, when this model boxes a living enemy warrior model with an attack with this weapon, you can remove the boxed model from play and replace it with an Incubus model.

witheringDeath.name: Withering Death
witheringDeath.description: A model hit by this weapon suffers –2 ARM for one turn unless it has Resistance: Corrosion.

blightSpasm.name: •Blight Spasm
blightSpasm.description: When this attack boxes a living or undead model, the closest enemy model within 1" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion blast damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After this damage is resolved, remove the boxed model from play.

poison__ac60a960.name: •Poison
poison__ac60a960.description: Gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against living models.

pitch.name: •Pitch
pitch.description: On a hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit is thrown d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

bloodLure__ddb809ce.name: •Blood Lure
bloodLure__ddb809ce.description: Warbeasts models in this model’s battlegroup can charge enemy models hit by this weapon this turn without being forced.

assimilation.name: Assimilation
assimilation.description: When this model destroys an enemy construct model with this weapon, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from this model.

spiritEater.name: Spirit Eater
spiritEater.description: This model can reave fury points from enemy warbeasts destroyed by this weapon. Other models cannot reave fury points from enemy warbeasts destroyed by this weapon.

spellbound.name: Spellbound
spellbound.description: This model can channel spells through a model hit by an attack made with this weapon this turn.

closeVolley.name: Close Volley
closeVolley.description: When this model directly hits a model with this weapon, this model’s ranged attacks against that model automatically hit for one turn.

kineticGrip.name: Kinetic Grip
kineticGrip.description: When a model is hit by this attack, it suffers –2 SPD for one round.

forceGrip.name: Force Grip
forceGrip.description: Instead of causing damage, an enemy model hit by this attack can be pushed up to 3" in any direction.

focusPowered.name: Focus-Powered
focusPowered.description: For each focus point on this model when this attack is declared, this weapon gains +1 RNG and POW until this attack is resolved.

temporalDisruption.name: Temporal Disruption
temporalDisruption.description: A model directly hit by this weapon suffers –2 SPD and DEF for one round.

fromBeneath__ca120d57.name: •From Beneath
fromBeneath__ca120d57.description: Attacks with this weapon ignore cover and concealment.

canisterShot.name: •Canister Shot
canisterShot.description: This weapon’s base stats become RNG SP 10, AOE –

cannonball.name: •Cannonball
cannonball.description: This weapon’s base stats become RNG 20. A model hit is slammed d6" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this attack.

incendiaryShot.name: •Incendiary Shot
incendiaryShot.description: This weapon’s base stats become RNG 16, AOE 4, and POW 14/7 for this attack. This attack causes fire damage and models hit suffer the Fire continuous effect.

ebbAndFlow.name: Ebb and Flow
ebbAndFlow.description: On a direct hit, models hit that have been pushed by Tunneler this turn become knocked down.

gatesOfHell.name: Gates of Hell
gatesOfHell.description: Once per activation, immediately after resolving an attack in which this model destroyed a living or undead enemy model with this weapon, this model can spend one soul token to be placed anywhere completely within 4" of its current location, then its activation ends.

deathTollMechanithrall.name: Death Toll [Mechanithrall]
deathTollMechanithrall.description: When this weapon boxes a living enemy warrior model, remove that model from play and return one Grunt to a friendly small-based Mechanithrall unit within 8" of this model. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

starve.name: Starve
starve.description: A model damaged by this weapon must forfeit either its Normal Movement or its Combat Action during its next activation.

stingingSwarm.name: Stinging Swarm
stingingSwarm.description: On a direct hit, center a 3" cloud effect template on the model directly hit. This template remains in play for one round. Models that enter or end their activation in the template suffer a POW 10 damage roll.

baitTheLine.name: Bait the Line
baitTheLine.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup gain +2 SPD when charging a model damaged by this weapon this turn.

comboPitchAttack.name: Combo Pitch (★Attack)
comboPitchAttack.description: On a hit against a model with an equal or smaller base, the model hit is thrown d6" directly away from this model. When resolving damage for this attack, the model hit suffers a damage roll with POW equal to the POW of this weapon. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.

chainAttackShifter.name: Chain Attack: Shifter
chainAttackShifter.description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks it can immediately use Shifter. (Place this model B2B with the enemy hit.)

deathTollHolyZealot.name: Death Toll [Holy Zealot]
deathTollHolyZealot.description: When this weapon boxes a living enemy warrior model, remove that model from play and return one Grunt to a friendly Holy Zealot unit within 8" of this model. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

destructor.name: •Destructor
destructor.description: Damage rolls resulting from this attack are automatically boosted.

extraction.name: Extraction
extraction.description: When an enemy model is destroyed by this attack, one warjack in this model's battlegroup that is in its control range gains 1 focus point.

armorPiercing__6f7ba3d5.name: •Armor-Piercing
armorPiercing__6f7ba3d5.description: When calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of models hit.

deadReckoning.name: •Dead Reckoning
deadReckoning.description: This model gains Eyeless Sight when resolving this attack.

mechanikalSeizure__fd222661.name: •Mechanikal Seizure
mechanikalSeizure__fd222661.description: A warjack hit by this weapon becomes stationary for one round.

skewer__bc0563e5.name: Skewer
skewer__bc0563e5.description: When this weapon damages an enemy model with an equal or smaller base, immediately after the attack is resolved the damaged model can be pushed directly toward this model until it contacts a model, an obstacle, or an obstruction.

thresherAttack__b1e9e740.name: Thresher (★Attack)
thresherAttack__b1e9e740.description: This model makes one melee attack with this weapon against each model in its LOS that is in this weapon’s melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model. Thresher attacks are simultaneous.

criticalBurster.name: Critical Burster
criticalBurster.description: On a critical hit, that boxes a living or undead model, the closest three enemy models within 3" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable POW 10 corrosion damage roll. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. After this damage is resolved, remove the boxed model from play.

criticalHeartSeeker.name: Critical Heart Seeker
criticalHeartSeeker.description: On a critical hit, gain an additional die on this weapon’s damage rolls against the target directly hit. Discard the lowest die in each roll.

shadowLeap.name: Shadow Leap
shadowLeap.description: The model hit suffers Shadow Bind. If it is already suffering Shadow Bind, the closest other enemy model within 5" of it, that is not already suffering Shadow Bind, suffers Shadow Bind instead. (A model suffering Shadow Bind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

lifeStealer__d011c15a.name: Life Stealer
lifeStealer__d011c15a.description: When an attack with this weapon destroys an enemy model, immediately after the attack is resolved a friendly living Faction model currently within 10" of this model can remove d3 damage points.

transfiguration.name: Transfiguration
transfiguration.description: Models destroyed by this weapon are removed from play. When an attack from this weapon destroys one or more enemy models, return one destroyed Grunt to a friendly Faction unit within 8" of this model. The Grunt returns with one unmarked damage box. Place the Grunt within 2" of another model in that unit. The returned Grunt must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action the turn it is put into play.

telekineticSlam.name: Telekinetic Slam
telekineticSlam.description: On a direct hit, target model is slammed d6" in a direction of your choice. Collateral damage is resolved at POW of this weapon.

stormChiller.name: Storm Chiller
stormChiller.description: Enemy models hit can be pushed d3" directly away from this model. On a critical hit, the model hit becomes stationary for one round unless it has Resistance: Cold.

criticalArmorPiercing__d8090de4.name: Critical Armor-Piercing
criticalArmorPiercing__d8090de4.description: On a critical hit, when calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of the model hit.

chainAttackThunderBlast.name: Chain Attack: Thunder Blast
chainAttackThunderBlast.description: If this model hits the same large or smaller-based model without Resistance: Electricity with both its initial attacks with this weapon, you can choose to slam the model hit d3" directly away from this model. The POW of collateral damage is equal to the POW of this weapon.

criticalThunderclap__a17aa0c9.name: Critical Thunderclap
criticalThunderclap__a17aa0c9.description: On a critical hit, models hit without Resistance: Electricity become knocked down.

crescendo.name: •Crescendo
crescendo.description: Place a 3" template centered on the model targeted. A model entering or ending its activation in one or more Crescendo templates suffers a POW 7 blast damage roll. The template remains in play for one round.

sonicEruption.name: •Sonic Eruption
sonicEruption.description: This weapon gains Pistol and its base stats become RNG Sp 10, AOE –, and POW 12 for this attack.

accurse.name: Accurse
accurse.description: Remove all focus and fury points from enemy models hit by this weapon.

chainAttackIgnition.name: Chain Attack: Ignition
chainAttackIgnition.description: If this model hits the same model with both its initial attacks with this weapon, after resolving the attacks the model hit and other enemy models within 2" of it suffer a POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect. These damage rolls are not considered to have been caused by an attack.

bloodLure.name: Blood Lure
bloodLure.description: Warbeasts in this model’s battlegroup can charge enemy models hit by this weapon this turn without being forced.

rathroksAwakening.name: Rathrok’s Awakening
rathroksAwakening.description: This model gains 1 fury point each time it destroys a living enemy model with this weapon.

criticalArmorPiercing.name: •Critical Armor-Piercing
criticalArmorPiercing.description: On a critical hit, when calculating damage from this weapon, halve the base ARM stats of the model hit.

destructiveReload.name: Destructive Reload
destructiveReload.description: this model can suffer d3 damage to make an additional ranged attack with this weapon during its Combat Action.

repulsor.name: Repulsor
repulsor.description: When this model hits an enemy model with this weapon, the model hit is pushed 1" directly away from this model. When this model is hit with a melee attack, after the attack is resolved, the attacking model is pushed 1" directly away from this model.

divineIntervention.name: Divine Intervention
divineIntervention.description: While in Blaize’s control range, friendly living warrior models gain +1 ARM for each soul token on Blaize. Additionally, while in Blaize’s control range, Morrowan models gain Divine Inspiration. Divine Intervention lasts for one round. (A model with Divine Inspiration gains an additional die on melee attack and melee damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll.)

hogHeaven.name: Hog Heaven
hogHeaven.description: While in Carver’s control range, friendly Farrow models gain Overtake and an additional die on melee damage rolls. Hog Heaven lasts for one turn. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

wintersChill.name: Winter’s Chill
wintersChill.description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold suffers a damage roll while in Sorscha’s control range, double the damage that exceeds the model’s ARM. Winter’s Chill lasts for one turn.

deadOfWinter.name: Dead of Winter
deadOfWinter.description: Place d3+3 cloud effect templates anywhere completely in Sorscha’s control range. These templates are hazards that remains in play for one round. A model without Resistance: Cold suffers 1 point of cold damage for each Dead of Winter template it enters or ends its activation within.

poisonPill.name: Poison Pill
poisonPill.description: While in Malakov's control range, friendly Faction models gain Shield Guard. Additionally, once per turn when a friendly Faction model is directly hit by an enemy attack while in Malakov's control range, immediately after the attack has been resolved the model can make a full advance followed by a basic melee or ranged attack. Posion Pill lasts for one round. (When a friendly model is directly hit by a non-spray ranged attack while within 3" of a model with Shield Guard, you can choose to have the model with Shield Guard be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects. A model can use Shield Guard only once per round and cannot use Shield Guard if it is incorporeal, knocked down, or stationary. Shield Guard can only be used once per attack.)

deadOfNight.name: Dead of Night
deadOfNight.description: While in Strakhov's control range, friendly models gain Stealth, Reposition [3"], and Take Down. While in his control range, enemy models' ranged weapons suffer –4 RNG. Dead of Night lasts for one round.

hitRun.name: Hit & Run
hitRun.description: Models in Magnus’ battlegroup currently in his control range can make a full advance or run after all friendly models have completed their activations this turn. Warjacks do not have to spend focus to run during this movement. Hit & Run lasts for one turn.

killBox.name: Kill Box
killBox.description: Choose two table edges. Enemy models beginning an advance in Magnus’ control range cannot advance toward those table edges for one round.

bloodFrenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
bloodFrenzy.description: While in the Butcher’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack damage rolls this turn.

unearthlyRage.name: Unearthly Rage
unearthlyRage.description: While in Karchev’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain boosted melee damage rolls and their melee weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Unearthly Rage lasts for one turn.

undyingLoyalty.name: Undying Loyalty
undyingLoyalty.description: While in Irusk’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain +2 to attack rolls and Tough and cannot become knocked down. When a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while in Irusk’s control range, remove 1 damage point from that model. Undying Loyalty lasts for one round.

hourOfTheWolf.name: Hour of the Wolf
hourOfTheWolf.description: While in Harkevich’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain +3 ARM. Models in his battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range can charge or make slam power attacks without spending focus. A model in Harkevich’s battlegroup that declares a charge or slam against an enemy model while in his control range can make a basic ranged attack before advancing. Hour of the Wolf lasts for one round.

scorpionsSting.name: Scorpion’s Sting
scorpionsSting.description: While in Zaadesh’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 MAT and +2 to their melee attack damage rolls and Defensive Strike. Scorpion’s Sting lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement, or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.)

hideInSight.name: Hide in Sight
hideInSight.description: When an enemy model makes an attack roll against a friendly Faction model in Jalaam’s control range, the enemy model rolls one less die. Hide in Sight lasts for one round.

instrumentsOfWar.name: Instruments of War
instrumentsOfWar.description: While in Makeda’s control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted melee attack rolls and cannot become knocked down. Instruments of War lasts for one round.

handOfTheAncients.name: Hand of the Ancients
handOfTheAncients.description: All models are considered to be in Xerxis’ control range. Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. For each of those rolls, discard one die of your choice. Hand of the Ancients lasts for one turn.

risingTide.name: Rising Tide
risingTide.description: Aiakos immediately casts Manifest Destiny without spending focus. Additionally, models in Aiakos’ battlegroup that are currently in his control range gain +3 SPD for one turn.

bloodletting.name: Bloodletting
bloodletting.description: Model in Rahera’s battlegroup currently in her control range and friendly living warrior models currently in her control range can immediately make one basic melee or ranged attack. These attacks must target enemy models currently in Rahera’s control range.

bloodMagic.name: Blood Magic
bloodMagic.description: Skarre immediately suffers any number of damage points. For each damage point suffered as a result of Blood Magic, one friendly Faction model currently in her control range gains +5 ARM and +5 to its melee attack damage rolls for one round. This model cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage.

bloodRites.name: Blood Rites
bloodRites.description: Skarre can suffer 1 damage point to cast a spell instead of spending focus this activation. She can cast each of her spells once as a result of Blood Rites.

deathRitual.name: Death Ritual
deathRitual.description: Immediately remove from play one or more friendly living or undead models currently in Barnabas’ control range. For each model removed, Barnabas can gain one corpse token or one fury point or can remove d3 damage points from a model in his battlegroup. Barnabas cannot exceed his ARC in fury points as a result of Death Ritual.

deathHarvest.name: Death Harvest
deathHarvest.description: Each time a friendly Faction model destroys an enemy model while in Calaban’s control range, Calaban gains 1 fury point. Immediately after resolving an attack in which a friendly Faction model in Calaban’s control range destroyed one or more enemy models, Calaban can cast one spell. Calaban can spend fury points to boost attack and damage rolls on spells cast as a result of Death Harvest. Death Harvest lasts for one turn.

vengefulSpirits__885c4819.name: Vengeful Spirits
vengefulSpirits__885c4819.description: Choose up to d3 + 5 enemy models currently in Jaga-Jaga’s control range. Remove from play one friendly Faction warrior model within 5" of each chosen enemy model. Each chosen enemy model suffers a magical damage roll with POW equal to the base ARM of the corresponding removed model. Models destroyed by Vengeful Spirits are removed from play.

spiritWorld.name: Spirit World
spiritWorld.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Maelok’s control range gain Incorporeal this turn. While within Maelok’s control range, friendly Faction undead models gain +2 ARM. Spirit World lasts for one round.

roughHouse.name: Rough House
roughHouse.description: While in Boomhowler’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and Rapid Healing. Rough House lasts for one round. (When a model with Rapid Healing is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.)

jumpTheShark.name: Jump the Shark
jumpTheShark.description: Place Ragemonger anywhere completely within 5" of his current location. Additionally, when a friendly Faction model rolls a 1 on a die when resolving a melee attack or melee attack damage roll while in Ragemonger’s control range, count the die face as a 6. Jump the Shark lasts for one turn.

heavyRain.name: Heavy Rain
heavyRain.description: While in Captain Firequill’s control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted ranged attack damage rolls and models in Firequill’s battlegroup gain True Sight. Heavy Rain lasts for one turn. (A model with True Sight ignores cloud effects when determining LOS and also ignores Stealth.)

nightsDominion.name: Night’s Dominion
nightsDominion.description: When a friendly model in Shadowtongue’s control range casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1 to a minimum of 1. While in his control range, warbeasts in Shadowtongue’s battlegroup can use their animi without being forced. Night’s Dominion lasts for one turn.

rumGrapeshot.name: Rum & Grapeshot
rumGrapeshot.description: Friendly warrior models in Foulbloods’s control range with Stumbling Drunk gain +3 ARM and Tough. When a model is pushed as a result of Stumbling Drunk you can choose the direction it is pushed. Rum and Grapeshot lasts for one round.

spiritRealm.name: Spirit Realm
spiritRealm.description: Friendly Faction models in Bagadibawm’s control area gain +2 SPD and Ghostly for one round. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

brokenEarth.name: Broken Earth
brokenEarth.description: While in Baldur’s control range, friendly Faction models gain cover. While in Baldur’s control range, enemy models never have Pathfinder and treat open terrain as rough terrain. Broken Earth lasts for one round.

hallowedGround.name: Hallowed Ground
hallowedGround.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Baldur’s control range are affected by Roots of the Earth for one round.

blackTide.name: Black Tide
blackTide.description: Enemy models without Amphibious currently in Barnabas’ control range become knocked down.

tideOfEarth.name: Tide of Earth
tideOfEarth.description: Choose a table edge and a distance up to 5". Models in Thorle’s battlegroup that are in his control range are pushed the chosen distance directly toward the chosen table edge in the order you choose. At the end of your turn, choose a distance up to 5". Models in Thorle’s battlegroup that are in his control range are pushed the chosen distance directly away from the chosen table edge in the order you choose.

monsterMayhem.name: Monster Mayhem
monsterMayhem.description: Warbeasts in Arkadius’ battlegroup currently in his control range can immediately  each advance up to 3" and make one basic melee or ranged attack. Attack and damage rolls resulting from these attacks are boosted.

psychicApocalypse.name: Psychic Apocalypse
psychicApocalypse.description: While in Strum & Drang’s control range enemy Cohort models cannot gain, be allocated, or spend focus or essence points, or be forced. While in Sturm & Drang’s control range, enemy models cannot be used to channel spells. Psychic Apocalypse lasts for one round.

darkestNight.name: Darkest Night
darkestNight.description: Grayle immediately casts Fog of War without spending fury. Additionally, when a friendly Faction model in Grayle’s control range destroys an enemy model with a melee attack during its activation, another friendly Faction model in Grayle’s control range can advance up to 3". A model can advance only once as a result of Darkest Night. Darkest Night lasts for one turn.

highwayToHell.name: Highway to Hell
highwayToHell.description: Helga immediately casts Engine of Destruction without spending fury. Additionally, when a friendly Farrow model hits one or more enemy models with an attack during its activation while in Helga’s control range, at the end of its activation the attacking model can make a full advance. Highway to Hell lasts for one turn.

grandFinale.name: Grand Finale
grandFinale.description: When a friendly Faction model in Helga’s control range hits an enemy model with a basic melee attack, instead of making a normal damage roll, the enemy model can be slammed d6" directly away from the attacking model. The POW of the slam and resulting collateral damage rolls are equal to the POW of the attack. Grand Finale lasts for one turn.

timeOfTheBeast.name: Time of the Beast
timeOfTheBeast.description: While in Iona’s control range, friendly Tharn models gain +2 ARM and +2 to their attack damage rolls. Additionally, while in Iona’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Time of the Beast. Time of the Beast lasts for one round.

callOfTheHunt.name: Call of the Hunt
callOfTheHunt.description: Kaya can force warbeasts in her battlegroup even if they are outside her control range. At the end of the activation of each warbeast in her battlegroup, you can place that warbeast anywhere completely within 3" of Kaya. Call of the Hunt lasts for one turn.

wildMastery.name: Wild Mastery
wildMastery.description: Place any number of fury points on each friendly Faction warbeast in Kaya’s battlegroup currently in her control range. She can immediately leech fury points from warbeasts in her battlegroup that are in her control range.

moonShadow.name: Moon Shadow
moonShadow.description: While in Kaya’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and gain Unstoppable. Additionally, friendly Faction models can advance through enemy models in Kaya’s control range if they have enough movement to move completely past their bases. Moon Shadow lasts for one round.

bloodRage__2089863b.name: Blood Rage
bloodRage__2089863b.description: Kromac suffers up to 7 damage points. For each damage point he suffers, Kromac gains 1 fury point. Kromac’s fury point total cannot exceed his current ARC as a result of Blood Rage. If Kromac is in Tharn form when this feat is used, he can immediately take beast form; replace his Tharn form model with his beast form model. Effects on the replaced model are applied to the beast model.

bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
bloodlust.description: While in Kromac’s control range warbeast in his battlegroup can charge and make slam power attacks without being forced. Additionally, when a model in Kromac’s battlegroup declares a charge or slam power attack while in his control range, that model gains +3 SPD that activation. Bloodlust lasts for one turn.

hurricane.name: Hurricane
hurricane.description: Enemy models currently in Krueger’s control range are pushed 3" directly away from Krueger in the order you choose. Affected models suffer –2 SPD for one round

stormRavager.name: Storm Ravager
stormRavager.description: Place three 3" templates anywhere completely within Krueger’s control range. These templates are hazards. Enemy models in one or more of the templates when they are placed suffer a boostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. An enemy model entering or ending its activation in one or more of the templates suffers an unboostable POW 10 electrical damage roll. During each of your Maintenance Phases, remove one AOE.

standDeliver.name: Stand & Deliver
standDeliver.description: While in Azazello’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM, +3 to their melee attack damage rolls, and Set Defense. Stand & Deliver lasts for one round. (Models suffer –2 on charge, slam power attack, and impact attack rolls against a model with Set Defense.)

petCemetery.name: Pet Cemetery
petCemetery.description: Midas spends any number of fury points when this feat is used. Return each destroyed warbeast from Midas’ battlegroup to play, placing them completely within 6" of Midas with one unmarked damage box in each aspect. For each fury point spent, remove 1 damage point from each model in Midas’ battlegroup that is in his control range. Returned warbeasts gain Undead. Returned warbeasts cannot be forced this turn. Warbeasts that were destroyed this turn cannot be returned.

disjunction.name: Disjunction
disjunction.description: While in Mohsar’s control range, enemy models cannot leech fury, enemy warbeasts cannot have fury leeched from them, and enemy warjacks cannot power up. Disjunction lasts for one round.

seedsOfDestruction.name: Seeds of Destruction
seedsOfDestruction.description: When a friendly Faction model boxes a living or undead enemy model with a melee or ranged attack while the enemy model is in Morvahna’s control range this turn, enemy models within 2" of the boxed model suffer an unboostable  POW 13 damage roll.
