This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Friendly models within 2" of the boxed model can each remove d3 damage points. Then the destroyed model is removed from play.

bloodSacrifice.name: Blood Sacrifice
bloodSacrifice.description: Morvahna immediately suffers 1 or more damage points. This damage cannot be transferred. For each damage point she suffers, return one destroyed non-character living friendly Faction trooper model to play. Returned models must be placed completely within her control range and within 2" of another model in their units. Troopers are returned with one unmarked damage box and must forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions this turn.

darkWaters.name: Dark Waters
darkWaters.description: While in Rask’s control range, friendly Faction models cannot be targeted by attacks, charges, or slam power attacks made by models more than 5" away from them. Dark Waters lasts for one round.

ritesOfTheWurm.name: Rites of the Wurm
ritesOfTheWurm.description: Tanith can channel spells through warbeasts in her battlegroup while they are in her control range. Additionally, when Tanith or a warbeast in her battlegroup in her control range casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1. When Tanith casts a spell affected by Rites of the Wurm, the COST of a spell cannot be reduced to less than 1. Rites of the Wurm lasts for one turn.

fromOnHigh.name: From on High
fromOnHigh.description: Friendly Faction models with Flight currently in Una’s control range gain +2 SPD for one turn. Additionally, while in Una’s control range friendly Faction light warbeasts with Flight cannot be targeted by melee attacks. From on High lasts for one round.

blackRoots.name: Black Roots
blackRoots.description: The area within 10" of Wurmwood becomes a forest. Enemy models that become knocked down while within 10" of Wurmwood suffer 1 damage point. Black Roots lasts for one round.

starstrikeCalibration.name: Starstrike Calibration
starstrikeCalibration.description: Aurora and friendly Faction models with Flight beginning their activations in her control range gain +2 SPD. Additionally, when a friendly Faction model with Flight makes an attack against an enemy model without Flight that is in Aurora’s control range, add +2 to the damage rolls. Starstrike Calibration lasts for one turn.

eleventhHour.name: Eleventh Hour
eleventhHour.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Aurora’s control range gain Reposition [5"] and Unstoppable. Eleventh Hour lasts for one turn. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [5"] can advance up to 5", then its activation ends.)

arcanodynamicCatalysis.name: Arcanodynamic Catalysis
arcanodynamicCatalysis.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi in Locke’s control range immediately expire. For one round, when an enemy model is forced, casts a spell, or spends 1 or more essence, focus or fury points while in Locke’s control range, you can place one catalytic token on a model in Locke’s battlegroup currently in her control range. If a model casts a spell by spending essence, focus, or fury, Arcanodynamic Catalysis triggers only once. A model cannot have more than three catalytic tokens on it at any time. A model gains +1 DEF and +1 ARM for each catalytic token on it. The weapons of a model with one or more catalytic tokens gain Damage Type: Magical. Remove one catalytic token from each affected model at the end of its activation.

circumpotence.name: Circumpotence
circumpotence.description: Enemy models/units activating in Axis’ control range suffer –2 SPD, –2 to their melee damage rolls, and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks. Circumpotence lasts for one round.

oblivionConfiguration.name: Oblivion Configuration
oblivionConfiguration.description: Friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls against enemy models in Orion’s control range that have 1 or more essence, focus, or fury points. Oblivion Configuration lasts for one turn.

clockworkReinforcement.name: Clockwork Reinforcement
clockworkReinforcement.description: While within Lucant’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM. When a friendly Faction model in Lucant’s control range makes a Repair special action, add +2 to the damage removed. Clockwork Reinforcement lasts for one round.

technologicalSuperiority.name: Technological Superiority
technologicalSuperiority.description: Warjacks in Syntherion’s battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range can charge without spending focus and gain an additional die on their attack rolls. Technological Superiority lasts for one turn.

mathematicalPerfection.name: Mathematical Perfection
mathematicalPerfection.description: The base MAT and RAT of friendly Faction models in Directrix’s control range are each equal to her current ARC stat for one turn.

roulette.name: Roulette
roulette.description: While in Ashlynn’s control range, models gain two additional dice on their attack rolls. For each of those attack rolls, you choose two of the dice rolled to be discarded. Roulette lasts for one round.

lamentationsOfWar.name: Lamentations of War
lamentationsOfWar.description: Return d3 + 2 friendly destroyed small- or medium-based Faction solos to play. Place those models within 1" of Ashlynn. Those models must forfeit their Combat Action this turn.

metaPrinciple.name: Meta Principle
metaPrinciple.description: While in Syvestro’s control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard one die of your choice in each roll. Additionally, when an enemy model is destroyed while in Syvestro’s control range, a friendly Faction model in Syvestro’s control range can remove d3 damage points. Meta Principle lasts for one turn.

overdose.name: Overdose
overdose.description: Di Morray gains one elixer token and 1 focus point. Warjacks in his battlegroup currently in his control range also gain 1 focus point. Additionally, di Morray gains Range Amplifier this activation. (When a model with Range Amplifier casts a spell and is the point of origin for the spell, the spell gains +5 RNG.)

arcanodynamicCatalysis__8bffef83.name: Arcanodynamic Catalysis
arcanodynamicCatalysis__8bffef83.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi in Locke’s control range immediately expire. For one round, when an enemy model is forced, casts a spell, or spends 1 or more essence, focus, or fury points while in Locke’s control range, you can place one catalytic token on a model in Locke’s battlegroup currently in her control range. If a model casts a spell by spending essence, focus, or fury, Arcanodynamic Catalysis triggers only once. A model cannot have more than three catalytic tokens on it at any time. A model gains +1 DEF and +1 ARM for each catalytic token on it. The weapons of a model with one or more catalytic tokens gain Damage Type: Magical. Remove one catalytic token from each affected model at the end of its activation.

typhoon.name: Typhoon
typhoon.description: Enemy models that advance and end their movement in or are placed in Montador’s control range become knocked down. While in Montador’s control range, enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls. Typhoon lasts for one round.

conquest.name: Conquest
conquest.description: While in Damiano’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM, +3 to their melee attack damage rolls, and can only move or be moved only during your turn. Conquest lasts for one round.

overwhelmingForce.name: Overwhelming Force
overwhelmingForce.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Mackay’s control range gain Run & Gun and their weapons gain Damage Type: Magical. Additionally, when a friendly Faction construct model makes a damage roll against an enemy model in Mackay’s control range, the damage roll is boosted. Overwhelming Force lasts for one turn. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

trueGrit.name: True Grit
trueGrit.description: Choose d6 + 5 friendly Faction non-Leader warrior models currently in MacBain’s control range. Chosen models gain +2 ARM. When a chosen model is disabled, it removes 1 damage point and becomes knocked down. True Grit lasts for one round.

bombsAway.name: Bombs Away
bombsAway.description: While in Madhammer’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 RAT. When an enemy model suffers a blast damage roll or is directly hit by an AOE weapon while in Madhammer’s control range, add an additional die to the damage roll. Bombs Away lasts for one turn.

perfectPlan.name: Perfect Plan
perfectPlan.description: Friendly Rhul Guard models/units currently in Ossrum’s control range gain +3 ARM, +3 SPD, and Pathfinder. Perfect Plan lasts for one round.

landslide.name: Landslide
landslide.description: Choose a table edge and a distance up to 8". Enemy models currently in Gorten’s control range are pushed the chosen distance directly toward the chosen table edge in the order you choose. For one round, affected models suffer –3 SPD, RAT, and DEF, and cannot charge or make slam or trample power attacks.

shadowWar.name: Shadow War
shadowWar.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Crosse’s control range are affected by Ghost Walk this turn. Additionally, affected models gain Stealth and Run & Gun for one round. (At the end of its activation, if it destroyed one or more enemy models with ranged attacks that activation, a model with Run & Gun can make a full advance.)

airSupport.name: Air Support
airSupport.description: Put a Rocketman unit and a Rocketman Ace solo into play. Place each model completely within 3" of Bennet.

foxHunt.name: Fox Hunt
foxHunt.description: Choose an enemy model/unit in Gearhart’s control range. Friendly Faction models gain Prey against the chosen model/unit. A model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit in Gearhart’s control range to be the prey. Fox Hunt lasts for one turn.

ritesOfShadow.name: Rites of Shadow
ritesOfShadow.description: When an enemy model is forced, casts a spell, or spends 1 or more focus or fury points while in Asphyxious’ control range, Asphyxious can remove d3 damage points and gains one soul token. If a model casts a spell by spending focus or fury, Rites of Shadow triggers only once. Rites of Shadow lasts for one round.

shadowfall.name: Shadowfall
shadowfall.description: Models in Agathia’s battlegroup currently in her control range are affected by Ghost Walk. Additionally, you can place each friendly faction Cohort model currently in Agathia’s control range anywhere completely within 3" of its current location. Shadowfall lasts for one turn.

hellGate.name: Hell Gate
hellGate.description: Deneghra gains three soul tokens. Additionally each warjack in Denghra’s battlegroup currently in her control range gains three focus points.

darkOmen.name: Dark Omen
darkOmen.description: Enemy models roll one fewer die when making attack and damage rolls while in Fiona’s control range. Dark Omen lasts for one round.

darkSummons.name: Dark Summons
darkSummons.description: Put a small-based Bane unit into play. Place each model completely within 3" of Goreshade.

reanimator.name: Reanimator
reanimator.description: Remove one or more friendly Faction warrior models currently in Goreshade’s control range from play. For each model removed, return one destroyed non-character friendly Faction warrior model to play completely within Goreshade’s control range. Place returned troopers models in play within 2" of another model in their units. Returned models forfeit their Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they return to play.

wintersGrasp.name: Winter’s Grasp
wintersGrasp.description: Choose any number of friendly Faction small- or medium-based non-Leader warrior models currently in Goreshade’s control range. Enemy models within 1" of a chosen model become stationary for one round unless they have Resistance: Cold, then the chosen models are destroyed.

consumingBlight.name: Consuming Blight
consumingBlight.description: Enemy models currently in Asphyxious’ control range suffer an unboostable POW 5 damage roll. Consuming Blight damage rolls are simultaneous. Asphyxious then gains up to 7 focus points. He cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Consuming Blight.

toTheSlaughter.name: To the Slaughter
toTheSlaughter.description: This model gains +2 SPD. When a model in this model's battlegroup activates while in this model's control range, the activating model gains +2 SPD. When an affected model ends its Normal Movement with an enemy model in its melee range, the affected model gains 1 focus point. To the Slaughter lasts for one turn.

spectralLegion.name: Spectral Legion
spectralLegion.description: Return up to d3 + 5 friendly destroyed small- or medium-based Grunts to play. Place these models anywhere completely within 3" of Asphyxious. Returned models gain Undead and Ghostly and become solos. These returned models cannot be targeted by attacks or damaged. Returned models leave play at the end of this turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

dragonsCall.name: Dragon’s Call
dragonsCall.description: When a living enemy model is destroyed in Terminus’ control range, Terminus gains the destroyed model’s soul token. Terminus gains +1 ARM for each soul token on him. Dragon’s Call lasts for one round.

vengeanceOfTheDragonfather.name: Vengeance of the Dragonfather
vengeanceOfTheDragonfather.description: Enemy models cannot allocate focus points to or leech fury points from models in Venethrax’s control range. Vengeance of the Dragonfather lasts for one round.

blackGate.name: Black Gate
blackGate.description: While in Scaverous’ control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted magic attack rolls. When Scaverous casts a spell, reduce the COST of the spell by 1. When an enemy model casts a spell while in Scaverous’ control range, increase the COST by 1. Black Gate lasts for one round.

recalibration.name: Recalibration
recalibration.description: While in Mortenebra’s control range, friendly Faction models can reroll attack and damage rolls this turn. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Recalibration.

mechanismOfDestruction.name: Mechanism of Destruction
mechanismOfDestruction.description: While in the Mortenebra’s control range, models in her battlegroup gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die of each roll. Additionally, while in Mortenebra’s control range, friendly models gain Side Step. Mechanism of Destruction lasts for one turn. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.)

fateWeaver.name: Fate Weaver
fateWeaver.description: Skarre immediately suffers up to 5 damage points. Skarrel cannot spend focus points to reduce this damage. For each damage point she suffers as a result of Fate Weaver, one model currently in her control range can be affected by Fate Weaver. An affected friendly model cannot be targeted by charges and gains +5 DEF for one round. An affected enemy model suffers –5 to attack rolls for one round.

deadOnArrival.name: Dead on Arrival
deadOnArrival.description: Enemy non-Leader models in Sturgis’ control range are immediately pushed 3" directly toward Sturgis in the order you choose. Then enemy models within 3" of Sturgis suffer a POW 12 magical damage roll. These damage rolls are simultaneous. For each model destroyed by Dead on Arrival, you can allocate 1 focus point to a warjack in Sturgis’ battlegroup in his control range.

nightfall.name: Nightfall
nightfall.description: While in the Coven’s control range, enemy models have their LOS reduced to 5". Nightfall lasts for one round.

theWithering.name: The Withering
theWithering.description: Enemy models currently in Deneghra’s control range suffer –2 SPD, MAT, RAT, DEF, and ARM. The Withering lasts for one round.

webOfShadows.name: Web of Shadows
webOfShadows.description: Choose d3 + 3 friendly non-Leader Faction models currently in Deneghra’s control range. The chosen models gain Incorporeal for one round.

eyeOfTheStorm.name: Eye of the Storm
eyeOfTheStorm.description: When a friendly Faction model makes an electrical damage roll against an enemy model in Nemo’s control range, add an additional die to the damage roll. Eye of the Storm lasts for one turn.

reapTheWhirlwind.name: Reap the Whirlwind
reapTheWhirlwind.description: While in Caine’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain a +1 cumulative bonus on ranged attack and ranged damage rolls for each other model in his battlegroup that hit an enemy model with a ranged attack this turn while in Caine’s control range. This cumulative bonus cannot exceed +3. Reap the Whirlwind lasts for one turn.

powerhouse.name: Powerhouse
powerhouse.description: While in Jakes’ control range, friendly Faction models gain Resistance: Electricity and Unstoppable. Affected models’ melee weapons become RNG 2 and gain Electro Leap. Powerhouse lasts for one round.

overkill.name: Overkill
overkill.description: After resolving each ranged attack that hits an enemy model, Caine gains a cumulative +1 to his Spellstorm Pistol attack damage rolls. Overkill expires at the end of Caine’s activation.

pitStop.name: Pit Stop
pitStop.description: Remove all damage from friendly Faction warjacks currently in Darius' control range. Additionally, friendly Faction warjacks currently in Darius' control range gain +2 SPD, RAT, and +2 to melee damage rolls for one turn.

shadowWar__75e68be9.name: Shadow War
shadowWar__75e68be9.description: When one or more enemy model are destroyed by an attack while in Kraye’s control range, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in Kraye’s battlegroup currently in its control range gains 1 focus point. Additionally, while in Kraye’s control range, models in his battle group gain Stealth. Shadow War lasts for one round.

firingSquad.name: Firing Squad
firingSquad.description: Sloan immediately casts Fire Group without spending focus. Additionally, Sloan and models in her battlegroup beginning their activations in her control range can make one additional ranged attack during their activations. Firing Squad lasts for one turn.

temporalBarrier.name: Temporal Barrier
temporalBarrier.description: While in Haley's control range, enemy models suffer –2 DEF. Enemy models beginning their activations in Haley’s control range suffer –2 SPD. Temporal Barrier lasts for one round.

perfectPosition.name: Perfect Position
perfectPosition.description: Small- and medium-based based friendly Faction warrior models currently in Brisbane’s control range can immediately advance up to 3" and then gain Dig In. Warjacks in Brisbane’s battlegroup currently in his control range gain Bulldoze for one turn. (A model with Dig In gains cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.) (When a model with Bulldoze is B2B with an enemy model during its Normal Movement, it can push that model up to 2" directly away from it. A model can be pushed by Bulldoze only once per turn. Bulldoze has no effect when a model makes a trample power attack.)

electricalStorm.name: Electrical Storm
electricalStorm.description: Enemy Cohort models currently in Nemo’s control range suffer a POW 14 electrical damage roll. Electrical Storm damage rolls are simultaneous. Warjacks damaged by Electrical Storm suffer Disruption.

invincibility.name: Invincibility
invincibility.description: While in Stryker’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +5 ARM for one round.

highVoltage.name: High Voltage
highVoltage.description: Each warjack in Nemo’s battlegroup currently in his control range is allocated up to 3 focus points.

maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
maelstrom.description: Caine can make a basic Spellstorm Pistol attack against every enemy model currently in his control range, ignoring intervening models. Caine cannot use Maelstrom while he is engaged. Maelstrom attacks are simultaneous.

rollingThunder.name: Rolling Thunder
rollingThunder.description: After all friendly models have completed their activations this turn, friendly Faction models/units currently in Stryker’s control range can advance up to 3" and then can make one basic melee attack. When resolving these attacks, affected models can spend focus points to boost one attack or damage roll for each focus point spent.

lightningCharge.name: Lightning Charge
lightningCharge.description: When a friendly Faction model makes a power attack or a charge attack while in Stryker’s control range, the attack automatically hits and gains an additional die on the damage roll. Lightning Charge lasts for one turn.

thunderingRage.name: Thundering Rage
thunderingRage.description: While in Maddox’s control range, friendly Faction models’ weapons gain +2 POW and Beat Back. Thundering Rage lasts for one turn. (Immediately after a basic attack with a weapon with Beat Back is resolved during this model’s Combat Action, the enemy model hit can be pushed 1" directly away from the attacking model. After the enemy model is pushed, the attacking model can advance up to 1" directly toward it.)

breach.name: Breach
breach.description: Remove all wall templates currently in Siege’s control range. Additionally, the next time each enemy model suffers a damage roll while in Siege’s control range, halve its base ARM when calculating damage. Breach lasts for one turn.

arcaneSingularity.name: Arcane Singularity
arcaneSingularity.description: Friendly Haley models in play currently in this model’s control range gain +2 AAT, ARC, and Ctrl for one turn and immediately gain 2 focus points.

blitz.name: Blitz
blitz.description: Haley and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in her control range can make one additional ranged or melee attack during their activations. Blitz lasts for one turn.

adrenalineRush.name: Adrenaline Rush
adrenalineRush.description: Monstrosities in Cyphon’s battlegroup currently in his control range gain +3 SPD and ARM and +3 to their melee attack damage rolls for one round.

massDelusion.name: Mass Delusion
massDelusion.description: While in Khythos's control range, enemy models suffer –2 to their attack rolls against friendly Faction non-Incorporeal models. Additionally, friendly Faction non-Incorporeal models in Khythos’s control range gain Dodge. Mass Delusion lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

telekineticTide.name: Telekinetic Tide
telekineticTide.description: Push each enemy non-Leader model currently in Thexus’ control range 2" in any direction.

metamorphose.name: Metamorphose
metamorphose.description: Models in Absylonia’s battlegroup currently in her control range gain Flight, +2 to their melee attack damage rolls, and their melee weapons gain +1 RNG. Metamorphose lasts for one round.

fieldOfBones.name: Field of Bones
fieldOfBones.description: While in Anamag’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain Dark Shroud and their melee weapons gain Grievous Wounds. Field of Bones lasts for one turn. (While within 2" of a model with Dark Shroud, enemy models suffer –2 ARM.) (On a direct hit, a model hit by a weapon with Grievous Wounds loses Tough and cannot have damage removed from it for one round.)

dragonSBreath__19d37ae8.name: Dragon's Breath
dragonSBreath__19d37ae8.description: While in Kallus' control range, enemy models lose Resistance: Fire and cannot gain it. Additionally, enemy models currently in Kallus’ control range immediately suffer the fire continuous effect. Dragon's Breath lasts for one round.

dragonStorm.name: Dragon Storm
dragonStorm.description: After all friendly models have completed their activations this turn, each warbeast in Thagrosh’s battlegroup that is in his control range can make a full advance followed by one basic melee attack. Completely resolve each warbeast’s movement and attack before moving on to the next.

whispersOfTorment.name: Whispers of Torment
whispersOfTorment.description: While in Xekaar’s control range, enemy models suffer –2 MAT, RAT, and THR. Additionally, affected models suffer –2 to their melee attack damage rolls. Whispers of Torment lasts for one round.

arcaneReaver.name: Arcane Reaver
arcaneReaver.description: Immediately remove any number of soul tokens, fury points, essence points, and focus points from non-Leader models in Hexeris’ control range. For each token or point removed, place 1 fury point on Hexeris. Hexeris cannot exceed his current ARC in fury points as a result of Arcane Reaver.

voidWind.name: Void Wind
voidWind.description: While in Mordikaar’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF and Poltergeist. Void Wind lasts for one round.

strengthEternal.name: Strength Eternal
strengthEternal.description: Remove d6 + 3 damage points from each friendly Faction construct model currently in Zaal’s control range. While in Zaal’s control range, friendly Faction construct models gain +3 ARM. Strength Eternal lasts for one round.

desecratedIcons.name: Desecrated Icons
desecratedIcons.description: Place a desecration token on each non-cache scenario element within Ashmael’s control range. When a friendly Faction model attacks an enemy model that is within contesting range of a scenario element with a desecration token, they gain an additional die on the attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. When you secure a scenario element with a desecration token, remove the token from it.

vampiricShroud.name: Vampiric Shroud
vampiricShroud.description: Hysene can cast one spell this activation without spending fury. The first time each friendly Faction Eldritch model destroys an enemy model while within Hysene’s control range, it gains +3 ARM. Vampiric Shroud lasts for one round.

strengthOfArms.name: Strength of Arms
strengthOfArms.description: When a friendly Faction model makes a melee attack against an enemy model while the enemy model is in Kreoss' control range, the attack automatically hits. While in Kreoss' control range, friendly Faction models can make one additional melee attack during their Combat Actions. Strength of Arms lasts for one turn.

divineMight.name: Divine Might
divineMight.description: While in Severius’ control range, enemy models cannot cast spells or be used to channel spells and enemy Leaders suffer –2 ARC. Divine Might lasts for one round.

vigilanceOfTheFaithful.name: Vigilance of the Faithful
vigilanceOfTheFaithful.description: While in Cyrenia’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. When one or more friendly Faction models are destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack while in Cyrenia’s control range, immediately after the attack is resolved one friendly Faction warrior model in Cyrenia’s control range  can advance up to 2". A model can only move once per turn as a result of Vigilance of the Faithful. Vigilance of the Faithful lasts for one round.

purgeTheFaithless.name: Purge the Faithless
purgeTheFaithless.description: When an enemy model is boxed by a melee or ranged attack while in Reznik’s control range, enemy models within 2" of the boxed models suffer an unboostable POW 12 fire damage roll. After resolving this damage, the boxed model is removed from play. This damage is not considered to have been caused by an attack. Purge the Faithless lasts for one turn.

minefield.name: Minefield
minefield.description: While in the Hasker’s control range, enemy models lose Pathfinder and cannot gain it, and treat open terrain as rough terrain. Additionally, place three mine tokens anywhere completely within Hasker’s control range. When an enemy model enters, is placed, or ends its activation within 3" of a mine, roll a d6; on a result of 1-2 nothing happens, on a result of 3-6 the model suffers an unboostable POW 14 magical blast damage roll and is knocked down. Models disabled by mine tokens cannot make a Tough roll. Minefield lasts for one round. When Minefield expires, remove the mine tokens from play.

fullBlast.name: Full Blast
fullBlast.description: McCoy and friendly Faction models/units beginning their activations in his control range gain Cavalry and Reposition [5"]. Additionally, affected friendly Faction models/units gain +2 SPD when they charge. Full Blast lasts for one turn.

firefight.name: Firefight
firefight.description: Warjacks in this model’s battlegroup beginning their activations in her control range can make one additional ranged or melee attack during their activations. Additionally, while in Cyn’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Swift Hunter. Firefight lasts for one turn. (When a model with Swift Hunter destroys one or more enemy models with a basic ranged attack, immediately after the attack is resolved it can advance up to 2".)

lastDance.name: Last Dance
lastDance.description: While within Jakes' control range friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. Additionally, friendly Faction models currently in Jakes' control range gain Acrobatics and Unstoppable. Last Dance lasts for one round.

arcaneConflagration.name: Arcane Conflagration
arcaneConflagration.description: After resolving each ranged attack that hits an enemy model, Caine gains a cumulative +1 to his Spellstorm Pistol damage rolls. When a model is boxed by a Spellstorm Pistol attack, models within 1" of it suffer an unboostable POW 10 magical blast damage roll, then remove the boxed model from play. Arcane Conflagration lasts for one round.

standingTall.name: Standing Tall
standingTall.description: While in Vargus’ control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM and cannot become knocked down. Standing Tall lasts for one round.

cloudBurst.name: Cloud Burst
cloudBurst.description: Sparkhammer gains the benefit of all of his Arcane Machinery effects this activation. Additionally, while in Sparkhammer’s control range, friendly models can reroll electrical attack and attack damage rolls. Each roll can be rerolled only once due to Cloud Burst. Cloud Burst lasts for one turn.

restorationsOfShadow.name: Restorations of Shadow
restorationsOfShadow.description: Remove all damage from friendly Faction extra-large and smaller based models in Hazaroth’s control range. Additionally, each warjack in Hazaroth’s battlegroup currently in his control area gains 3 focus points.

blessingsOfTheVoid.name: Blessings of the Void
blessingsOfTheVoid.description: While in Hellyth’s control range, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and ARM and friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM. Blessings of the Void lasts for one round.

shadowInitiative.name: Shadow Initiative
shadowInitiative.description: Upkeep spells in Morayne's control range immediately expire. This activation Morayne can cast one spell without spending focus for each upkeep spell that expired as a result of Shadow Initiative.

ironStorm.name: Iron Storm
ironStorm.description: Enemy models that advance and end their movement in or are placed in Scyrafael’s control range and closer to her than they began suffer an unboostable pow 10 magical damage roll, then are pushed d3" directly away from Scyrafael in the order you choose. Iron Storm lasts for one round.

invocationOfShadow.name: Invocation of Shadow
invocationOfShadow.description: Immediately place Tyrus and friendly Faction models currently in his control range anywhere completely within 2" of their current locations. Additionally, Tyrus and friendly Faction models/units activating in his control range gain Ghostly. Invocation of Shadow lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

wellOfSorrow.name: Well of Sorrow
wellOfSorrow.description: When an enemy model casts a spell while in Agathon’s control range, increase the COST of the spell by 1. Additionally, while in Agathon’s control range, models gain one additional die on their arcane attack and arcane attack damage rolls. You choose a die to discard in each roll. Well of Sorrow lasts for one round.

shadowsOfAnnihilation.name: Shadows of Annihilation
shadowsOfAnnihilation.description: Omodamos immediately casts Locked Horns without spending essence. Additionally, Omodamos and friendly Faction models activating in his control range gain +2 SPD and Ghostly. Shadows of Annihilation lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

malignantConduit.name: Malignant Conduit
malignantConduit.description: Summon a horror without spending essence. Malignant Conduit does not count towards the maximum number of horrors this model can summon per activation or game. The horror summoned by Malignant Conduit must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat action the turn it is summoned.

whisperingVoid.name: Whispering Void
whisperingVoid.description: While in Zaateroth’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. When an enemy model misses a friendly Faction model in Zaateroth’s control range with an attack, immediately after the attack is resolved place the friendly model anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. Whispering Void lasts for one round.

missionCritical.name: Mission Critical
missionCritical.description: While in Strakhov’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain +3 ARM, Tough, and Feign Death. Mission Critical lasts for one round. (A model with Feign Death cannot be targeted by ranged or arcane attacks while knocked down.)

toTheSlaughter__85e4207d.name: To the Slaughter
toTheSlaughter__85e4207d.description: This model gains +2 SPD. When a model in this model's batltegroup activates while in this model's control range, the activating model gains +2 SPD. When an affected model ends its Normal Movement with an enemy model in its melee range, the affected model gains 1 focus point. To the Slaughter lasts for one turn.

howlingWind.name: Howling Wind
howlingWind.description: While in Zerkova’s control range, enemy models cannot make ranged attacks. Enemy models beginning their activations in Zerkova’s control range cannot run, charge, make power attacks or special attacks, or make special actions. Howling Wind lasts for one round.

feelTheHate.name: Feel the Hate
feelTheHate.description: Each time an enemy model is destroyed in Zoktavir’s control range, you can place one rage token on a friendly Faction model in his control range. A model can have up to three rage tokens at any time. Models can spend rage tokens during their activations to make additional melee attacks or to boost melee attack or melee damage rolls. A model can make one additional attack or boost one roll for each token spent. Feel the Hate lasts for one turn. Remove unspent rage tokens at the end of this turn.

icyGaze.name: Icy Gaze
icyGaze.description: Enemy models without Resistance: Cold currently in Sorscha’s control range and LOS become stationary for one round.

redHaze.name: Red Haze
redHaze.description: Zoktavir immediately gains 6 focus points. He cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Red Haze. Living enemy models cannot charge Zoktavir. Red Haze lasts for one round.

onrush.name: Onrush
onrush.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Kozlov’s control range gain +2 SPD and Unyielding for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

arcaneConvergence.name: Arcane Convergence
arcaneConvergence.description: Each friendly Faction model currently in Zerkova’s control range can immediately cast one spell without spending focus, performing a special action, or performing a special attack.

desperateGround.name: Desperate Ground
desperateGround.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Irusk’s control range ignore cloud effects and forests when determining LOS and gain Pathfinder. Affected models currently knocked down immediately stand up. Enemy models/units beginning their activations in Irusk’s control range suffer –3 SPD. Desperate Ground lasts for one round.

fieldOfTalons.name: Field of Talons
fieldOfTalons.description: Enemy models that advance and end their movement in or are placed in the Old Witch’s control range immediately suffer an unboostable POW 14 magical damage roll. Warrior models damaged by Field of Talons become knocked down. Field of Talons lasts for one round.

chargeOfTheHorseLords.name: Charge of the Horse Lords
chargeOfTheHorseLords.description: While in Vladimir’s control range, friendly Faction warjacks and cavalry models gain Side Step and Sprint. Charge of the Horse Lords lasts for one turn. (When a model with Side Step hits an enemy model with an initial melee attack or a melee special attack, the model with Side Step can advance up to 2" after the attack is resolved.) (At the end of an activation in which it destroyed or removed from play one or more enemy models with melee attacks, a model with Sprint can immediately make a full advance, then its activation ends.)

bloodLegacy.name: Blood Legacy
bloodLegacy.description: Choose d3 + 3 friendly Faction non-character warrior models currently in Vladimir’s control range. Those models gain +3 SPD, MAT, RAT, DEF, and ARM. Additionally, affected models gain +3 to their melee attack damage rolls. Blood Legacy lasts for one round.

forcedMarch.name: Forced March
forcedMarch.description: Warjacks in Vladimir’s battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range double their base SPD and can run, charge, and make power attacks without spending focus. Forced March lasts for one turn.

hourOfReckoning.name: Hour of Reckoning
hourOfReckoning.description: The Old Witch gains the benefit of all of her Arcane Machinery effects this activation.

victoryMarch.name: Victory March
victoryMarch.description: Place each model in Tarja's battlegroup, and each model in one friendly Faction unit, completely within 3" of their current locations.

rollingMist.name: Rolling Mist
rollingMist.description: Enemy models' line of sight is reduced to 8". Rolling Mist lasts for one round.

stronghold.name: Stronghold
stronghold.description: While within Gunnbjorn’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Impervious Flesh. Stronghold lasts for one round. (When a model with Impervious Flesh suffers a damage roll, roll one fewer die.)

doubleTimeIt.name: Double Time It
doubleTimeIt.description: One friendly Faction non-leader warrior model/unit in Abraham’s control range can immediately be removed from the table and goes into the tunnels. That model/unit gains Ambush and Tunnel Ambush. During your next turn, friendly Faction warrior models that ambush and are placed within Abraham’s control range do not have to sacrifice their movement or action.

breakOut.name: Break Out!
breakOut.description: You may choose a friendly Trapdoor marker within 7" of Craghorn. A friendly Faction model/unit with the Tunnel Ambush rule that is not in play immediately ambushes to the chosen marker.  Choose up to 3 friendly Faction models/units that ambushed this turn. They gain +2 to damage rolls. Break Out! lasts one turn.

panacea.name: Panacea
panacea.description: Remove all damage from models in Absylonia’s battlegroup that are currently in her control range. Additionally, while in Absylonia’s control range models in her battlegroup gain Rapid Healing. Panacea lasts for one round. (When a model with Rapid Healing is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.)

fleshWeb.name: Flesh Web
fleshWeb.description: While in Bethayne's control range, friendly living Faction models gain Rapid Healing. Additionally, while a friendly living Faction model is B2B with another friendly living Faction model, it gains +2 ARM and cannot become knocked down. Flesh Web lasts for one round. (When a model with Rapid Healing is damaged by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved remove d3 damage points from it.)

symbiosis.name: Symbiosis
symbiosis.description: While in Bethayne’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain Flank [friendly Faction warbeast]. Symbiosis lasts for one round. (When a model with Flank [friendly Faction warbeast] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction warbeast model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional die on damage rolls.)

unstoppableTide.name: Unstoppable Tide
unstoppableTide.description: While in Fyanna’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 DEF and Dodge. Unstoppable Tide lasts for one round.

hostOfAngels.name: Host of Angels
hostOfAngels.description: When a friendly living non-Incubus warrior Faction model in Kallus’ control range is disabled by an enemy attack, you can replace it with an Incubus model. The replaced model is removed from play. Additionally, while in Kallus’ control range, friendly soulless warrior models gain +3 DEF. Host of Angels lasts for one round.

rageOfTheDragon.name: Rage of the Dragon
rageOfTheDragon.description: While in Kryssa’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 to their melee attack damage rolls and their melee weapons gain the Fire continuous effect. Rage of the Dragon lasts for one turn.

fieldOfSlaughter.name: Field of Slaughter
fieldOfSlaughter.description: While within Lylyth's control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted attack rolls. Field of Slaughter lasts for one turn.

theReaping.name: The Reaping
theReaping.description: When an enemy model is directly hit by a ranged attack made by a friendly Faction model while the friendly Faction model is in Lylyth’s control range, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round. The Reaping lasts for one turn.

decimation.name: Decimation
decimation.description: While in Lylyth’s control range, friendly Faction models' ranged weapons gain Pistol and affected models can make one additional ranged attack during their activations. Decimation lasts for one turn.

troubleshoot.name: Troubleshoot
troubleshoot.description: While in Mekanolyth's control range, friendly Faction models can reroll ranged attack and ranged attack damage rolls. Additionally, affected models' ranged weapons gain +2 RNG. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Troubleshoot. Troubleshoot lasts for one turn.

tideOfBlood.name: Tide of Blood
tideOfBlood.description: Rhyas and friendly Faction models activating in her control range gain one additional melee attack during their Combat Actions. The first time a friendly Faction model damages an enemy model with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action while in Rhyas’ control range, immediately place the attacking model anywhere B2B with the damaged model. Tide of Blood lasts for one turn.

foreboding.name: Foreboding
foreboding.description: While in Saeryn’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM and models in her battlegroup gain Retaliatory Strike. Foreboding lasts for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

conjoinedSpirits.name: Conjoined Spirits
conjoinedSpirits.description: Conjoined Spirits can be used once per game by either Saeryn or Rhyas. When it is used, you can either have Saeryn and Rhyas immediately trade places or you can return one of them to play. If you choose to return Saeryn or Rhyas to play, place the returned model completely within 3" of the model that used Conjoined Spirits. The returned model comes into play with a number of fury points equal to its ARC. After Conjoined Spirits is used, Saeryn and Rhyas cannot advance for the rest of the turn. If you return Saeryn to play as a result of Conjoined Spirits, Rhyas is no longer a warlock or a Leader model  and returns to being a solo.

darkRevival.name: Dark Revival
darkRevival.description: Return one destroyed large-based or smaller warbeast that was part of Thagrosh’s battlegroup to play. Place it anywhere completely within 3" of him. The warbeast must forfeit its Combat Action this turn.

darkMiracles.name: Dark Miracles
darkMiracles.description: This activation, Vayl can cast each of her spells once without spending fury.

catMouse.name: Cat & Mouse
catMouse.description: At the end of this turn after all friendly models have ended their activations, each friendly non-trooper Faction model in Vayl’s control range can make a full advance.

dawnsLight.name: Dawn’s Light
dawnsLight.description: While in Issyria’s control range, friendly Faction models gain True Sight and gain one additional die on attack and damage rolls. For each of those rolls, discard one die of your choice. Dawn’s Light lasts for one turn. (A model with True Sight ignores cloud effects when determining LOS. A model with True Sight also ignores Stealth.)

gravityWell.name: Gravity Well
gravityWell.description: When an enemy model in Ossyan’s control range makes a ranged attack damage roll, it rolls one fewer die. When a friendly Faction model makes a ranged attack damage roll against an enemy model in Ossyan’s control range, it gains an additional die on the roll. Gravity Well lasts for one round.

arcantrikAptitude.name: Arcantrik Aptitude
arcantrikAptitude.description: Remove all damage from extra-large and smaller based models in Helynna’s battlegroup currently in her control range. Additionally, while in Helynna’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +3 ARM and friendly Faction warjacks models do not suffer the effects of crippled systems. Arcantrik Aptitude lasts for one round.

tidesOfBattle.name: Tides of Battle
tidesOfBattle.description: When one or more friendly Faction models are destroyed or removed from play by an enemy attack while in Vyros’ control range at any time except while advancing, immediately after the attack is resolved one friendly Faction model in Vyros’ control range can advance up to 3". Tide of Battle lasts for one round.

godspeed.name: Godspeed
godspeed.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Shae’s control range immediately advance up to 3". During this movement, affected models gain Pathfinder.

boneyard.name: Boneyard
boneyard.description: Models in Eviscerus' battlegroup currently in his control range become Dug In. Then, models in Eviscerus' battlegroup currently in his control range gain Burial Rites. (A dug in model has cover, gains Resistance: Blast, and does not block LOS. The model remains dug in until it moves, is placed, or is engaged.) (A model with Burial Rites gains +2 SPD and one focus point at the start of each activation in which it begins Dug In. A model loses Burial Rites for the rest of the game the next time it ceases to be Dug In.)

doomSDay.name: Doom's Day
doomSDay.description: Dekathus gains five soul tokens. Additionally, cohort models in Dekathus’ battlegroup currently in his control range gain Overtake. Doom’s Day lasts for one round. (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

graveyardShift.name: Graveyard Shift
graveyardShift.description: Put a Mechanithrall Swarm unit into play. Place each model completely within 2" of Sepsira.

reduceReuseRecycle.name: Reduce, Reuse, Recycle
reduceReuseRecycle.description: Return one destroyed large-based or smaller Cohort model that was part of Mortenebra’s battlegroup to play. Place it within 3" of her. The Cohort model must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action this turn.

wrathOfLyliss.name: Wrath of Lyliss
wrathOfLyliss.description: Nekane can suffer one damage point to cast a spell instead of paying the COST of the spell in focus points. Each spell can be cast once as a result of Wrath of Lyliss. Additionally, Nekane can suffer one damage point to boost an attack or damage roll instead of spending a focus point. Wrath of Lyliss lasts for one round.

exhortationOfMartyrdom.name: Exhortation of Martyrdom
exhortationOfMartyrdom.description: While in Lesnoi's control range, friendly Faction warrior models gain Last Word. Additionally, Lesnoi gains Grim Salvation. Exhortation of Martyrdom lasts for one round. (When a model with Last Word is disabled by an enemy attack, it can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack.) (If a model with Grim Salvation is directly hit by a basic attack made by an enemy model, choose a friendly non-incorporeal warrior model within 3" of the model with Grim Salvation to be directly hit instead. That model is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects.)

goToGround__6a4cd85e.name: Go to Ground
goToGround__6a4cd85e.description: While in Lissya's control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF, and Reposition [3"]. Go to Ground lasts for one round. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then it activation ends.)

awakenTheBeast.name: Awaken the Beast
awakenTheBeast.description: If Morozov is in Human Form, immediately use Tempered Shifting to replace him with his Shifted Form. You can immediately replace any friendly Marked models with friendly Shapeshifter models that have not yet been put into play. When a Shapeshifter model replaces a model that entered play this turn or that already activated this turn, it must forfeit its Normal Movement and Combat Action this turn. Additionally, while within Morozov’s control range, friendly Shapeshifter models gain +2 ARM and +2 to melee damage rolls. Awaken the Beast lasts for one round.

lionSRoar.name: Lion's Roar
lionSRoar.description: Friendly Faction warrior models beginning a charge within Maksim's control range gain +2 SPD during that charge. While in Maksim's control range, enemy models cannot run, charge, perform special actions, or perform special attacks. Lion's Roar lasts for 1 round.

pathOfDestruction.name: Path of Destruction
pathOfDestruction.description: While within Yana’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Pathfinder, Cleave, and Overtake. (When a model with Cleave destroys one or more models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved the model can make one additional melee attack. A model can gain only one additional attack from Cleave each activation.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1")

burgeoningThorns.name: Burgeoning Thorns
burgeoningThorns.description: Enemy models without Flight currently within Reznikova's control range suffer –2 SPD and DEF. While in Reznikova's control range, friendly Faction models gain Spring Blades. Burgeoning Thorns lasts for one round.

bastionOfFaith.name: Bastion of Faith
bastionOfFaith.description: While in Durst’s control range, warjacks in his battlegroup gain +4 ARM. When a friendly Faction warrior model in Durst’s control range is directly hit by an attack while B2B with a warjack in Durst’s battlegroup, you can choose to have the warjack be directly hit instead. The warjack is automatically hit and suffers all damage and effects from the attack. Bastion of Faith lasts for one round.

burntOut.name: Burnt Out
burntOut.description: Enemy models currently within 3" of of one or more warjacks in Feora’s battlegroup currently in her control range suffer an unboostable POW 13 fire damage roll and the fire continuous effect.

scorchedEarth.name: Scorched Earth
scorchedEarth.description: Enemy models currently in Feora’s control range suffer the Fire continuous effect. Friendly warjack models can charge or power attack slam enemy models suffering the fire continuous effect without spending a focus point. Scorched Earth lasts for one turn.

wildfire__05a30a3e.name: Wildfire
wildfire__05a30a3e.description: Feora gains 1 focus point for each enemy model currently in her control range suffering the Fire continuous effect and can immediately give that focus to warjacks in her battlegroup that are in her control range. Feora can then remove the Fire continuous effects from any number of models in her control range. For each Fire continuous effect Feora removes, choose one model in her control range to suffer the Fire continuous effect.

clashOfFlames.name: Clash of Flames
clashOfFlames.description: Feora immediately casts Incite without spending focus. Additionally, while in Feora’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Flame Trail. Clash of Flames lasts for one turn.

firesOfCommunion.name: Fires of Communion
firesOfCommunion.description: Choose d3 + 2 enemy non-Leader living or undead warrior models currently in Severius’ control range. The chosen models suffer a boostable POW 12 magical damage roll. If a model is boxed by Fires of Communion, center a cloud effect template on the boxed model and remove it from play. The template is a hazard that remains in play for one round. Enemy models entering or ending their activations in the AOE suffer a POW 12 fire damage roll and the Fire continuous effect.

union.name: Union
union.description: Each warjack in Amon’s battlegroup currently in his control range gains 3 focus points.

judgmentDay.name: Judgment Day
judgmentDay.description: Enemy models currently in Reznik’s control range lose all focus and fury points. While in Reznik’s control range, enemy models cannot upkeep spells or be allocated focus and those casting spells suffer the Fire continuous effect. Judgment Day lasts for one round.

menothsWrath.name: Menoth’s Wrath
menothsWrath.description: Enemy models currently in Kreoss’ control range become knocked down.

invocationsOfTheTrueLaw.name: Invocations of the True Law
invocationsOfTheTrueLaw.description: Enemy upkeep spells and animi in Kreoss’ control range immediately expire. Then Kreoss can immediately cast each of his upkeep spells without spending focus.

ragingInferno.name: Raging Inferno
ragingInferno.description: When an enemy model suffers a fire damage roll while in Malekus’ control range, add an additional die to the damage roll. Raging Inferno lasts for one round.

prayersOfWar.name: Prayers of War
prayersOfWar.description: Warjacks in Durant’s battlegroup currently in his control range gain 1 focus point. Durant gains 1 focus point for each warjack in his battlegroup currently in his control range. Durant cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Prayers of War.

essenceOfDust.name: Essence of Dust
essenceOfDust.description: Friendly Faction models currently in the Testament’s control range gain Incorporeal. When declaring charges and slam power attacks or when making attacks, friendly Faction models can ignore models in the Testament’s control range when determining LOS. Essence of Dust lasts for one turn.

godhead.name: Godhead
godhead.description: For one round, advancing enemy models that end their movement within 10" of the Harbinger and closer to her than they began suffer an unboostable POW 14 fire damage roll.

resurrection.name: Resurrection
resurrection.description: Return d3 + 5 friendly destroyed Faction troopers to play. Place those models within 2" of another model in their unit and completely within the High Reclaimer’s control range. Returned models must forfeit thier Normal Movement and Combat Actions the turn they are returned to play.

shadowsOfUrcaen.name: Shadows of Urcaen
shadowsOfUrcaen.description: Immediately place Thyra anywhere completely within 2" of her current location. When a friendly Faction model activates in Thyra’s control range, at the start of its activation you can place it anywhere completely within 2" of its current location. Shadows of Urcaen lasts for one turn.

divineProtection.name: Divine Protection
divineProtection.description: While in Vindictus’ control range, friendly Faction warrior models cannot be targeted by charges, slam power attacks, enemy spells, or non-magical ranged attacks. Divine Protection lasts for one round.

timeOfSlaughter.name: Time of Slaughter
timeOfSlaughter.description: Anathia gains the benefit of all of her Gifts of Annihilation effects for one round. Additionally, Anathia can immediately leech fury from warbeasts in her battegroup currently in her control range.

arcaneAlignment.name: Arcane Alignment
arcaneAlignment.description: While in Rahn’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 RNG to their non-channeled spells, and their arcane attack rolls and arcane attack damage rolls are boosted. Arcane Alignment lasts for one turn.

perfectExecution.name: Perfect Execution
perfectExecution.description: While in Vyros’ control range, warjacks in his battlegroup gain Flank [friendly Faction warrior model]. Perfect Execution lasts for one turn. (When a model with Flank [friendly Faction warrior model] makes a melee attack against an enemy model in the melee range of a friendly Faction warrior model, the model with Flank gains +2 to attack rolls and gains an additional damage die.)

closingDarkness.name: Closing Darkness
closingDarkness.description: Friendly models/units currently in Elara’s control range gain Ghostly and are affected by Boundless Charge. Closing Darkness lasts for one turn. (A model with Ghostly can advance through terrain and obstacles without penalty and can advance through obstructions and models if it has enough movement to move completely past them.)

huntingSeason.name: Hunting Season
huntingSeason.description: Choose an enemy model/unit in Falcir’s control range. Models in Falcir's battlegroup gain Prey against the chosen model/unit. A model gains +2 to attack and damage rolls against its prey. When the prey is destroyed or removed from play, choose another model/unit in Falcir's control range to be the prey. Hunting Season lasts for one turn.

zeroHour.name: Zero Hour
zeroHour.description: When an enemy model advances and ends its movement or is placed in Garryth’s control range, one friendly Faction model in Garryth’s control range can target the enemy model with a basic attack. Zero Hour attack rolls are boosted. A model can only attack as a result of  Zero Hour once per game. Zero Hour lasts for one round.

vortexLock.name: Vortex Lock
vortexLock.description: While in Garryth’s control range enemy models cannot cast spells, summon horrors, channel spells, or spend focus or fury points. Vortex Lock last for one round.

theVanishing.name: The Vanishing
theVanishing.description: While in Kaelyssa’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Stealth and cannot be targeted by charges or slam power attacks. The Vanishing lasts for one round.

whispersOfTheVeld.name: Whispers of the Veld
whispersOfTheVeld.description: When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold destroys or removes from play one or more friendly models in Ghyrrshyld’s control range with a melee attack, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round after the attack is resolved. Additionally, when a friendly living Faction warrior model is destroyed by an enemy attack while in Ghyrrshyld’s control range, Ghyrrshyld gains the destroyed model’s soul token. When Ghyrrshyld replenishes his focus during your next Control Phase, replace each soul token on him with 1 focus point, then Whispers of the Veld expires.

firestorm.name: Firestorm
firestorm.description: While in Ravyn’s control range, friendly Faction models gain boosted ranged attack rolls and Swift Hunter. Firestorm lasts for one turn.

bladesOfVengeance.name: Blades of Vengeance
bladesOfVengeance.description: Thyron and friendly Faction models beginning their activations in his control range gain +2 SPD. Additionally, while in Thyron’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Duelist. Blades of Vengeance lasts for one round.

illimitableDominion.name: Illimitable Dominion
illimitableDominion.description: While in Horruskh’s control range, friendly Faction models cannot become knocked down and gain +2 ARM. Illimitable Dominion lasts for one round.

pandemonium.name: Pandemonium
pandemonium.description: While in Kishtaar's control range friendly Faction models gain an additional die on attack and damage rolls. Discard the lowest die in each roll. Pandemonium lasts for one round.

howlOfTheAbyss.name: Howl of the Abyss
howlOfTheAbyss.description: Oriax gains up to d3 +2 soul tokens. Additionally., while in Oriax's control range the melee weapons of Cohort models in his battlegroup gain Shadow Bind. Howl of the Abyss lasts for one turn. (A model hit by this weapon suffers Shadow Bind. A model suffering from Shadowbind suffers –3 DEF and cannot advance for one round. Shadow Bind can be shaken.)

hornOfWoe.name: Horn of Woe
hornOfWoe.description: While in Orsus’ control range, enemy models lose Tough and cannot have damage removed from them. Enemy models destroyed while in Orsus’ control range are removed from play. Additionally, choose d3 +2 friendly Faction models currently in Orsus’ control range. The chosen models gain an additional die on melee damage rolls. Horn of Woe lasts for one round.

invocationsOfFire.name: Invocations of Fire
invocationsOfFire.description: This activation, Sabbreth can cast each of her spells once without spending focus points. Friendly Faction warrior models beginning a charge in Sabbreth’s control range gain +2 SPD during that charge. Invocations of Fire lasts for one turn.

avalancheOfSteel.name: Avalanche of Steel
avalancheOfSteel.description: Friendly faction warrior models within Kyrrax's control range gain a +2 bonus to melee attack rolls. Additionally, when a friendly faction model destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with an attack while in his control range, after the attack is resolved, one friendly faction warrior model within his control range can immediately advance up to 2" and make one basic melee attack. A model can only advance and attack as a result of Avalanche of Steel once per game. Avalanche of Steel lasts for one turn.

windsOfChange.name: Winds of Change
windsOfChange.description: Enemy models currently within Lylyth's control range suffer -2 RAT for one round and may be pushed 2" directly away from this model in the order you choose. Enemy models activating in Lylyth's control range lose Flight for one turn. Winds of Change Lasts for one round.

jawsOfTheDragon.name: Jaws of the Dragon
jawsOfTheDragon.description: Nyxyan can immediately choose a new model/unit in her control range to be her prey. Friendly faction warrior models gain the benefits of Nyxyan’s Prey special rule against her prey for one turn.

wallOfFangs.name: Wall of Fangs
wallOfFangs.description: While in Rassyk’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Defensive Strike and Reposition [3"]. Wall of Fangs lasts for one round. (Once per turn, when an enemy model advances into and ends its movement or is placed in the melee range of a model with Defensive Strike, the model with Defensive Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against it.) (At the end of a model/unit with Reposition [3"]’s activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, it can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.)

theDarkSilence.name: The Dark Silence
theDarkSilence.description: While in Shyryss' control range, friendly models gain concealment and Dodge. Additionally when a friendly Faction model within Shyryss’ control range is targeted by a charge or slam, the charging or slamming model suffers –3 SPD when resolving the charge or slam. The Dark Silence lasts for one round. (A model with Dodge can advance up to 2" immediately after an enemy attack that missed it is resolved.)

bloodMoon.name: Blood Moon
bloodMoon.description: When a friendly Faction model directly hits a model in Vallyx's control range with an attack, resolve the attack as if it was a critical hit. Blood Moon lasts for one round.

defianceOfTheVoid.name: Defiance of the Void
defianceOfTheVoid.description: While in Makeda’s control range, friendly living models gain Retaliatory Strike. Additionally, when a friendly living warrior model in this model’s control range is disabled, this model can suffer 1 damage point to remove 1 damage point from the disabled model. This damage cannot be transferred. Defiance of the Void lasts for one round. (If a model with Retaliatory Strike is hit by an enemy melee attack during your opponent’s turn, after that attack is resolved the model with Retaliatory Strike can immediately make one basic melee attack against the attacking model. A model can make only one Retaliatory Strike per turn.)

deathWind.name: Death Wind
deathWind.description: Friendly Faction warrior models beginning their activations in Morghoul’s control range gain Acrobatics, Overtake, and Unstoppable. Death Wind lasts for one turn.

plagueWind.name: Plague Wind
plagueWind.description: While in Rasheth’s control range, enemy models suffer –2 DEF and ARM. The affected model also suffers –2 to its melee attack damage rolls.  When a living model is destroyed in his control range, Rasheth can remove 1 damage point. Plague Wind lasts for one round.

blackout.name: Blackout
blackout.description: Enemy models currently in Morghoul’s control range and LOS suffer Blind for one round. (A model suffering Blind cannot make ranged or arcane attacks, suffers –4 MAT and DEF, and cannot run, charge, or make slam or trample power attacks. It must forfeit either its Normal Movement or Combat Action during its next activation. Blind can be shaken.)

darkDominion.name: Dark Dominion
darkDominion.description: When a living or undead enemy warrior model is boxed by an attack while in Hexeris’ control range, you can take control of it. The model becomes an independent model and gains Undead. The model can immediately advance up to 3" and can make one basic melee attack, then remove the model from play. Dark Dominion lasts for one turn.

danceOfDeath.name: Dance of Death
danceOfDeath.description: Makeda immediately casts Incite without spending fury. Additionally, when a model in Makeda’s battlegroup destroys one or more enemy models in her control range with an attack, either Makeda can gain 1 fury point or 1 fury point can be removed from a model in her battlegroup that is in her control range. Dance of Death lasts for one turn.

imperishableFlesh.name: Imperishable Flesh
imperishableFlesh.description: Immediately apply up to 1 damage point to each aspect of living warbeasts in Naaresh’s battlegroup that are currently in his control range. Naaresh can remove 1 damage point for each damage point applied as a result of Imperishable Flesh. Additionally, while in Naaresh’s control range, living warbeasts in his battlegroup gain +1 ARM and +1 to its melee attack damage rolls  for each of their damaged aspects. Imperishable Flesh lasts for one round.

painSuffering.name: Pain & Suffering
painSuffering.description: While in Morghoul’s control range, enemy non-Leader models cannot spend focus or fury, be forced, or have damage transferred to them. Pain & Suffering lasts for one round.

rageOfAncients.name: Rage of Ancients
rageOfAncients.description: Zaal gains a number of ancestral rage tokens equal to the number of friendly Faction warrior models that have been destroyed and not returned to play since the start of the game. While in Zaal’s control range, friendly Faction models can spend ancestral rage tokens on Zaal to boost one melee attack or melee damage roll for each token spent. At the end of the turn, remove unspent ancestral rage tokens from Zaal.

totalAnnihilation.name: Total Annihilation
totalAnnihilation.description: While in Xerxis’ control range, friendly Faction models gain an additional die on their melee damage rolls. While in Xerxis’ control range and B2B with another friendly Faction model, friendly Faction models gain +2 ARM. Total Annihilation lasts for one round.

callToPenitence.name: Call to Penitence
callToPenitence.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Di Baro’s control range gain Reposition [3"]. Enemy models currently in di Baro’s control range suffer –2 SPD and DEF. Call to Penitence lasts for one round.

rideTheStorm.name: Ride the Storm
rideTheStorm.description: While in Calder’s control range, friendly Faction models gain +2 DEF. Additionally, while in her control range, models in Calder’s battlegroup gain Riposte. Ride the Storm lasts for one round. (When a model with Riposte is missed by an enemy melee attack, immediately after the attack is resolved the model with Riposte can make one basic melee attack against the attacking model.)

initiateFullAuxiliaryPower.name: Initiate Full Auxiliary Power
initiateFullAuxiliaryPower.description: Huxley gains up to 6 focus points. He cannot have more focus points than his current ARC as a result of Initiate Full Auxiliary Power. Huxley can then immediately allocate focus points to warjacks in his battlegroup.

giveEmHell.name: Give ’Em Hell!
giveEmHell.description: When one or more friendly Faction models are destroyed while in Wolfe’s control area by an enemy attack, immediately after the attack is resolved one model in Wolfe’s battlegroup currently in his control area can advance up to 2" and make one basic attack. Give ’Em Hell! lasts for one round.

iceStorm.name: Ice Storm
iceStorm.description: While in Borka’s control range, models gain Stealth. When an enemy model without Resistance: Cold hits one or more friendly models in Borka’s control range with Resistance: Cold with a melee attack during its Combat Action, the enemy model becomes stationary for one round at the end of its activation. Ice Storm lasts for one round.

spreadTheNet.name: Spread the Net
spreadTheNet.description: While in Grim’s control range, enemy models suffer –3 DEF. Enemy models beginning their activations in Grim’s control range suffer –3 SPD and cannot charge or make power attacks or special attacks. Spread the Net lasts for one round.

scrollOfGrimmr.name: Scroll of Grimmr
scrollOfGrimmr.description: Doomshaper and friendly Faction warbeasts in his battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range gain +3 SPD and can charge or make slam or trample power attacks without being forced. Scroll of Grimmr lasts for one turn.

snowblind.name: Snowblind
snowblind.description: Enemy models currently in Kolgrima’s control range lose and cannot gain Eyeless Sight, Flight, or Pathfinder and cannot make ranged attacks for one round. Additionally, enemy models in Kolgrima’s control range are pushed 2" directly away from Kolgrima in the order you choose.

barroomBlitz.name: Barroom Blitz
barroomBlitz.description: Friendly Faction models beginning a charge, slam power attack, or trample power attack in Borka’s control range gain +2 SPD. Warbeasts in Borka’s battlegroup beginning their activations in his control range can make power attacks without being forced and gain an additional die on collateral damage and power attack damage rolls. Barroom Blitz lasts for one turn.

shockAwe.name: Shock & Awe
shockAwe.description: While in Gunnbjorn's control range, friendly Faction models can reroll their attack and damage rolls. Each roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Shock & Awe. Shock & Awe lasts for one turn.

goodOmens.name: Good Omens
goodOmens.description: When a friendly Faction model rolls a 1 or 2 on a die in an attack or damage roll while in Truthsayer’s control range, it can reroll the die. Each die can be rerolled only once as a result of Good Omens. Good Omens lasts for one turn.

fortification.name: Fortification
fortification.description: While in Gunnbjorn’s control range, friendly Faction models gain cover and Resistance: Blast and cannot become knocked down. Fortification lasts for one round.

fellChorus.name: Fell Chorus
fellChorus.description: Grissel can use her Battle Plans three times this activation. Additionally, Desperate Pace, Money Shot, and Tenacity become RNG 12 this activation.

callOfValor.name: Call of Valor
callOfValor.description: Friendly Faction models currently in Grissel’s control range gain Reposition [3"] and Unyielding. Call of Valor lasts for one round. (At the end of an activation in which it did not run or fail a charge, a model with Reposition [3"] can advance up to 3", then its activation ends.) (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

bloodOfDhunia.name: Blood of Dhunia
bloodOfDhunia.description: While within Doomshaper’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain an additional die on melee attack rolls. When a model in Doomshaper’s battlegroup that is in his control range is hit by an enemy attack, after the attack is resolved remove d3 + 3 damage points from the model. Blood of Dhunia lasts for one round.

dhuniasWrath.name: Dhunia’s Wrath
dhuniasWrath.description: Enemy models suffer d6 damage points for each focus or fury point they spend while in Doomshaper’s control range. Enemy warbeasts suffer d6 damage points for each fury point they receive as a result of being forced while in Doomshaper’s control range. If a model is destroyed as a result of this damage while casting a spell, the spell does not take effect. If a model is destroyed as a result of this damage while making an attack, the target model suffers no further damage or effects from the attack. Dhunia’s Wrath lasts for one round.

stokingTheFlames.name: Stoking the Flames
stokingTheFlames.description: Friendly Faction models gain boosted attack and damage rolls against enemy models in Horgle’s control range suffering the Fire continuous effect. Stoking the Flames lasts for one turn.

onMyMark.name: On My Mark
onMyMark.description: While in Grim’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Mark Target and their ranged weapons gain Snipe. On My Mark lasts for one turn. (Other friendly Faction models gain +2 to ranged attack rolls against enemy models within 5" of a model with Mark Target that are in its LOS.) (Ranged weapons with Snipe gain +3 RNG.)

rollingFog.name: Rolling Fog
rollingFog.description: Place d3 + 3 cloud effect templates anywhere completely within Skuld’s control range. Rolling Fog templates do not block friendly Faction models’ LOS. Friendly Faction models can advance through other friendly Faction models that are in a Rolling Fog template  if they have enough movement to move completely past them. While in one or more Rolling Fog templates, living enemy models suffer –2 to attack rolls. Rolling Fog lasts for one round.

grimDetermination.name: Grim Determination
grimDetermination.description: Remove d3+3 damage points from friendly Faction models currently in Madrak’s control range. While in Madrak’s control range, friendly Faction models cannot be charged or slam power attacked. Grim Determination lasts for one round.

desperateHour.name: Desperate Hour
desperateHour.description: While in Madrak’s control range, friendly non-Leader Faction models gain Berserk and Overtake. Desperate Hour lasts for one turn. (When a model with Berserk destroys one or more models with a melee attack during its Combat Action, immediately after the attack is resolved it must make one additional melee attack against another model in its melee range, regardless of whether that model is a friendly model or an enemy model.) (When a model with Overtake destroys one or more enemy models with a basic melee attack during its Combat Action, after the attack is resolved it can immediately advance up to 1".)

rallyingCry.name: Rallying Cry
rallyingCry.description: While in Madrak’s control range, friendly Faction warrior models cannot become knocked down. When a friendly Faction warrior model makes a Tough roll of 4, 5, or 6 while in Madrak’s control range, that model can remove 1 damage point. After removing this damage the affected model can advance up to 3". Rallying Cry lasts for one round.

stonesFortitude.name: Stone’s Fortitude
stonesFortitude.description: When an enemy model makes a damage roll against a friendly Faction model in Ragnor’s control range, the enemy model rolls one less die. Stone’s Fortitude lasts for one round.

stormOfAges.name: Storm of Ages
stormOfAges.description: Enemy models/units activating in Baranova’s control range suffer –2 SPD, cannot charge, and cannot make slam or trample power attacks. When a friendly model in Baranova’s control range is targeted by a ranged or arcane attack, the attack suffers –2 RNG. Storm of Ages lasts for one round.

howlOfTheWolf.name: Howl of the Wolf
howlOfTheWolf.description: While in Borisyuk’s control range, models in his battlegroup gain boosted ranged attack rolls. When a model in Borisyuk's battlegroup destroys or removes from play one or more enemy models with an attack while in his control range, after the attack is resolved, one other model in Borisyuk's battlegroup can immediately advance up to 2" and make one basic attack. A model can only advance and attack as a result of Howl of the Wolf once per game. Howl of the Wolf lasts for one turn.

pallOfAshes.name: Pall of Ashes
pallOfAshes.description: Place d3+3 cloud effect template anywhere completely within Vilkul’s control range. While in the templates, friendly Faction models gain Pathfinder and can move through obstructions and other models if they have enough movement to move completely past them. While in a template, living models suffer -2 DEF, -2 to attack rolls, and lose Tough unless they can ignore gas effects. Pall of Ashes lasts for one round.

fortunesOfWar.name: Fortunes of War
fortunesOfWar.description: While in Sikora’s control range, friendly Faction models gain Unyielding. Additionally, while in Sikora’s control range, friendly Faction models can reroll missed attack rolls. Each attack roll can be rerolled only once as a result of Fortunes of War. Fortunes of War lasts for one round. (A model with Unyielding gains +2 ARM against melee damage rolls.)

checkmate.name: Checkmate
checkmate.description: Savaryn can use his Battle Plan ability a total of three times this activation. Additionally, while in Savaryn’s control range, friendly Faction models ignore cover and concealment when making ranged attacks this turn.
